monk-whirling-assault.audience: Players who want to fight in melee while moving, and progress from Lv1 to Endgame on a single page

changeHistory.summary: Changed SSF to viable and updated the beginner rating from unrated to 2/5, because Maxroll (0.5.5) states in its strengths that the build works in SSF (campaign in about 4 hours, Arbiter in about 8 hours). Confirmed on poe2db that Whirling Assault unlocks at Lv41.

Re-checked the source's statements, covered stages and source information, and fixed mix-ups and over-generalizations. Sources and dynamic setups that could not be confirmed were not treated as re-verified, and the verification date for leveling as a whole was not changed.

Separated the confirmation scope between the source text and the per-stage tabs. Supports and operation from other stages are not recommended as-is; requirements and unconfirmed points are stated. This is not a re-verification of the exact full loadout.
Re-fetched the selected stage tab and corrected mix-ups in the Lv41 leveling main and support skills. Limited the supports and mana measures to what the leveling tab states.

Re-checked 3 of the 5 sources for publication status, supported patch, update date, main skill and ascendancy, and updated the check dates. The 2 Mobalytics sources cannot be fetched automatically, so they remain unchecked (check dates unchanged).

gearPriorities: Weapon: added damage, increased damage, +levels to melee / attack skills, critical, attack speed
Boots: movement speed → resistances, Life, Evasion
Armor: resistances, Life, Evasion. In Endgame, also value ES and global defenses

levelingStages.caution: Place Frozen Locus on enemy packs and break it with Glacial Cascade from behind. Add Herald of Ice at Lv10.
levelingStages.gearPriority: On the weapon, prioritize increased physical damage and added damage. Boots: movement speed. Armor: resistances, Life, Evasion.
levelingStages.label: Lv1–10
levelingStages.mainSkill: Glacial Cascade + Frozen Locus
nowActions: Upgrade Glacial Cascade as the top priority
Place Frozen Locus, then break it with Glacial Cascade
Look for boots with movement speed
levelingStages.passivePriority: Follow the staged "Glacial 1-22" tree. Individual node names cannot be extracted safely, so check the pickup order in the source tree below.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Prioritize replacing a weapon whose damage is not growing, and boots without movement speed.
levelingStages.supports: Glacial Cascade: Concentrated Area → Cold Attunement. Frozen Locus: Ice Bite I → Cold Attunement.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Reach Lv11, with the basic Frozen Locus + Glacial Cascade combo stable.

levelingStages.caution: Tempest Flurry is not the main skill for regular clearing; use it to apply Shock to bosses.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Weapon: increased physical and added damage. Boots: movement speed. Everything else: resistances, Life, Evasion.
levelingStages.label: Lv11–20
levelingStages.mainSkill: Glacial Cascade + Frozen Locus. From Lv14, add Tempest Flurry (once its requirements are met) to apply Shock on bosses.
nowActions: Keep updating Glacial Cascade first
Apply Shock with Tempest Flurry only in boss fights
Secure armor with resistances and Life
levelingStages.passivePriority: Continue the staged "Glacial 1-22" tree. Do not stray from the cold / attack pathing.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Replace weapons that are far below your current level, and armor pieces lacking defenses or resistances.
levelingStages.supports: Continue the early setup. Put Shock on Tempest Flurry and use it to apply Shock to bosses.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Reach Lv21, and be able to reproduce the Frozen Locus + Glacial Cascade combo in boss fights.

levelingStages.caution: Hollow Palm is not automatically optimal; a good Quarterstaff can deal more damage.
levelingStages.gearPriority: If you adopt Hollow Palm, remove the weapon. Otherwise keep using a strong Quarterstaff.
levelingStages.label: Lv21–30
levelingStages.mainSkill: Glacial Cascade until Lv22. From Lv22 you can move to the Storm Wave route.
nowActions: Decide at Lv22 whether to move to Storm Wave
Check the gear requirements before adopting Hollow Palm
Do not sell your weapon right after switching
levelingStages.passivePriority: Switch to the staged "Stormwave 22+" tree. Take Hollow Palm Technique only if you understand its gear requirements.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Before switching to Hollow Palm, assemble Evasion / Energy Shield gear that keeps your damage working without a weapon.
levelingStages.supports: For Storm Wave's support setup, use the "Stormwave 22+" stage of the 0.5.5 guide. For slots whose names cannot be confirmed, see the source guide.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Reach Lv31, and decide between the Storm Wave setup and continuing with Glacial Cascade.

levelingStages.caution: Whirling Assault unlocks at Lv41. Do not remove your current main skill early.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Prioritize resistances, Life and Evasion, and also check the Dexterity / Intelligence requirements after the Lv41 switch.
levelingStages.label: Lv31–40
levelingStages.mainSkill: Storm Wave, or keep Glacial Cascade if it is stable.
nowActions: Prepare Whirling Assault for Lv41
Check the required Dexterity and Intelligence
Keep your pre-switch main skill in place
levelingStages.passivePriority: Progress so you can connect into the staged "Lv41+ Whirling" tree. Check individual nodes in the source tree.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Replace in advance any slots that would not meet gear requirements after the Lv41 switch.
levelingStages.supports: Maintain the staged setup of your chosen leveling route, and prepare the gems for Lv41.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Reach Lv41, have Whirling Assault ready, and meet the required attributes.

levelingStages.caution: The leveling tab presents mana options: Conservative Casting, Mana Leech, or Pounce with Mark of Siphoning. Choose after checking your owned gems and attribute requirements.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Quarterstaff: added damage, increased damage, +levels to melee / attack skills, critical, attack speed. Armor: resistances, Life, Evasion.
levelingStages.label: Lv41–Campaign End
levelingStages.mainSkill: Whirling Assault as the main skill, combined with Staggering Palm, Tempest Bell and Mantra of Destruction.
nowActions: Switch to Whirling Assault
Check mana and support requirements in the leveling setup
Set up Tempest Bell and Mantra of Destruction for bosses
levelingStages.passivePriority: Switch to the "Leveling Whirling 41+" tree of the 0.5.5 guide.
levelingStages.replaceGear: If a good Quarterstaff outperforms Hollow Palm, go back to the weapon setup.
levelingStages.supports: The source's leveling tab lists Magnified Area II, Rage II, Heavy Swing and Pursuit II. Adding Pursuit II is presented as the priority use for a Greater Jeweller's Orb. Add supports only once slots, owned gems and attribute requirements are met.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Finish the campaign. You can clear with Whirling Assault and use Staggering Palm, Tempest Bell and Mantra of Destruction as the situation calls for.

levelingStages.caution: At the start of a map, make your first Power Charge with Killing Palm before activating Charged Staff.
levelingStages.gearPriority: First stabilize resistances and defenses, then grow the Quarterstaff's damage, melee skill levels, critical and attack speed.
levelingStages.label: Start of Mapping
levelingStages.mainSkill: Killing Palm → Charged Staff → Whirling Assault → Falling Thunder.
nowActions: Make the first charge with Killing Palm
Keep Charged Staff up
Use Falling Thunder after Whirling Assault
levelingStages.passivePriority: Move to the "Early Endgame Whirling" tree. For the ascendancy, check the current guide, which includes Way of the Stonefist.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Check in order: armor lacking resistances, boots lacking movement speed, a Quarterstaff whose damage has stalled.
levelingStages.supports: In the source's "Early Endgame Whirling", check the supports that fit your owned gems and slot count. Do not assume the Late Endgame 5-link setup or the high-tier Falling Thunder supports are available at the start of mapping.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: You can keep Charged Staff from dropping, and chain into Falling Thunder after roughly two Whirling Assaults.

levelingStages.caution: There are other charge methods such as Hollow Focus, but the current guide treats the Charged Staff approach as the stable option.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Melee skill levels, critical strike chance, Evasion, maximum ES, global defenses, and any missing resistances.
levelingStages.label: Early Endgame
levelingStages.mainSkill: Whirling Assault as the clearing main skill, Falling Thunder as charge spender and single-target damage.
nowActions: Find out why your charges are dropping
Swap supports depending on whether you have mana problems
Stabilize Evasion, ES and resistances first
levelingStages.passivePriority: Complete the Early Endgame tree before moving to Late Endgame. Avoid changing all passives at once.
levelingStages.replaceGear: If defenses are unstable, prioritize Evasion, ES and resistances over damage gear.
levelingStages.supports: For Whirling Assault, swap between Efficiency II and critical supports depending on your mana situation. Add reflection / area supports to Falling Thunder in stages.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Charge generation and mana sustain are stable, and your upgrade goals toward Late Endgame gear are clear.

levelingStages.caution: Fixed prices and DPS cannot be guaranteed as of publication, so do not state them as numeric targets.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Compare in order: a strong Quarterstaff, melee skill levels, critical strike chance / damage, Evasion, ES, global defenses.
levelingStages.label: Endgame (Finished)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Repeat the basic rotation: Whirling Assault ×2 → Falling Thunder.
nowActions: Stabilize the basic rotation
Check your critical, Evasion and ES gaps
Compare upgrade gains one slot at a time
levelingStages.passivePriority: Base it on the Late Endgame Whirling tree, adjusted to cover your gear's critical, Evasion, ES and resistance gaps.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Update one slot at a time, comparing not the price but your current gaps against actual listed performance.
levelingStages.supports: Finished candidates: Whirling Assault with Magnified Area II, Elemental Armament II, Rage III, Ancestral Call II, Efficiency II. If you have no mana problems, swap Efficiency II for a critical support.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Once finished, update the critical, defense and mana bottlenecks one item at a time.

strengths: Whirling Assault lets you attack while moving, so maps flow smoothly.
Combined with Falling Thunder, you can convert charges into single-target damage or wide-area attacks.
A leveling route from Lv1 to Lv41 is provided.
Maxroll (0.5.5) lists "SSF Campaign ~4 hours, Arbiter ~8 hours" among its strengths.
weaknesses: Whirling Assault cannot be used until Lv41, so you have to switch skills partway through the campaign.
The early Glacial Cascade route is described as having low durability, so keeping gear updated and dodging matter.
In Endgame you need to generate the first Power Charge and keep Charged Staff up, so it is not a complete one-button setup.
The main skill, Whirling Assault, is a Tier 11 gem usable only from Lv41 (poe2db). Until then you progress with other skills.

monk-falling-thunder.audience: Players who want to cycle combos and Power Charges and put out big numbers with a single melee hit

changeHistory.summary: Created a new draft (unpublished). Checked Milkybk_'s Maxroll guide text directly and cross-checked names and numbers against the Japanese poe2db. Confirmed this is a different setup from the builds of the same name (Everseen's HCSSF-oriented build and Kevlar Peterson's Flicker Strike type).

monk-falling-thunder.difficulty: Two respecs during the campaign plus a Hollow Palm transition, and combo and Power Charge management are assumed
gearPriorities: Weapon: critical strike chance and damage. During the transition, elemental damage; in the finished form, a high-physical + critical Sinister Quarterstaff
Gloves: added damage to attacks, critical damage, attack speed (converted by Way of the Stonefist). During Hollow Palm, +levels to melee skills
Armor: Evasion / ES (Chaos Inoculation in the finished form). Boots: 35% movement speed. Amulet: +levels to melee skills and critical

levelingStages.caution: Act 1 is called a difficult section even in the source. In boss fights, damage is reduced for the first 5 seconds after the fight starts, so wait a little before spending Power Charges. Boss sequence: prepare a stun with Wind Blast → stun with Wing Blast for 3 Power Charges → spend 1 with Rend for the lightning buff → place Frost Bomb at their feet → Falling Thunder with the remaining 2.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Use the Orb of Transmutation obtained from Clearfell's league mechanic reward on a Wrapped Quarterstaff. Look for a Long Quarterstaff in Red Vale. Armor: Life / ES. Gloves and rings: added damage to attacks. Boots: movement speed.
levelingStages.label: Lv1–15 (Act 1, Quarterstaff)
levelingStages.mainSkill: For packs, Frozen Locus + Herald of Ice. For single target, Falling Thunder
nowActions: Place Frozen Locus and break it with Quarterstaff Strike or Wind Blast
On bosses, make 3 Power Charges with Wing Blast before firing Falling Thunder
Upgrade to a Gothic Quarterstaff at Lv11
levelingStages.passivePriority: Follow the source's staged "Campaign" tree. There is a first respec at Lv10, so keep some gold in reserve.
levelingStages.replaceGear: At Lv11, check Renly's Gothic Quarterstaff, craft it with your currency and upgrade. Open sockets and insert elemental runes.
levelingStages.supports: Falling Thunder: Elemental Armament I → Lightning Attunement. Frozen Locus: Elemental Armament I → Cold Attunement. Wind Blast: Rage I → Rapid Attacks I. Herald of Ice: Magnified Area I. The support setup is covered only as far as it was cross-checked through a secondary summary of the source planner's staged table; for the latest exact slots, see the source guide.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Reach Lv16 and have the gold for the second respec saved. Transition to Hollow Palm Technique.

levelingStages.caution: Devour a Hollow Focus bell before a boss and you can start the fight with 3 Power Charges. Also keep Frost Bomb's Exposure up.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Remove the Quarterstaff. +levels to melee skills on gloves and amulet is the top priority. Armor: Life / Evasion / ES and resistances.
levelingStages.label: Lv16–End of Act 2 (Hollow Palm transition)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Unarmed attacks with Hollow Palm Technique are the core. Single target is Falling Thunder
nowActions: Respec into Hollow Palm Technique at Lv16
Secure +levels to melee skills on gloves and amulet
Finish the Trial of the Sekhemas at Lv22 and take Hollow Focus Technique
levelingStages.passivePriority: Respec into Hollow Palm Technique at Lv16. At Lv22, finish the Trial of the Sekhemas and take Hollow Focus Technique as your first ascendancy.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Prioritize gloves / amulets with +levels to melee skills. You do not need to upgrade a weapon in this period, so save crafting currency.
levelingStages.supports: During Hollow Palm you use no weapon and scale damage with melee skill levels. The Act 2 single-target loop: Shock with Storm Wave → consume the Shock with Siphoning Strike for a Power Charge → Falling Thunder. For exact support slots, see the source planner.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Push through Acts 3–4 still on Hollow Palm.

levelingStages.caution: Hollow Palm starts to fall off late. You do not need weapon upgrades in this period, so save your crafting currency instead of spending it.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Keep updating gloves / amulet with +levels to melee skills. Start leaning armor toward Evasion / ES and bring resistances close to the cap.
levelingStages.label: Act 3–Campaign End (Hollow Palm continues)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Hollow Palm unarmed attacks + Falling Thunder
nowActions: Push through the campaign still on Hollow Palm
Save your crafting currency
Before bosses, store Power Charges by Devouring a bell
levelingStages.passivePriority: Continue the source's "Campaign" tree. The second ascendancy is Way of the Stonefist: glove mods are converted and scale — attack speed → chance for Onslaught, added damage → gained as added damage, defenses → Evasion / ES.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Update gloves with added damage and +levels to melee skills as the top priority.
levelingStages.supports: Continue the campaign setup. Maintain the Thrill of the Kill buff with Devour / Killing Palm finishers, and do not let Rend's lightning buff drop in boss fights. For exact support slots, see the source planner.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Reach the Interludes and Lv54, with the crafting materials for a Waxing Quarterstaff ready.

levelingStages.caution: If you leave Hollow Palm's falloff unaddressed, you will stall in the Interludes. Once you hit Lv54, return to a weapon promptly.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Crafting a Waxing Quarterstaff with your saved currency is the top priority.
levelingStages.label: Interludes (Lv54, return to Quarterstaff)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Waxing Quarterstaff + Falling Thunder
nowActions: Craft a Waxing Quarterstaff at Lv54
Remove Hollow Palm Technique
Start securing gems for the Whirling Assault setup
levelingStages.passivePriority: Remove Hollow Palm Technique and rebuild the tree around a Quarterstaff.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Replace gear that was all-in on +levels to melee skills for the unarmed setup with regular added damage / critical gear, piece by piece.
levelingStages.supports: You are returning to a weapon, so return Falling Thunder's supports to the weapon-based setup. For exact slots, see the source planner.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Finish the campaign. Start stockpiling gems for the Whirling Assault setup for maps.

levelingStages.caution: Until you have Ailith's Chimes, the charge engine is not in its finished form. The opening charge generation sometimes uses Tempest Bell.
levelingStages.gearPriority: The first purchase candidate is Ailith's Chimes. Whirling Assault has no inherent conversion, so the source advises that an elemental damage Quarterstaff is advantageous.
levelingStages.label: Start of Mapping (respec to Whirling Assault)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Build energy with Whirling Assault, generate Power Charges with Reaper's Invocation → Profane Ritual. Spend them on Charged Staff and Falling Thunder
nowActions: Respec into the Whirling Assault setup
Make Ailith's Chimes your first purchase goal
Do not let the Charged Staff buff drop
levelingStages.passivePriority: Respec into the mapping tree. Switch to the routine of processing a Hollow Focus bell with Killing Palm before bosses to store Power Charges.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Secure Ailith's Chimes as the top priority. After that, grow the weapon's elemental damage and critical.
levelingStages.supports: Whirling Assault is for building energy; Falling Thunder carries the damage. Inserting Mantra of Destruction adds chaos damage in proportion to the combo consumed.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Obtain Ailith's Chimes and take Martial Master.

levelingStages.caution: Herald of Ice explosions need Freeze. Secure cold damage through Heart of the Well or the "gain damage as cold" on Fists of Stone. If the big hit does not crit, you have to rebuild your charges from scratch.
levelingStages.gearPriority: A high-physical + critical strike chance Sinister Quarterstaff. Gloves: Fists of Stone, converted by Way of the Stonefist. Armor: Evasion / ES. Boots: 35% movement speed. Raise Falling Thunder's level with a Prism of Belief.
levelingStages.label: Endgame (Finished) (CI, charge engine complete)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Alternate Whirling Assault and Falling Thunder. Store up to 6 Power Charges, then Falling Thunder
nowActions: Maintain the loop: 6 Power Charges → Falling Thunder
Transition to Chaos Inoculation and stack ES
Swap to a dedicated setup for pinnacle bosses
levelingStages.passivePriority: Respec into Chaos Inoculation and rebuild ailment and stun thresholds around ES. Add more runes with Runic Meridians. The source states that Abasement and Shimmering Mirage are required to prevent permanent stun / permanent freeze. Martial Adept recovers ES when you consume combo.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Replace all Life mods with Evasion / ES. On the amulet, aim for max rolls of defensive mods and +levels to melee skills. Push gems to Lv20, 20% quality and 6 links.
levelingStages.supports: Whirling Assault: Culmination II + Ailith's Chimes converts consumed combo into Power Charges. Falling Thunder: Nova Projectiles I for mapping. In the pinnacle-boss-only setup, remove Nova Projectiles I and other utility. Critical is also supplemented by Charge Regulation, Blindside and Pinpoint Critical.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: The finished form. From here, progress with 3-mod jewels and max-rolling each gear piece.

mainSkillTiming.available: Falling Thunder is a Tier 1 gem usable from Lv1 (poe2db). However, it only shows its true value once you have the means to generate Power Charges
mainSkillTiming.recommendedSwitch: After the campaign, respec into the Whirling Assault setup. Once you have Ailith's Chimes and Martial Master, the charge engine is complete

monk-falling-thunder.name: Falling Thunder Martial Artist

beginner.note: The main gem is Tier 1 and usable from Lv1, so only the early condition is counted as a confirmed condition. The source's weaknesses include "Combo Based", "Melee" and "Rough Act 1", and combo and Power Charge management plus melee dodging are assumed, so the operation and dodge conditions are not counted. SSF viability is not stated in the source.

earlyMainSkill.basis: Falling Thunder is a Tier 1 gem requiring level 1 (poe2db). The source also builds its Act 1 boss rotation around it.

boss.note: A setup that swaps supports specifically for pinnacle bosses is provided; this is a build whose calling card is single-target damage.
boss.sourceName: Maxroll: Falling Thunder Martial Artist Build Guide

damage.note: High boss damage is among the strengths. The summary also describes big single hits (nukes) on pinnacle bosses, and the design pushes critical strike chance close to 100%.
damage.sourceName: Maxroll: Falling Thunder Martial Artist Build Guide

defense.basis: Both a strength and a weakness
defense.note: There are options for ES, Evasion and Deflect plus Chaos Inoculation, but it is melee and the early game is rough.
defense.sourceName: Maxroll: Falling Thunder Martial Artist Build Guide

mapping.note: Designed to process packs with Herald of Ice explosions from Freeze. Great Scaling is also listed among the strengths.
mapping.sourceName: Maxroll: Falling Thunder Martial Artist Build Guide

reviewedFacts.difficulty: High (the source's weaknesses are Combo Based / Melee / Rough Act 1. Many buttons, and charge management is needed at all times)
reviewedFacts.gearDependence: Centered on the weapon (Quarterstaff) and gloves (Fists of Stone converted by Way of the Stonefist). The finished form requires the lineage support Ailith's Chimes
reviewedFacts.operation: A lot (keep cycling the loop: generate Power Charges → maintain Rend → Falling Thunder)
reviewedFacts.ssfNote: Whether the build works in SSF is not stated in the source (Maxroll). A separate HCSSF-oriented guide of the same name exists (Everseen, Mobalytics), but it is not this entry's source

strengths: A Power-Charge-spending Falling Thunder hit is huge, and boss damage is high (source strength: High Boss Damage).
If you freeze enemies with cold damage, Herald of Ice explosions can process packs (source strength: Herald Explosions).
Designed to push critical strike chance close to 100%, so it keeps growing as your gear improves (source strength: Great Scaling).
The main gem is Tier 1, so you can start using Falling Thunder from Lv1 (poe2db).
weaknesses: A melee build, and Act 1 is rough (source weaknesses: Melee / Rough Act 1).
Combo and Power Charge management are assumed; there are many buttons and operation is complex (source weakness: Combo Based).
There are two respecs during the campaign, at Lv10 and Lv16, and the Lv16 one transitions you to Hollow Palm Technique.
The finished form requires Ailith's Chimes; without it, the charge engine does not turn.
If the big hit does not crit, you have to rebuild your Power Charges from scratch (source gear explanation).

monk-hollow-focus-storm-wave.audience: Players who want to run a fast-paced melee build that flattens maps with bell explosions and melts bosses with overlapping fissures

changeHistory.summary: Created a new draft (unpublished). Checked Goratha's Maxroll guide text directly and cross-checked names against the Japanese poe2db. Note that the "Hollow" in the build name refers to Hollow Focus (the bells), not Hollow Palm Technique (unarmed) — the source uses a Quarterstaff throughout.

monk-hollow-focus-storm-wave.difficulty: Starts with leveling on a separate character, weapon set swapping, combo management, and positioning to overlap Storm Wave's fissures are assumed
gearPriorities: Weapon: a high physical damage Quarterstaff. In the finished form, a rare with critical damage bonus, attack speed and critical strike chance; an upgraded Duality is also a candidate
Gloves: the most important slot, because Way of the Stonefist converts them. Physical damage to attacks, +levels to melee skills, attack speed
Armor: maximize Evasion, with Deflect on 2+ pieces. Amulet: +3 to melee skills and Evasion %. Rings: physical leech (Life / Mana)

levelingStages.caution: Monk is the weakest of all classes early on, and the source states plainly that Act 1 is also the Twister leveling setup's weakest point. During the single-target rotation, do not leave Whirling Slash's wind cloud. Dodge rolling means starting over from the beginning.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Weapon Set 1 is specialized for Whirling Slash speed: from Act 2, look for a Winged Spear and use an Essence of Haste. No off-hand. If you have the currency, Skysliver is also a candidate. Weapon Set 2 is specialized for Twister damage: stack added elemental damage; attack speed is not needed. Early on, use a Buckler for Parry → Fangs of Frost; later, switch to a Spirit sceptre to add more Spirit gems. Armor: Armour / Evasion early, moving to Evasion / ES later.
levelingStages.label: Lv1–Campaign End (Twister leveling)
levelingStages.mainSkill: A combo setup that builds stages with Whirling Slash and releases Twister. On bosses, War Banner or Herald of Ice
nowActions: First create a Huntress, secure a spear and the Whirling Slash / Twister gems, and pass them to the Monk through the stash
Set Whirling Slash to Weapon Set 1 and everything else to Weapon Set 2
On bosses, follow the order: Whirling Slash ×3 → Ice-Tipped Arrows and Barrage → Twister
levelingStages.passivePriority: Rush Concussive Attack as fast as possible, then hurry to Dance with Death. On the way, take attack speed for Weapon Set 1, and use Essence of the Mountain and Hail for Weapon Set 2 to supplement freeze buildup and cold damage. The first ascendancy is Way of the Mountain, which helps with stun, damage and defense while you are freezing enemies.
levelingStages.replaceGear: From Act 2, upgrade to a Winged Spear and prioritize using an Essence of Haste. Move armor bases from Armour / Evasion to Evasion / ES piece by piece.
levelingStages.supports: Gem cutting priority is set by the source: cut Frost Bomb early, and Fangs of Frost with the first Lv3 gem. The first two Lv5 gems are Barrage and Ice-Tipped Arrows. Freezing Mark with the first Lv7 gem. For supports, put Rage I and Rapid Attacks I on Whirling Slash and the rest on Twister. Link Frost Nexus to Twister to create cold ground; later, Salvo is also a candidate.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Finish the campaign and reach maps.

levelingStages.caution: Freeze is the prerequisite for maximum damage. Without a Vestige of Darkness, use Grip of Winter to freeze more easily. Mana problems are common, and you need physical damage mana leech on at least one slot somewhere. The source warns of a known bug where Charged Staff's effect disappears on weapon swap.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Stacking Evasion as high as possible is the main defense (combined with Deflect and ES). Early on, a Vestige of Darkness is excellent for the helmet; otherwise, Grip of Winter. For the weapon, look for maximum physical damage; attack speed, critical damage bonus, critical strike chance and +levels to melee skills are also good. Note that +levels to melee skills makes mana heavier. Gloves are the most important slot as the conversion target of Way of the Stonefist, and physical damage to attacks on them enables Herald of Ice's Armour Explosion. Rings need Life / Mana leech of physical damage on at least one slot.
levelingStages.label: Early Mapping (switch to Storm Wave)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Single target is Storm Wave. Clearing is Shattering Palm + Herald of Ice ice explosions. The Hollow Focus bell and Tempest Bell raise both
nowActions: Switch to the three main skills: Storm Wave / Shattering Palm / Tempest Bell
On bosses, apply Elemental Weakness and Freezing Mark together with Hand of Chayula before you start hitting
Fire Storm Wave standing at the distance where its fissures overlap (too close or too far both lower single-target damage)
levelingStages.passivePriority: The second ascendancy is Way of the Stonefist. The third is Martial Adept or Hollow Focus Technique. Early Power Charge generation goes through Resonance + Combat Frenzy into Charged Staff. Take Heavy Frost and Thin Ice, and area nodes of the Dizzying Sweep family.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Obtain a Vestige of Darkness early. If you have spare currency, Duality is another alternative candidate. Update gloves on the assumption of the Way of the Stonefist conversion, prioritizing physical damage to attacks and +levels to melee skills.
levelingStages.supports: Link Armour Break III to Herald of Ice and cause Armour Explosion with the added physical damage from Way of the Stonefist — that is the core of clearing. Shattering Palm takes Magnified Area II and Ancestral Call II, with Rage III also a candidate, and it is also the trigger source for Ice Bite II. The recommended Hollow Focus setup is Magnified Area II, Cooldown Recovery II and similar (poe2db).
levelingStages.transitionCondition: You have Deflect gear on 2+ pieces, and you reach the stage where you can spend currency on lineage supports and the finished weapon.

levelingStages.caution: Do not link Rapid Attacks III to any skill (a single-target damage loss check item in the source FAQ). Elemental Weakness needs leveling at high levels, and its Intelligence requirement is heavy. The proper distance for Storm Wave's fissure overlap differs per boss hitbox, and some of it has to be learned by experience.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Best is a rare staff with high critical damage bonus, attack speed and critical strike chance. An upgraded Duality is also a candidate; choose the damage version for the upgrade. Aim for Deflect on 2+ pieces, eventually toward the 95% cap. The amulet wants +3 to melee skills with global defenses and Evasion %; having Spirit lets you avoid compromising Evasion on the chest. The ideal Heart of the Well turns double damage into gained damage plus Rage on melee hit. Place a Time-Lost Sapphire near Dizzying Hits.
levelingStages.label: Endgame (Finished) (lineage supports, Deflect cap)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Clear with Shattering Palm and melt bosses with Storm Wave's overlapping fissures. Bells are supplied by both Hollow Focus and Tempest Bell
nowActions: Obtain Kaom's Madness first (relatively cheap, and it adds one fissure)
Increase Deflect gear to 2+ pieces and approach the 95% cap
Put a Druid talisman in Weapon Set 2 and make a Werewolf-form dash movement set
levelingStages.passivePriority: Once Chakra of Rhythm + Rune of Culmination lets Shattering Palm gain 2 combo from one attack, switch Martial Adept to Hollow Focus Technique. The final ascendancy is Runic Meridians. The Hollowkeeper requires First Principle of the Hollow and First Teachings of the Keeper. Late on, fill in critical nodes.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Max-roll the rare staff and progress the Duality upgrade. Runes are specified in the source FAQ: Saqawal's Rune of Erosion on the helmet, Craiceann's Rune of Warding and Warding Rune of Heart on the chest, Rune of Culmination on the gloves, Farrul's Rune of the Chase on the boots.
levelingStages.supports: Storm Wave lineage supports: Kaom's Madness adds a fissure, Garukhan's Resolve is a large gain for critical specialization (expensive), Vorana's Siege covers both area and single target. The mana measure is Oisín's Oath. Fragments Of The Past is used to apply Maim and Cold Exposure, but it consumes a runeword. Once your gear is ready, move Rage III over to Shattering Palm.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: The finished form. From here, progress with jewels, max-rolling each gear piece, and pushing critical damage.

mainSkillTiming.available: Storm Wave is a Tier 7 gem, and the source FAQ says it is usable from Lv21. However, the source says Twister leveling is faster during the campaign, and full use starts after reaching maps.
mainSkillTiming.recommendedSwitch: Race through the campaign on Twister, then switch to the Storm Wave + Shattering Palm setup after reaching maps. The bells (Hollow Focus) come fully online when you take the Hollow Focus Technique ascendancy

monk-hollow-focus-storm-wave.name: Hollow Focus Storm Wave Martial Artist

beginner.note: The main skill, Storm Wave, is a Tier 7 gem usable from Lv21, so only one early condition under the beginner criteria (main skill usable at Lv22 or below) can be confirmed. However, the leveling reality is the Twister setup, and it assumes preparing a Huntress first, weapon set swapping, combo management and positioning to overlap fissures, so the operation, dodge and SSF conditions cannot be confirmed. SSF viability is not stated in the source (the source mentions prices of uniques and lineage supports, and much of it assumes trade).

earlyMainSkill.basis: Storm Wave is a Tier 7 gem usable from Lv21 (source FAQ). It meets this site's beginner criterion: "at least one main skill usable from Lv22 or below."

boss.note: Single-target damage from overlapping fissures is the calling card. Positioning mastery is assumed, but the source states plainly that it destroys bosses.
boss.sourceName: Maxroll: Hollow Focus Storm Wave Martial Artist Build Guide

damage.note: Storm Wave's fissure overlap is the single-target core, and it grows further with lineage supports (Kaom's Madness adds a fissure, Garukhan's Resolve specializes in critical).
damage.sourceName: Maxroll: Hollow Focus Storm Wave Martial Artist Build Guide

defense.basis: Both a strength and a weakness
defense.note: The source rates it "extremely tanky" through Evasion, Deflect and Ghost Dance recovery, while the early-game Monk is soft, and reaching the Deflect cap requires securing 2+ gear pieces.
defense.sourceName: Maxroll: Hollow Focus Storm Wave Martial Artist Build Guide

mapping.note: The Hollow Focus bell explosions and the Shattering Palm + Herald of Ice Armour Explosion chain are the core of clearing.
mapping.sourceName: Maxroll: Hollow Focus Storm Wave Martial Artist Build Guide

reviewedFacts.difficulty: High (weapon set management, combos and positioning are needed at all times. There are moments during the leveling rotation where dodge rolling is off-limits)
reviewedFacts.gearDependence: Centered on the weapon (Quarterstaff) and gloves (converted by Way of the Stonefist). In the finished form, the lineage supports Kaom's Madness / Garukhan's Resolve are the room to grow
reviewedFacts.operation: A lot (the Twister leveling rotation is fixed: Whirling Slash ×3 → buff → Twister. After maps: Hand of Chayula debuffs → Shattering Palm → Tempest Bell → Storm Wave positioning)
reviewedFacts.ssfNote: Whether the build works in SSF is not stated in the source (Maxroll). The source mentions buying Skysliver and Duality and the prices of lineage supports (cheap / expensive), and much of it assumes trade

strengths: With Hollow Focus bell explosions and the Shattering Palm + Herald of Ice chain, map clearing is extremely fast (source: obliterates maps).
Overlapping Storm Wave fissures give high boss single-target damage (source: destroys bosses).
Recovery from Evasion, Deflect and Ghost Dance makes the finished form extremely tanky (source: extremely tanky).
Leveling on the Twister setup lets you race through the campaign (source: extremely fast leveling).
weaknesses: Monk is the weakest of all classes early on, and Act 1 is also the Twister leveling setup's weakest point (source gear explanation).
You need the preparation of creating a Huntress first to ready a spear and gems (source's recommended procedure).
Weapon set swapping and combo management are assumed, and dodge rolling during the leveling rotation breaks the sequence.
Storm Wave's single-target damage depends on positioning to overlap its fissures, and the proper distance differs per boss.
Mana problems are common, and the finished form's lineage supports include an expensive one (Garukhan's Resolve).

monk-infernal-legion-chayula.audience: Players who like "zero-button" play: pressing almost nothing while the area around their companion keeps burning, processing maps and bosses with DoT

changeHistory.summary: Created a new draft (unpublished). Checked Shayd's Maxroll guide text directly and cross-checked names and mechanics against the Japanese poe2db. No mirror or summary sites were used. The ascendancy's official Japanese name is "Acolyte of Chayula". leagueStarter was set to true to match the site convention that all existing entries are true, but the source is not a dedicated league starter guide, so this needs confirmation at publication.

monk-infernal-legion-chayula.difficulty: Starts with melee leveling (Ice Strike) rather than minions, and around Lv56 requires a respec of about 40,000 gold and taming two rare beasts with specified mods
gearPriorities: +levels to all minion skills: secure it on the sceptre, helmet and amulet. The top-priority stat, affecting both the companion's damage and durability (source).
Spirit: +92 or more additional Spirit from gear is the requirement to use Blackflame. With a Shrine Sceptre, you can use Spirit-reservation supports effectively for free (source).
Trenchtimbre: early on the +1 roll, updated to the +2 roll in red maps. Cheap and a large gain (source).
Companion maximum Life and increased minion area of effect: Infernal Legion II's base damage scales with the companion's maximum Life, and increased area translates directly into clear area (source).
Defense: build on Evasion / ES bases, and transition to Chaos Inoculation at about 6,000 ES. The finished form is about 10,000 ES + over 50% Evasion (source).
Jewels: prioritize "increased minion area of effect" (Ruby / Diamond), increased Presence area, and minion maximum Life (source).

levelingStages.caution: The source calls the early part of Monk's Act 1 a rough section. Do not overextend until Ice Strike unlocks.
levelingStages.gearPriority: A Quarterstaff with high physical / cold damage. For the remaining slots, prioritize maximum Life and resistances. Evasion or Evasion / ES bases are preferable, but mod content matters more than the base (source).
levelingStages.label: Lv1–13 (Act 1 early: Quarterstaff)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Progress with a high-damage Quarterstaff. Break Frozen Locus ice crystals with the tip of Glacial Cascade to cover both pack clearing and single target
nowActions: Upgrade to a high-damage Quarterstaff
Prioritize maximum Life and resistances on gear
Replace flasks with the newest ones
levelingStages.passivePriority: Lay the groundwork toward Concussive Attack. Ideally take Hollow Palm Technique by the Count Geonor fight in Act 1 (source).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Update flasks to the newest ones every 10–15 levels (source).
levelingStages.supports: The policy is to supplement the Quarterstaff's damage with runes such as a Lesser Glacial Rune (source).
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Ice Strike unlocks at Lv14.

levelingStages.caution: This stage is not a minion setup yet. To secure the respec cost (about 39,000–40,000 gold), pick up and sell rares, and do not buy expensive rares from vendors (source). Early defense is fragile — that is a weakness in the source.
levelingStages.gearPriority: +levels to melee skills on gloves and amulet is the damage core. Balance Life and resistances. During the campaign, if you see minion gear for after the transition (a sceptre, or a helmet with +levels to all minion skills), secure it (source).
levelingStages.label: Lv14–End of Act 4 (Ice Strike leveling)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Ice Strike is the main skill. Explode frozen enemies with Herald of Ice, and dive into large packs with Shattering Palm. On bosses, place Tempest Bell and cycle the combo
nowActions: Build freeze chains with Ice Strike and Herald of Ice
Save about 40,000 gold for the respec
Secure minion gear (sceptre, helmet) when you see it
levelingStages.passivePriority: Taking Hollow Palm Technique lets you fight without a weapon and frees you from hunting for melee weapons. Remnant Attraction makes collecting Flames of Chayula easier. The first ascendancy point is Waking Dream (source).
levelingStages.replaceGear: After taking Hollow Palm Technique, you no longer need to update your weapon. If you have the funds, Thrillsteel and Yoke of Suffering are candidates (source).
levelingStages.supports: Embitter is important: it converts Into the Breach's added chaos damage to cold so you can take Freeze (source). Cannibalism I and Clarity I supplement Life / Mana recovery. Putting Freezing Mark and Elemental Weakness on Hand of Chayula lets you apply both with one button (source).
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Finish Act 4 and enter the Interludes. Lv56+ and 18+ weapon set points are the guide for the transition.

levelingStages.caution: Finish the taming before the respec. The Plague Harvester is around Khari Crossing in the Interludes, and the Diretusk Boar spawns fixed at the Troubled Camp in Act 3's Infested Barrens, where you can reroll its mods with checkpoint respawns (source FAQ). Be careful not to kill the rare beasts.
levelingStages.gearPriority: A sceptre, helmet and amulet with +levels to all minion skills. A Shrine Sceptre is the best base, but mod content matters more than the base (source).
levelingStages.label: Around Lv56–Transition (tame companions and respec)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Tame the two companions first, then respec your passives and transition to the Infernal Legion II setup. The main companion is a Plague Harvester with the "all damage can Ignite" mod; the support companion is a Diretusk Boar with the "all damage can Shock" mod (source)
nowActions: Tame a Plague Harvester (all damage can Ignite)
Tame a Diretusk Boar (all damage can Shock)
Respec your passives for about 40,000 gold
levelingStages.passivePriority: The respec costs about 40,000 gold. Vile Mending, Living Death, minion fire resistance and Unspoken Bond are required nodes so your companions do not kill themselves with Infernal Legion (source). Long Distance Relationship and Bond of the Ape extend the companion's area of effect. The ascendancy order is Waking Dream → Choice of Power → Chayula's Gift (source).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Prepare Saitha's Spear in Weapon Set II (to Aggravate boss Ignites). Set both companions to Weapon Set I only, so a weapon swap can instantly heal and recall them (source).
levelingStages.supports: Cut Infernal Legion II with a Lv5 Uncut Support Gem. Do not use Infernal Legion I — its fire resistance and area are insufficient (stated in the source). Put Selfless Remnants on Into the Breach to transfer the purple flame's effect to allies in your Presence. After taking Gigantic Following, replace Hulking Minions with Searing Flame II (source).
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Both companions are tamed, the respec is done, and you can enter maps with Infernal Legion II.

levelingStages.caution: If a companion leaves your Presence, your maximum ES drops visibly. If it happens often, add more increased Presence area jewels (source).
levelingStages.gearPriority: Obtain Trenchtimbre's +1 roll early and replace the Buckler. Using Blackflame requires +92 or more additional Spirit from gear. Saitha's Spear is cheap and powerful (source).
levelingStages.label: Early Mapping
levelingStages.mainSkill: Process maps with the companion's radial DoT. On entering a zone, enter with Weapon Set II (the Into the Breach snapshot), and apply Exposure with Frost Bomb. On bosses, have the companion apply Ignite, then weapon swap and Aggravate the Ignite with Spearfield (source)
nowActions: Obtain a Buckler with +1 to all minion skill levels
Make a habit of entering zones with Weapon Set II
On bosses, follow the order: Ignite → Frost Bomb → Spearfield
levelingStages.passivePriority: The stage where you use Mind Over Matter to use Mana as a mitigation pool (source). On jewels, prioritize increased Presence area, aiming for a radius of about 7m (source).
levelingStages.replaceGear: For the sceptre, prioritize mods. If a Shrine Sceptre is expensive, you may save with a Stoic Sceptre or similar (source).
levelingStages.supports: With a Shrine Sceptre, you can use Spirit-reservation supports such as Upwelling II effectively for free. Put leftover Spirit into Ghost Dance. Enable Withering Presence only after obtaining Blackflame (source).
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Enter the red map range, where you can aim for Trenchtimbre's +2 roll and Genesis Tree minion gear.

levelingStages.caution: Catha's Brilliance increases the companion's Spirit cost. If you come up short, take additional companion reservation nodes; if it is still not enough, go back to Infernal Legion II (source). The Elephant Tortoise setup deals about 80% more damage, but it requires AI herding (holding Direct Minions), and the source treats it as an alternative.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Update Trenchtimbre to the +2 roll. Replace belt and rings with Genesis Tree minion pieces; the belt's "increased minion area" is the most important. Replace Blackflame with minion rings one by one (source).
levelingStages.label: Red Maps (transition to the Wasp setup)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Transition to the Wasp setup, which assumes Xoph's Pyre. The mains are a Plague Harvester with Shroud Walker and a Gargantuan Wasp, which teleport to enemies while spreading area Ignites. Put Catha's Brilliance on the other companion instead (source)
nowActions: Obtain Xoph's Pyre and transition to the Wasp setup
Update Trenchtimbre to the +2 roll
Assemble increased minion area on jewels
levelingStages.passivePriority: The top jewel priority is "increased minion area of effect" (only rolls on Ruby and Diamond). Next, increased Presence area and minion maximum Life (source).
levelingStages.replaceGear: If resistances are short, supplement with runes. Instilling Warlord Leader on the amulet extends the Presence radius and damage (source).
levelingStages.supports: Scouring Flame is a strict upgrade over Searing Flame II. A Skeletal Cleric helps companions survive. Charged Mark and Sniper's Mark create shocked ground (source). Convalescence is insurance that starts ES recharge immediately when you take damage.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: ES reaches about 6,000 and you can transition to Chaos Inoculation.

levelingStages.caution: A large part of your ES and Evasion depends on the companion being inside your Presence (source). There is no useful fourth ascendancy notable, so the fourth ascendancy is not urgent (stated in the source).
levelingStages.gearPriority: Maximize ES on helmet, chest and focus (focus: +2 to all minion skill levels). Sacrificial Regalia, Jiquani's Thesis and Mageblood are finished-form candidates. Add Transcendent Limbs only after you finish rerolling your ideal companion (source).
levelingStages.label: Endgame (Finished) (Chaos Inoculation form)
levelingStages.mainSkill: After taking Chaos Inoculation, run with about 10,000 ES and over 50% Evasion. The companion's area Ignite is constant DPS, and you focus on Frost Bomb and debuff upkeep (source)
nowActions: Transition to Chaos Inoculation at about 6,000 ES
Update the sceptre to a Shrine Sceptre with Purity of Fire
Keep rerolling companion mods
levelingStages.passivePriority: Add notables with Megalomaniac and Prism of Belief jewels. Defense and companion Life nodes also raise ES, Evasion and damage at the same time (source).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Maximum Life and chaos resistance rolls become unnecessary after Chaos Inoculation. Update one slot at a time based on ES and minion stats (source).
levelingStages.supports: At this stage the sceptre is assumed to be a Shrine Sceptre with Purity of Fire. If you cannot hold one, take Living Death in the passives (source).
levelingStages.transitionCondition: After finishing, progress by rerolling companion mods (Shroud Walker + all damage can Ignite, etc.) and updating jewels.

monk-infernal-legion-chayula.mainSkill: Attach Infernal Legion II to a companion tamed with Tame Beast (a Plague Harvester) for a radial DoT setup that constantly Ignites nearby enemies. Transfer Into the Breach's purple flames to the companion with Selfless Remnants to grow the Ignite with added chaos damage

mainSkillTiming.available: The main skill, Infernal Legion II, cannot be used early on. Around Lv56 you tame companions and respec your passives, then transition. Until then you level with a melee setup on Ice Strike (unlocks at Lv14)
mainSkillTiming.recommendedSwitch: Prepare Lv56+, 18+ weapon set points, about 40,000 gold and a Lv5 Uncut Support Gem; tame the two companions first (Plague Harvester = all damage can Ignite, Diretusk Boar = all damage can Shock), then respec. Do not use Infernal Legion I

monk-infernal-legion-chayula.name: Infernal Legion Acolyte of Chayula

beginner.note: The main skill, Infernal Legion II, transitions in after a respec around Lv56, so earlyMainSkill is not counted as a confirmed condition. Mapping itself is low-operation — the source states "Zero Button" — but the melee leveling before the transition, the weapon swap on zone entry and managing the companion's Presence are required, so the remaining conditions cannot be confirmed. SSF viability is not stated in the source.

moderateOperation.basis: The source's strengths state "Zero Button Playstyle", and its summary says "Infernal Legion II combined with Companion provides a \"Zero-Button\" Playstyle when it comes to Mapping". The companion's radial DoT does the processing, and you mainly maintain Frost Bomb and debuffs.

boss.note: From the source's summary. You apply Ignite first, then weapon swap to add debuffs and Spearfield's Aggravate, so the Ignite remains during the swap and DPS does not drop.
boss.sourceName: Maxroll: Infernal Legion Acolyte of Chayula Build Guide (Shayd)

damage.note: The first of the source's strengths. Into the Breach's added chaos damage reaches 190% with no investment (source FAQ), and with the "all damage can Ignite" mod it rides directly onto the Ignite, nearly tripling DPS.
damage.sourceName: Maxroll: Infernal Legion Acolyte of Chayula Build Guide (Shayd)

defense.basis: Both a strength and a weakness
defense.note: The finished form is very tanky at about 10,000 ES + over 50% Evasion + Chaos Inoculation (source strength: "Very Tanky Endgame"). On the other hand, the early campaign is fragile — a source weakness ("Squishy Early Game").
defense.sourceName: Maxroll: Infernal Legion Acolyte of Chayula Build Guide (Shayd)

mapping.note: A constant radial DoT occurs around the companion and can be processed with zero buttons. However, it depends on the companion's AI and Presence area management, and rerolling companions with specified mods is assumed, so this is not rated 5.
mapping.sourceName: Maxroll: Infernal Legion Acolyte of Chayula Build Guide (Shayd)

reviewedFacts.difficulty: Medium to High (melee leveling → respec around Lv56, and taming two companions with specified mods is required)
reviewedFacts.gearDependence: Centered on +levels to all minion skills (sceptre, helmet, amulet), securing Spirit, and the companion's maximum Life. No unique is mandatory, but cheap uniques grow it
reviewedFacts.operation: Low (mapping is zero-button. The weapon swap on zone entry and maintaining debuffs and Spearfield on bosses are needed)
reviewedFacts.ssfNote: Whether the build works in SSF is not stated in the source. The source says no unique is mandatory, but note that taming rare beasts with specified mods is assumed

sources.type: Japanese name and mechanics cross-check (can turn a rare beast into a companion while keeping its monster mods)

strengths: High damage. Into the Breach's added chaos damage reaches the 190% range at maximum, and combined with an "all damage can Ignite" companion, Ignite damage nearly triples (source).
Mapping is "zero-button". A constant radial DoT keeps occurring around the companion (source strength: Constant Radial DoT DPS).
The finished form's defense is very hard: about 10,000 ES, over 50% Evasion, and Chaos Inoculation gives full immunity to chaos damage, bleeding and poison (source strength: Very Tanky Endgame).
Bosses melt in seconds with Frost Bomb and Saitha's Spear's Spearfield (source summary).
No unique is mandatory for it to function. Cheap options such as Blackflame and Trenchtimbre can grow the early game (source).
weaknesses: Fragile early on (source weakness: Squishy Early Game). Leveling is melee Ice Strike, not minions, and Monk's Act 1 is especially rough.
Leveling is not a minion setup (source weakness: Non-Minion Leveling). Around Lv56, a respec of about 40,000 gold is required.

You must tame companions with specified mods (source weakness: Must Tame Specific Companion). A Plague Harvester (all damage can Ignite) and a Diretusk Boar (all damage can Shock) are the minimum requirement.
If you do not make the Weapon Set II snapshot on zone entry a habit, the Remnant pickup area stays narrow (source FAQ).
Whether the build works in SSF is not stated in the source.

warrior-shield-wall-warbringer.audience: Players who want to start a bold melee build that detonates fissures spread across the whole screen, on a low budget.

changeHistory.summary: Created a new draft (unpublished). Checked cArn_'s Maxroll guide text and embedded planner directly and cross-checked names and numbers against the Japanese poe2db. A separate setup from the existing Shield Wall Smith (Smith of Kitava), with a different ascendancy.

warrior-shield-wall-warbringer.difficulty: Switch to the main setup at Lv22. Involves managing Exertion on warcries and splitting passives by weapon set for warcry use.
gearPriorities: Shield: the highest-Armour one (Shield Wall's damage scales with the shield's Armour. The source FAQ states explicitly that weapon damage is irrelevant to its damage).
Chest: high Life and Armour. The "Armour also applies to elemental damage" mod has a large impact on durability.
Everywhere: secure resistances up to 75% and stack Life. Attack speed on gloves and desecrated skill speed on jewellery improve feel and clear speed. Thrillsteel is a candidate unique.

levelingStages.caution: Slow animations early on are a weakness in the source. Shield Wall is not available yet, so this is a stretch where you push through on two-handed mace damage.
levelingStages.gearPriority: A two-handed mace and armour pieces with Life / resistances / Armour. Save gold for the Lv22 transition and for gambling a shield.
levelingStages.label: Lv1–22 (two-handed mace leveling)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Rolling Slam and Boneshatter are the core. Perfect Strike for single target.
nowActions: Progress with Rolling Slam and Boneshatter on a two-handed mace until Lv22
Save gold for the transition cost and shield gambling
Take Answered Call with the first ascendancy
levelingStages.passivePriority: Take enough attributes to meet gear and gem requirements, and put the rest into Strength to grow Life. First ascendancy is Answered Call, which houses an ancestral spirit in your totems for buffs.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Upgrade the two-handed mace with whatever drops. The shield is not used until the Lv22 transition.
levelingStages.supports: Normal attack: Rapid Attacks II + Concentrated Area. Rolling Slam: Brink I. Boneshatter: Impact Shockwave + Magnified Area I. Perfect Strike: Window of Opportunity I + Rapid Attacks I. Infernal Cry: Tireless. Also use Herald of Ash. Setup from the source planner (Level 1-22).
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Reach Lv22 and secure a level 7 Uncut Skill Gem. Gamble a shield with gold and prepare a high-Armour shield.

levelingStages.caution: If mana is tight, one source of mana leech on a ring or gloves solves it. Do not level the Leap Slam / Infernal Cry / Shield Charge gems (instruction in the source FAQ).
levelingStages.gearPriority: Always look for the shield with the highest Armour. Weapon damage is irrelevant to your damage. Chest with Life and Armour; aim for 75% resistances.
levelingStages.label: Lv22–Campaign End (switch to Shield Wall)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Detonate Shield Wall's fissures with Fortifying Cry or Infernal Cry. Shockwave Totem provides supplementary damage.
nowActions: At Lv22, gamble a high-Armour shield and switch to Shield Wall
Once Fortifying Cry is available, switch to Warcaller's Bellow
Get used to the rotation of alternating Shield Wall and warcries
levelingStages.passivePriority: Once Fortifying Cry becomes available, switch from Answered Call to Warcaller's Bellow. Warcries lose their cooldown, so you can detonate fissures at any time, and nearby corpses also explode. Allocate Weapon Set 2 passives exclusively for warcries.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Replace the shield immediately whenever one with higher Armour appears. Swap the two-handed mace for a one-handed mace + shield.
levelingStages.supports: Shield Wall: Rapid Attacks I + Fire Infusion + Magnified Area I. Fortifying Cry: Brutality II + Raging Cry. Infernal Cry: Tireless + Raging Cry. Shockwave Totem: Urgent Totems I. Leap Slam / Shield Charge: Rapid Attacks I. In the late-campaign planner, Shield Wall gains Impale and supports are upgraded to higher tiers such as Magnified Area II.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Finish the campaign and have a clear path to obtaining the Ahn's Citadel and Kaom's Madness lineage supports.

levelingStages.caution: If single-target damage is lacking, the source FAQ's solution is to swap Ahn's Citadel and Kaom's Madness for Concentrated Area and Close Combat II, and use Sunder on enemies whose Armour is fully broken. Modest scaling in the very endgame is a weakness in the source.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Push the shield's Armour. Chest with Life + Armour + "Armour also applies to elemental damage". Attack speed on gloves, desecrated skill speed on jewellery. Thrillsteel as the unique.
levelingStages.label: Endgame (branching fissures with lineage supports)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Detonate the fissures of a Shield Wall branched by Ahn's Citadel and Kaom's Madness with Fortifying Cry / Infernal Cry / Sunder / movement skills.
nowActions: Obtain both lineage supports and branch the fissures
On bosses, fully break Armour before using Sunder
Keep updating the Armour of your shield and chest
levelingStages.passivePriority: With Anvil's Weight, make all damage break Armour, and with Imploding Impacts lower enemy Armour below 0. Finally, Jade Heritage grants additional physical damage reduction and a powerful guard skill.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Keep updating the shield and chest Armour while maintaining Life and resistances. Push gems to Lv20, 20% quality and 6 links.
levelingStages.supports: Shield Wall: Rapid Attacks II + Ahn's Citadel + Kaom's Madness + Heft + Rageforged II. Fortifying Cry: Raging Cry + Heavy Swing + Brutality III + Atalui's Bloodletting + Heft. Sunder: Rapid Attacks III + Rigwald's Ferocity + Rage III + Prolonged Duration II. War Banner: Daresso's Passion + Magnified Area II + Prolonged Duration II. Scavenged Plating and Tame Beast are also included in the source planner.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: The finished form. From here, refine the shield and chest Armour and max-roll each gear piece.

mainSkillTiming.available: Shield Wall is a Tier 7 gem requiring character Lv22, 41 Strength and a shield with Armour (poe2db). Higher-tier gems raise the requirements as well.
mainSkillTiming.guide: cArn_'s Maxroll guide (guide text and embedded planner checked directly)
mainSkillTiming.recommendedSwitch: In the source, obtain the level 7 gem at Lv22, gamble a high-Armour shield with gold, and then switch.

warrior-shield-wall-warbringer.name: Shield Wall Warbringer

beginner.note: The main skill, Shield Wall, is usable from Lv22, so the early condition is counted as a confirmed condition. Operation involves alternating Shield Wall with two warcries plus Exertion management and per-weapon-set passives, so the operation condition is not counted. Durability is counted because the source summary states the build is extremely tanky against elemental hits. SSF viability is not stated in the source.

earlyMainSkill.basis: Shield Wall is a Tier 7 gem requiring level 22 (poe2db). The source also spells out the procedure of obtaining the level 7 gem at Lv22 and switching.

noDodgeRequirement.basis: The source summary states "EXTREMELY tanky character impervious to elemental hits", and the design can take hits head-on thanks to Jade Heritage's additional physical reduction and guard.

boss.basis: Both a strength and a weakness
boss.note: The source FAQ has a dedicated entry on fixing insufficient single-target damage (swapping the lineage supports to Concentrated Area + Close Combat II, and using Sunder after fully breaking Armour), so as-is it leans toward a weakness. It works after the swap.
boss.sourceName: Maxroll: Shield Wall Warbringer Build Guide

damage.basis: Both a strength and a weakness
damage.note: Good damage and speed on a low budget is a strength, while modest scaling in the very endgame is stated as a weakness.
damage.sourceName: Maxroll: Shield Wall Warbringer Build Guide

defense.basis: Strength (emphasized)
defense.note: The summary calls it extremely tanky against elemental hits, built on gear with "Armour also applies to elemental damage" and Jade Heritage's additional physical reduction and guard.
defense.sourceName: Maxroll: Shield Wall Warbringer Build Guide

mapping.note: Fissures spread across the whole screen and can be detonated by any skill. Warcaller's Bellow making warcries explode corpses is listed as a strength.
mapping.sourceName: Maxroll: Shield Wall Warbringer Build Guide

reviewedFacts.difficulty: Medium to high (Exertion management on two warcries, Sunder timing, and per-weapon-set passives dedicated to warcries. The source notes that a simple rotation of alternating the warcries makes little difference).
reviewedFacts.gearDependence: Weapon damage is irrelevant; the shield's Armour is the key to damage. No unique is mandatory, and Thrillsteel takes you to the next stage.
reviewedFacts.operation: Frequent (the basics are alternating Shield Wall → warcry detonation. On bosses, use Sunder after fully breaking Armour, and War Banner once Glory is charged).
reviewedFacts.ssfNote: Whether the build works in SSF is not stated in the source (Maxroll).

Good damage and speed even on a low budget (source strength: Good damage and speed on low budget).

mercenary-supporting-fire-tactician.audience: Players who want to map comfortably, surrounded by a minion army while raining arrows over the whole screen.

changeHistory.summary: Created a new draft (unpublished). Checked Shayd's Maxroll guide text directly and cross-checked names against the Japanese poe2db.

mercenary-supporting-fire-tactician.difficulty: There is one respec of about 21,700 gold at Lv36, but after the transition it is a one-button playstyle of firing Supporting Fire on cooldown.
gearPriorities: Weapon (sceptre): "+ to Level of all Minion Skills" and Spirit. The finished form is a corrupted Chober Chaber with +4 to minion skills.
Armour: stack ES on helmet, gloves and boots. The finished form is Morior Invictus and Heroic Tragedy + Chaos Inoculation for over 10,000 ES.
Strength: directly tied to Supporting Fire's damage and to Life / ES, so stack it on all gear with priority. On the belt, also secure minion area-of-effect and command skill damage mods.

levelingStages.caution: The weapon set configuration (Permafrost Bolts on Set I, Fragmentation Rounds on Set II, Crossbow Shot shared by both sets) determines early comfort. When moving between Acts or zones, a reload is occasionally needed. Avoid gambling and expensive rare purchases during the campaign so you can secure the respec cost.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Check vendor crossbows and sceptres every few levels, and buy an Iron Ring in Act 1. Movement speed on boots is mandatory. At Lv16, craft a Varnished Crossbow with a Lesser Essence of Ice or an Orb of Alchemy and insert a Glacial Rune (this carries crossbow leveling to the end). "Added damage to attacks" (cold and physical ideally) on gloves, rings and the crossbow is the top priority; the rest is Life and elemental resistances. Also pick up helmets and sceptres with "+ to Level of all Minion Skills" for later use.
levelingStages.label: Lv1–Mid Act 2 (crossbow leveling)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Permafrost Bolts for packs. For single target, freeze first, then Fragmentation Rounds.
nowActions: Set up the weapon sets (Permafrost Bolts = Set I / Fragmentation Rounds = Set II)
At Lv16, craft a Varnished Crossbow and insert a Glacial Rune
Sell rares and save up for the respec cost (about 21,700 gold)
levelingStages.passivePriority: Keep crossbow nodes within an efficient range to hold down the respec cost. Rapid Reload and Adrenaline Rush help early on.
levelingStages.replaceGear: The Lv16 Varnished Crossbow is effectively the final upgrade. Update flasks every 10–15 levels.
levelingStages.supports: Permafrost Bolts is the main skill, Frost Bomb lowers elemental resistances, and Herald of Ice raises clear speed. On bosses, apply Freezing Mark, then use Fragmentation Rounds. See the source planner for the exact support slots.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Take Unleash Hell! in mid Act 2 and unlock Supporting Fire. However, wait until Lv36 for the full transition.

levelingStages.caution: As a rule, field one of each minion type; only Skeletal Sniper is used at 2–3, depending on Spirit, as single-target support. The minions' own damage does not matter (except the early sniper), and you still gain Muster's bonus even if they die.
levelingStages.gearPriority: "+ to Level of all Minion Skills" is the top priority, secured on sceptre, helmet and amulet (it grows both minion damage and durability). Strength also ties directly to damage and Life. A Shrine Sceptre grants Purity of Fire, letting you use Upwelling I and Clarity I for free, making it the early best choice.
levelingStages.label: Lv36–Campaign End (switch to Supporting Fire)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Use Supporting Fire on cooldown. Line up one of each minion type for Muster.
nowActions: Respec at Lv36 using about 21,700 gold
Engrave Supporting Fire's required supports (Fire Attunement / Multishot II / Bidding I / Muster) first
Line up one of each minion type (2–3 snipers)
levelingStages.passivePriority: Respec at Lv36. Growing Swarm and command skill cooldown recovery are the top priorities. Take Archon of Undeath, Lord of Horrors, At Your Command, Puppet Master and Gigantic Following. Put spare attribute points into Strength first.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Fully replace crossbow-oriented gear with minion skill level and Strength gear.
levelingStages.supports: Supporting Fire: Fire Attunement, Multishot II, Bidding I and Muster are the required slots at the transition (per the source's gem engraving priority). For single target, ignite the Skeletal Sniper's command skill (Gas Arrow) with Fire Attunement. Sceptre auras prioritize Upwelling II and Clarity II. Debuffs are Elemental Weakness and Frost Bomb.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Campaign finished, and the purchase funds (Exalted Orbs) for Enfolding Dawn are secured.

levelingStages.caution: If Supporting Fire is on cooldown at the moment you gain Archon of Undeath, the cooldown is not shortened retroactively. Trigger the Archon first with the Skeletal Arsonist's command, then fire.
levelingStages.gearPriority: The first purchase is Enfolding Dawn; save Exalted Orbs and buy it right away (upgrading it with forging greatly grows Armour and ES). Next, Meginord's Girdle gives a large amount of Strength and cold resistance.
levelingStages.label: Early Maps
levelingStages.mainSkill: Supporting Fire handles clear, and the Skeletal Arsonist's command skill cycles Archon of Undeath and Puppet Master.
nowActions: Buy the Spirit-securing unique chest with top priority
Buy Meginord's Girdle next
Maintain Puppet Master with the Skeletal Arsonist's command
levelingStages.passivePriority: Assemble the nodes related to Archon of Undeath. Once assembled, single-target damage shifts to Supporting Fire and you can reduce Skeletal Snipers.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Purchase in the order Enfolding Dawn → Meginord's Girdle.
levelingStages.supports: For Supporting Fire's Bidding, choose Bidding II for a single-target lean or Bidding III for stable clear, to taste. Skeletal Brute breaks Armour with Armour Break III and also handles intimidation on bosses.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Reach Red Maps, with funds to upgrade to Trenchtimbre or an Omen Sceptre.

levelingStages.caution: Use Infernal Legion I, not II, on Wolf Pack. Also, do not add Last Gasp to the Essence Harvest combination, or the harvest stops working.
levelingStages.gearPriority: A +2 Trenchtimbre (once shield resistances are no longer needed). The Omen Sceptre is the best base, and Malice greatly grows single-target damage. Secure regeneration with Emergent Instinct and stabilize mana recovery with Lavianga's Spirits. On the belt, "increased minion area of effect" and "minions deal increased damage with command skills" are mandatory-class mods.
levelingStages.label: Red Maps
levelingStages.mainSkill: Supporting Fire handles both clear and bosses. Apply Predator's Mark and Cold Exposure with Pounce.
nowActions: Aim for a buckler with +2 to Level of all Minion Skills
Switch to an Omen Sceptre and use Malice
Switch to applying Predator's Mark and Exposure with Pounce
levelingStages.passivePriority: With Resurging Archon, remove Skeletal Sniper completely and unify both clear and single target on Supporting Fire. Add Despair with Whispers of Doom. Necrotic Touch and Grip of Evil pair well with Malice. Licking Wounds raises Life and mana recovery.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Once the amulet and chest provide enough Spirit, graduate from Enfolding Dawn.
levelingStages.supports: Kurgal's Leash gives Supporting Fire Unholy Might (30% of physical damage gained as chaos). Grow chaos damage with Withering Presence, and defensively layer Blasphemy + Temporal Chains, later adding Despair. Mana recovery comes from Wolf Pack's Infernal Legion I + Essence Harvest.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Secure an amulet that can be instilled with Dominion, and Heroic Tragedy (Vorana inscription).

levelingStages.caution: Heroic Tragedy must have the "Vorana" inscription (rolls do not matter). If you do not have a Megalomaniac with Growing Swarm, go take Growing Swarm by the normal path.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Maximize ES on helmet, gloves and boots. Chober Chaber is a strict upgrade over Trenchtimbre; aim for a corrupted +4 to all minion skills one requiring 80–85 Intelligence. Morior Invictus requires all elemental resistances and all attributes, with reduced damage taken from critical strikes as the best third slot. Put Gigantic Following on the helmet with a Raven-Touched Shard, and another instillation on the gloves with Cadigan's Epiphany.
levelingStages.label: Endgame (CI, Dominion obtained)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Stacked shots of Supporting Fire. Maintain Archon of Undeath almost permanently, handling both clear and bosses with this alone.
nowActions: Instill Dominion on the amulet
Move to Heroic Tragedy (Vorana inscription) + Chaos Inoculation
Aim for a +4 corrupted Chober Chaber
levelingStages.passivePriority: Instilling Dominion is the top priority (Archon of Undeath's recovery period disappears, so it can be maintained almost permanently). Heroic Tragedy's Black Scythe Training converts Strength into ES, and combined with Chaos Inoculation you aim for over 10,000 ES. Hold Chober Chaber in one hand with Giant's Blood.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Fully replace Life mods with ES. At Min-Max, even Mageblood and Jiquani's Thesis come into view.
levelingStages.supports: Vorana's Siege grows area and damage against isolated enemies. Uul-Netol's Embrace is a powerful lineage support that gains 40% of physical damage as chaos (an expensive Min-Max slot). On the minion side, finish with Amanamu's Tithe, Tecrod's Revenge, Brutus' Brain and Her Declaration.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: The finished form. From here, refine jewel mods (maximum ES, ES recharge start speed, minion critical mods) and max-roll each gear piece.

mainSkillTiming.available: Supporting Fire is the Tactician's ascendancy skill, granted by Unleash Hell! and unlocked in mid Act 2 (source / poe2db). It scales with +1% damage per 1 Strength and +1% area of effect per 3 Dexterity.
mainSkillTiming.guide: Shayd's Maxroll guide (guide text checked directly)
mainSkillTiming.recommendedSwitch: At Lv36, Supporting Fire's third support socket opens and the command skill cooldown recovery nodes are also in place, so respec for about 21,700 gold and transition (source FAQ). Additional sockets open at Lv65 (fourth) and Lv90 (fifth).

mercenary-supporting-fire-tactician.name: Supporting Fire Tactician

beginner.note: The main skill, Supporting Fire, is an ascendancy skill and cannot be used until mid Act 2, so the early condition is not counted as a confirmed condition. After the transition, play centers on one button, and the ranged attacks plus the minion shield keep the dodging requirement low, so two conditions are counted. SSF viability is not stated in the source.

moderateOperation.basis: The source's strengths state "1 Button Build". After the transition, play centers on firing Supporting Fire on cooldown.

noDodgeRequirement.basis: A ranged attack with a base area of effect of 14m, with a minion army surrounding you as a shield. The source describes a "very comfy, laid back playstyle" and does not assume dodge play.

boss.note: With Dominion, Archon of Undeath is maintained almost permanently, and bosses are ground down with stacked Supporting Fire shots (per the source's passive explanation). Single-target damage is not stated in the strengths list, so this stays at 4.
boss.sourceName: Maxroll: Supporting Fire Tactician Build Guide

damage.note: Strength directly grows Supporting Fire's damage, stacked with Muster and Archon of Undeath's 25% more. The strengths' wording centers on clear, so this stays at 4.
damage.sourceName: Maxroll: Supporting Fire Tactician Build Guide

defense.basis: Strength (emphasized)
defense.note: Strength ties directly to Life and ES, and the finished form reaches over 10,000 ES with Heroic Tragedy + Chaos Inoculation. Stay Light, Use Cover also raises the efficiency of low Armour and Evasion.
defense.sourceName: Maxroll: Supporting Fire Tactician Build Guide

mapping.note: A rain of arrows with a base area of effect of 14m can process enemies before they are visible. Outstanding clear speed is listed among the source's strengths.
mapping.sourceName: Maxroll: Supporting Fire Tactician Build Guide

reviewedFacts.difficulty: Medium (there is a respec of about 21,700 gold at Lv36 and the effort of crossbow leveling early on, but operation after the transition centers on one button).
reviewedFacts.gearDependence: Centered on "+ to Level of all Minion Skills" on sceptre, helmet and amulet, plus Strength. In the finished form, Chober Chaber and Morior Invictus are the big room to grow.
reviewedFacts.operation: Low (fire Supporting Fire on cooldown, and maintain Archon of Undeath and Puppet Master with command skills).
reviewedFacts.ssfNote: Whether the build works in SSF is not stated in the source (Maxroll). The source states it "functions without uniques", but that is not an SSF statement, so it is treated as unconfirmed.
