strengths: Supporting Fire's base area of effect is a wide 14m, and pack clear is extremely fast (source strength: Phenomenal Clear).
After the transition, a one-button playstyle of firing Supporting Fire on cooldown (source strength: 1 Button Build).
A single stat, Strength, grows both offense (Supporting Fire's damage) and defense (Life / ES) at once (source strength: Scales Offense + Defense with One Stat).
The source calls it an excellent league starter, and it is also placed in A Tier in Maxroll's League Starter Tier List (source strength: Amazing League Starter).
The finished form reaches over 10,000 ES with Heroic Tragedy and Chaos Inoculation (per the source's gear explanation).
weaknesses: You must level with a crossbow early on, and the signature skill Supporting Fire cannot be used until mid Act 2 (source weakness: Have To Play Crossbows Early On).
A respec cost of about 21,700 gold applies at Lv36.
Because you field many minions, gear needs minion mods such as minion skill levels (source weakness: Minion Tax on Gear).
Suffix pressure is severe in Endgame (source weakness: Suffix Pressure Endgame).

ranger-glacial-lance-deadeye.audience: Players who want to map at high speed alongside mirages while freezing the whole screen.

changeHistory.summary: Created a new draft (unpublished). Checked aer0's Maxroll guide text directly and cross-checked names and numbers against the Japanese poe2db. Confirmed the A Tier placement in Maxroll's League Starter Tier List.

ranger-glacial-lance-deadeye.difficulty: Twister leveling until the first trial in Act 2. After the transition, there is timing management for the two mirages and Barrage.
gearPriorities: Spear: added physical and cold damage and attack speed. Update every 5–10 levels; the finished form is a crafted Akoyan Spear.
Sceptre: right after reaching maps, the base for socketing the Idol of Eramir. Together with the amulet, secure 240 Spirit.
Armour: Evasion, ES and Deflect. The helmet is pure ES (for Subterfuge Mask). Rings and gloves take added damage.

levelingStages.caution: If you leave Whirling Slash's whirlwind and fire Twister, the whirlwind collapses and you lose the added damage. Always fire from inside the whirlwind.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Life and resistances on most slots. Large added damage on rings, spear and gloves (any element). Update the spear every 5–10 levels, prioritizing physical and cold damage and attack speed suffixes.
levelingStages.label: Act 1 (Twister leveling)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Twister + Whirling Slash. On bosses, Parry → Fangs of Frost to create chilled ground, then attack.
nowActions: Keep Whirling Slash at Lv1
Fire Twister from inside the whirlwind
Update the spear every 5–10 levels
levelingStages.passivePriority: Push damage first early on. Critical is hard to scale, so leave it for later (source). See the source for the per-stage tree.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Update the spear with top priority. Also review rings and gloves with no added damage.
levelingStages.supports: Frost Nexus generates chilled ground. Keep Whirling Slash fixed at Lv1 to save mana (source). War Banner is also used for single target.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Act 2 begins. Barrage and Ice-Tipped Arrows can be prepared.

levelingStages.caution: Parry and Fangs of Frost can be removed at the start of Act 2 (source). Do not move to Glacial Lance until the first trial is finished.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Continue updating the spear. Maintain Life and resistances.
levelingStages.label: Early Act 2 – First Trial (continue Twister)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Continue Twister. Barrage consumes Frenzy Charges to add projectiles, and Ice-Tipped Arrows is used on cooldown.
nowActions: Add Barrage and Ice-Tipped Arrows
Use Freezing Mark on tough enemies
Clear the first trial
levelingStages.passivePriority: Continue damage first, and do not lean into critical yet (source).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Prioritize reviewing a spear whose damage has stalled and armour pieces with low resistances.
levelingStages.supports: Ice-Tipped Arrows' ice shards speed up pack clear, so Whirling Slash is used less often. Use Freezing Mark on tough rares and bosses, and Charged Mark also applies shocked ground.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Clear the first trial, making Glacial Lance (Tier 7, from Lv22) and the Mirage Deadeye ascendancy available.

levelingStages.caution: Pounce requires a talisman in Weapon Set 2's off-hand. Use both mirages on cooldown.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Sceptre: a Shrine Sceptre (resistances) or an Omen Sceptre (boss critical chance). Attack speed and damage on the Weapon Set 2 talisman also grow Pounce and Arctic Howl (lower priority). Fill attribute and resistance shortfalls with runes.
levelingStages.label: After the First Trial – Campaign End (switch to Glacial Lance)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Glacial Lance. Attacks summon Mirage Deadeye, and dodge rolls summon Mirage Archer.
nowActions: Switch to Glacial Lance after the first trial
Prepare a Tier 8 Spirit gem and enable Mirage Archer
On bosses, use Pounce → Arctic Howl in that order
levelingStages.passivePriority: Ascendancy order: Mirage Deadeye → Gathering Winds → Called Shots → Avidity (source). The tree continues damage first.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Continue updating the spear. If Spirit is short, secure it with the sceptre and amulet.
levelingStages.supports: Mirage Archer requires a Tier 8 Spirit gem (poe2db; the source writes Tier 7+). In boss fights, place War Banner, apply Freezing Mark with Pounce, and once freeze is primed, freeze with Arctic Howl and trigger Raging Cry. Fire Barrage with Combat Frenzy's Frenzy Charges.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Campaign finished. Glacial Lance and both mirages are operated stably.

levelingStages.caution: Using Barrage with Olroth's Conviction requires Ward on gear, with a total of 1.5–2× the cost as the guideline (source FAQ). Instilling Thaumaturgic Generator is expensive, so do not put it on an amulet you will replace soon.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Right after reaching maps, the top damage priority is the Idol of Eramir socketed into the sceptre (charge generation effectively doubles). Stack Evasion, ES and Deflect on chest, gloves, boots and helmet, and make the helmet pure ES (preparation for Subterfuge Mask). Prepare Valako's Roar charm early as well. Secure a total of 240 Spirit from the amulet and sceptre.
levelingStages.label: Early Maps
levelingStages.mainSkill: Glacial Lance + both mirages. Mana Remnants recover mana and speed up mirage re-summoning.
nowActions: Socket the Idol of Eramir into the sceptre
Secure 240 Spirit from the amulet and sceptre
Make the helmet pure ES in preparation for Subterfuge Mask
levelingStages.passivePriority: Prioritize Frenzy Charge nodes until the Idol of Eramir is socketed into the sceptre. Critical comes after a good spear is crafted (source).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Do not socket an expensive Idol of Eramir into a bad sceptre. Choose the sceptre that receives the idol carefully.
levelingStages.supports: Adding Khatal's Rejuvenation to Mana Remnants makes it easier to maintain 40% cooldown recovery speed. War Banner can gain Deflect with Refraction II (requires 10 additional Spirit). Ghost Dance also recovers ES based on Evasion (per the source's introduction).
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Low-Tier maps can be run stably, and the Idol of Eramir and 240 Spirit are in place.

levelingStages.caution: Critical assumes weapon quality. Do not lean into critical nodes while you have no good spear.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Pick up an Akoyan Spear that drops at area Lv78, create two good mods with Transmutation and Augmentation Orbs, and make it 4-mod with an essence and a Preserved Jawbone. The Sacred Flame sceptre is a big gain. Overflow mana with Uhtred's Chalice and Mana Remnants.
levelingStages.label: Endgame
levelingStages.mainSkill: Glacial Lance + Barrage. The stage where you scale with critical.
nowActions: Pick up and craft an Akoyan Spear at area Lv78
Aim for a Sacred Flame sceptre
Check the transition conditions for Guiding Palm of the Eye (40 Spirit on the amulet)
levelingStages.passivePriority: Once a good spear with a critical strike chance roll is crafted, take all the critical nodes. Take Subterfuge Mask only after a good ES helmet is crafted (source).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Compare the spear's critical strike chance roll with top priority. The finished belt is pursued in the next stage.
levelingStages.supports: Adding Olroth's Conviction to Barrage lets you use it 3 times, making it effectively always available (Ward required). Moving from a Shrine Sceptre with Purity of Ice to Guiding Palm of the Eye lets you socket Vitality II and Cannibalism II for free.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: The Akoyan Spear craft progresses and the critical setup is stable.

levelingStages.caution: The Aspirational tree assumes multiple jewels and includes Controlled Metamorphosis, which lowers resistances. Do not lean into it before gear is in place.
levelingStages.gearPriority: The belt reaches its full value with Mageblood, and Headhunter is also usable. Stack movement speed, attack speed and Evasion heavily.
levelingStages.label: Endgame (Aspirational)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Glacial Lance. High-speed mapping, firing continuously while moving.
nowActions: Aim for the finished form's unique belt
Check the Aspirational tree's jewel prerequisites
If adopting Rakiata's Flow, remove elemental penetration
levelingStages.passivePriority: The source's Aspirational tree. Hail assumes Barrage and Olroth's Conviction. Take Crimson Assault via Controlled Metamorphosis, a Time-Lost Emerald and From Nothing. On the assumption of using Rakiata's Flow, remove all investment into elemental penetration. Put spare attributes into Strength (Life).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Not by fixed price; update one slot at a time by the performance difference against your current gear.
levelingStages.supports: Combining Rite of Passage with Spirit of the Wolf lets all damage break Armour, and spreads Herald of Ice and Armour Explosion. The Fall of the Axe grants slow prevention and Onslaught.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Once finished, improve the bottlenecks among spear, charge generation and defense one item at a time.

mainSkillTiming.available: Glacial Lance is a Tier 7 spear skill requiring level 22 (poe2db Tier 7; matches the site's verified same-tier conversion). The source is structured to switch not by level but after clearing the first trial in Act 2.
mainSkillTiming.guide: aer0's Maxroll guide (guide text checked directly)
mainSkillTiming.recommendedSwitch: Switch after obtaining the ascendancy (Mirage Deadeye) in the first trial. Enabling Mirage Archer requires a Tier 8 Spirit gem (poe2db; the source writes Tier 7+).

ranger-glacial-lance-deadeye.name: Glacial Lance Deadeye

beginner.note: The main skill Glacial Lance is usable from Lv22 as a Tier 7 gem, so the early condition under the beginner standard (Lv22 or below) is counted as a confirmed condition. Operation is also counted because the source summary states explicitly "only a few buttons; one-button mapping is smooth and easy". However, Mirage Archer is summoned by dodge roll, so dodge operation is built into the rotation and the dodge condition is not counted. SSF viability is not stated in the source ("functions without uniques" is not an SSF statement).

earlyMainSkill.basis: Glacial Lance is a Tier 7 gem (poe2db). Tier 7's required level 22 matches the site's verified same-tier conversion (Shield Wall and others).

moderateOperation.basis: Maxroll's summary states explicitly "only has a few total buttons. One button mapping is smooth and easy".

boss.note: Good boss damage is among the strengths. The summary also says large bosses can be brought down with Barrage's rapid fire.
boss.sourceName: Maxroll: Glacial Lance Deadeye Build Guide

damage.note: Good boss damage is among the strengths. The introduction also highlights large cold damage.
damage.sourceName: Maxroll: Glacial Lance Deadeye Build Guide

defense.basis: Both a strength and a weakness
defense.note: There are layers of full-screen freeze, Evasion, Deflect and ES, while the weaknesses state explicitly that it is not designed to keep taking boss attacks head-on.
defense.sourceName: Maxroll: Glacial Lance Deadeye Build Guide

mapping.note: Clear speed and full-screen freezes are emphasized in the strengths.
mapping.sourceName: Maxroll: Glacial Lance Deadeye Build Guide

reviewedFacts.difficulty: Medium (the source summary says "only a few buttons; one-button mapping is smooth", while boss fights have the procedure War Banner placement → Pounce → Arctic Howl).
reviewedFacts.gearDependence: Centered on the spear's update frequency and quality. Right after reaching maps, the Idol of Eramir socketed into the sceptre is the top damage priority, and the finished form is a crafted Akoyan Spear and a Mageblood-class belt.
reviewedFacts.operation: Mapping centers on Glacial Lance and dodge rolls. Boss fights have more steps.
reviewedFacts.ssfNote: The source (Maxroll) states it "functions without uniques", but does not state whether it works in SSF. It also contains trade-assuming descriptions such as buying the Idol of Eramir and instillations on amulets, so it is not treated as SSF-confirmed.

sources.type: Japanese skill data (Tier 7, converts 80% of physical to cold, shards explode when a Frenzy Charge is consumed)

sources.type: Game data (per-Tier gem list for spears: Twister / Whirling Slash are Tier 1, Fangs of Frost is Tier 3, Barrage is Tier 5, Glacial Lance is Tier 7)

strengths: You can clear while freezing the whole screen, with fast clear speed (source strengths: Great Clear Speed / Full Screen Freezes).
Mirage Deadeye and Mirage Archer help with both clear and single-target attacks (per the source's introduction and summary).
Single-target damage is also good, and large bosses can be brought down with Barrage's rapid fire (source strength: Good Boss Damage).
It functions without uniques, and you can play safely behind defensive layers of freeze, Evasion, Deflect and ES (per the source's introduction and its summary, "safe and fast league starter").
weaknesses: It is not designed to keep taking boss attacks head-on (source weakness: Not Made To Facetank Bosses).
Deep Endgame needs gear (source weakness: Needs Some Gear for Deep Endgame). The Idol of Eramir and Thaumaturgic Generator instillations tend to be expensive.
The signature Glacial Lance is a Tier 7 gem, from Lv22. You level with Twister until the first trial in Act 2.
Running Barrage with Olroth's Conviction requires Ward on gear, and it stalls if you do not meet the guideline of 1.5–2× the cost (source FAQ).

monk-lightning-minion-chayula.audience: Players who like letting a minion army do the fighting while they focus on debuffs and support. From the Mid setup onward it runs on few buttons

changeHistory.summary: Created a new draft (unpublished). Checked Helm Breaker's Maxroll guide text directly and cross-checked names and mechanics against the Japanese poe2db. No mirror or summary sites were used. The ascendancy's official Japanese name is "Acolyte of Chayula". leagueStarter was set to true because the A Tier placement in Maxroll's League Starter Tier List was confirmed directly.

monk-lightning-minion-chayula.difficulty: Acts 1–3 start with non-minion crossbow / grenade leveling, and late in Act 3 (around Lv41–43) a respec of about 35,000 gold is required. Spectres have different variants under the same name, so you need to identify the right type
gearPriorities: +levels to all minion skills: secure it on the sceptre, helmet and amulet. The top-priority stat, growing both minion damage and durability (source).
Spirit: decides how many Spectres you can have. Alpha's Howl grows it greatly, and also doubles the Presence radius when using Selfless Remnants (source).
Bones of Ullr: obtain it prioritizing reservation efficiency to increase the number of minions you can summon (source).
Defense: stack ES and Evasion on the chest and gloves. Having Deflect on both is strongly recommended (source).
Enfolding Dawn: runeforging it is considered the best defensive option (source).
Jewels: on Sapphires, prioritize increased maximum ES, minions' all elemental resistances, minion attack / cast speed, and increased minion damage (source).

levelingStages.caution: This stage is not a minion setup (source weakness: Non-Minion leveling in Act 1-3). The source says Evasion-only armor makes the early game feel rough. Pick up rares, identify them, then sell them to secure gold for the transition.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Prioritize a crossbow with high flat physical and lightning damage, and switch to a Bombard Crossbow early in Act 3. Armor: maximum Life and resistances; Armour or Armour / Evasion bases are easier to progress on. If you see a helmet, amulet or sceptre with +1 minion skills for after the transition, secure it (source).
levelingStages.label: Lv1–End of Act 3 (crossbow / grenade leveling)
levelingStages.mainSkill: For the first few levels, progress with Quarterstaff Strike, Falling Thunder and Killing Palm. Once you pick up a Makeshift Crossbow or buy one from Renly in Clearfell, Explosive Grenade becomes the main skill. Flash Grenade covers both pack clearing and boss stuns, and while both are on cooldown you fill in with Crossbow Shot
nowActions: Pick up a crossbow and switch to grenade leveling
Secure movement speed and resistances on your boots
Secure gear with +minion skills when you see it
levelingStages.passivePriority: Grow grenade damage with Concussive Attack, Dizzying Sweep, Killer Instinct, Blinding Strike and Kite Runner (source).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Update flasks to the newest ones every 10–15 levels (source). Killing The King in the Mists makes War Banner usable; after defeating the witch in The Azak Bog, switch to Wolf Pack. Apply Exposure with Frost Bomb and curse with Elemental Weakness (source).
levelingStages.supports: Multishot I and Short Fuse I on Explosive Grenade. Putting Lightning Attunement on Flash Grenade grows its damage and also applies Shock. Use the first Lesser Jeweller's Orb on Explosive Grenade, the second on Flash Grenade, and save the rest for the minion setup (source).
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Reach Utzaal late in Act 3 and become able to bind a Vaal Guard Spectre (around Lv41–43).

levelingStages.caution: There are three different variants of Vaal Guard under the same name (melee type = 50 Spirit, ranged type = 60 Spirit, bomb type = 50 Spirit). Bind the type that throws bombs. The source also warns this Spectre can cause performance problems. Right after the respec there is a stretch where damage is lower than grenade leveling (source).
levelingStages.gearPriority: +levels to all minion skills is the top priority (sceptre, helmet, amulet). The sceptre mod "allies in your Presence gain added damage to attacks" scales multiplicatively with Choice of Power and Waking Dream, so its growth is large. Increase summon counts with additional Spirit on the chest and amulet (source).
levelingStages.label: Around Lv41–43, Late Act 3–Campaign End (minion transition)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Bind the bomb-type Vaal Guard with Bind Spectre and transition to the minion setup. Spam Flame Wall to bring out Raging Spirits, and protect them with Wolf Pack and Loyalty. Spend leftover Spirit on a Skeletal Storm Mage or Skeletal Sniper to supplement the Muster effect and Shock application (source)
nowActions: Bind a Vaal Guard (bomb type)
Respec your passives for about 35,000 gold
Maintain Raging Spirits with Flame Wall
levelingStages.passivePriority: Respec into minion specialization for about 35,000 gold. The core is Relentless Fallen, Lord of Horrors, Remnant Attraction and Empowering Remnants, Right Hand of Darkness, Necrotised Flesh and Crystalline Flesh, Vile Mending, and Profane Commander. The ascendancy order is Waking Dream → Choice of Power (source).
levelingStages.replaceGear: If you obtain Enfolding Dawn and Bones of Ullr, use them. The Lv36 Soul Mantle is also a defensive option, but runeforging Enfolding Dawn is considered best. A Trenchtimbre with +2 minion skills is also a candidate as hand-me-down leveling gear (source).
levelingStages.supports: Cut Loyalty, Minion Splash I, Last Gasp, Arcane Surge and Selfless Remnants with leftover Uncut Support Gems. Use Flame Wall at a low level (Lv5) to keep its Mana cost down. If you obtain a Greater Jeweller's Orb, there is also the option of replacing the Vaal Guard with a Skeletal Reaver (source).
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Finish the campaign, enter mapping, and become able to switch to Powered Zealot / Chaos Zealot Spectres.

levelingStages.caution: Powered Zealots / Chaos Zealots also have different variants under the same name. They cost 55 Spirit; let them attack a few times to confirm they fire the big blue lightning orbs (Spark) before binding. Maintaining Wardbound Minions requires about 100 Ward, and the gem level should be at most 16, preferably low (source).
levelingStages.gearPriority: Obtain Alpha's Howl. Spirit grows greatly, and the Presence radius when using Selfless Remnants + Waking Dream doubles. If it is expensive, substitute a helmet with +2 minion skills. For Bones of Ullr, prioritize reservation efficiency and movement speed. Runeforge Enfolding Dawn (source).
levelingStages.label: Early Mapping (Spark Spectres)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Replace the Vaal Guard with a Powered Zealot or Chaos Zealot Spectre that fires Spark. Powered Zealots are found in maps, and Chaos Zealots can be found in the Trial of Chaos. You support the army with Pain Offering and Despair (source)
nowActions: Bind a Powered Zealot (55 Spirit, Spark type)
Obtain Alpha's Howl
Secure about 100 Ward and run Wardbound Minions
levelingStages.passivePriority: Grow ES and Evasion with Enhanced Barrier, Mindful Awareness and Spectral Ward, and reduce minions' Spirit reservation with The Soul Meridian. The amulet instill is Essence Infusion (source).
levelingStages.replaceGear: A Rattling Sceptre is the best sceptre, but with a Shrine Sceptre you can use Upwelling II, Strong Hearted, Cool Headed and Vitality II at no additional Spirit cost. Maximize ES on gloves. For resistance adjustments, use Blazing Flux, Chilling Flux, Crackling Flux and Void Flux (source).
levelingStages.supports: As a prerequisite for the switch, cut Wildshards II and Pierce III first. Use the first Perfect Jeweller's Orb on Bind Spectre. Replace the Skeletal Storm Mage with Wardbound Minions and combine it with Warding Rune of Bodyguards to grant minions Onslaught. Also secure Refutation (source).
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Graduate from Flame Wall and Raging Spirits, and transition to the Mid setup (Skeletal Storm Mage + Convalescence).

levelingStages.caution: From this stage it becomes tanky, but as the source's weaknesses state, it is not recommended for HC. Maintaining Wardbound Minions requires securing about 100 Ward through runeforging Bones of Ullr and the gloves (or a Prism Guardian if that is not enough) (source).
levelingStages.gearPriority: Extend Spirit with a Prism Guardian. Update Alpha's Howl to a corrupted version with "+1 to all minion skill levels". Once Spirit exceeds 450, insert Amanamu's Gaze into Bones of Ullr to grow movement speed. Also prepare a Lavianga's Spirits Mana flask (source).
levelingStages.label: Mid (army complete)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Replace Flame Wall and Raging Spirits with Skeletal Storm Mage and Convalescence. Load Despair onto Blasphemy to turn it into a curse aura, and strengthen the army with Pain Offering. This is the polished stretch where the source's strengths include "Tanky (In the Mid setup)" and "Few buttons in the Mid setup" (source)
nowActions: Turn the curse into an aura with Blasphemy + Despair
Obtain a Prism Guardian
Solidify defense with Heavy Buffer + Mind Over Matter
levelingStages.passivePriority: Use Heavy Buffer and Mind Over Matter to use Mana as a defensive layer. Inner Faith and The Hollowkeeper reduce curse effect on you by 75%. Swap the campaign flask rewards to Mana flask upgrades. The amulet instill is Warlord Leader (source).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Choose chest and gloves bases with high ES and Evasion; having Deflect on both is strongly recommended. Put Warding Rune of Bodyguards in the sceptre, a Primate Idol in the second socket, and a Talisman of Ralakesh in the helmet (source).
levelingStages.supports: Swap Pain Offering's support from Meat Shield II to Brutus' Brain. Put Romira's Requital and Tecrod's Revenge on Wolf Pack (source).
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Secure +55% or more minion cast speed and advance to the Late setup (the switch to Vilenta's Propulsion).

levelingStages.caution: If you switch to Vilenta's Propulsion before meeting the +55% cast speed condition, damage drops. Check the condition first (source).
levelingStages.gearPriority: The most important is the rare belt mod "chance for minions to fire an additional projectile (Surpassing)". Use a high-ES focus with +2 minion skill levels. Put Cadigan's Epiphany in the gloves. Alpha's Howl can also aim for a double-corrupted version (+20–30 Spirit, or an additional socket) (source).
levelingStages.label: Late
levelingStages.mainSkill: Once minion cast speed reaches +55% or more, replace Projectile Acceleration II with Vilenta's Propulsion. Put Uhtred's Constellation on Convalescence (source)
nowActions: Secure the rare belt's additional minion projectile mod
Obtain a high-ES focus with +2 minion skill levels
Confirm +55% cast speed, then switch to Vilenta's Propulsion
levelingStages.passivePriority: Keep the amulet instill at Warlord Leader. Add minion critical stats and faster ES recharge start to Sapphire jewels (source).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Replace both rings with ones carrying minion mods (minion damage, attack / cast speed, minion resistances) (source).
levelingStages.supports: Removing Blasphemy and self-casting Despair grows damage for pinnacle bosses and lets you add 2–3 more Spectres (source FAQ). In that case, put Heightened Curse and similar on Despair.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: The amulet instill changes to Zarokh's Gift, and the Min-Max setup gear such as Sacrificial Regalia comes together.

levelingStages.caution: The source warns that if you do not snapshot with the snapshot tree, you lose about 50% of your total damage. If you will not do it, stay on the regular tree. The fourth ascendancy is stated in the source to be "completely useless", so there is no need to hurry it (source).
levelingStages.gearPriority: If Sacrificial Regalia comes together with the right mods, it is the best chest. The finished Alpha's Howl is 2 sockets + Legacy of Greymake, either corrupted with "+1 to all minion skill levels" or double-corrupted with +25–30 Spirit. A Mageblood is also an option instead of the rare belt (source).
levelingStages.label: Min-Max (finished form)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Replace Wolf Pack with Ghost Dance or a Skeletal Sniper to optimize Spirit. Put Khatal's Rejuvenation on Into the Breach (can be omitted if expensive). Using the Remnant snapshot (entering with Weapon Set II) grows damage a further 20–30%, but it is an advanced optimization the source calls completely optional (source)
nowActions: Change the instill to Zarokh's Gift
Aim for an Alpha's Howl with Legacy of Greymake
Replace Wolf Pack with Ghost Dance or a Skeletal Sniper
levelingStages.passivePriority: The amulet instill is Zarokh's Gift. If you obtain a Megalomaniac with Right Hand of Darkness, respec the pathing toward it (source).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Replace the Amanamu's Gaze in Bones of Ullr with Farrul's Rune of the Chase, and secure movement speed with the Quicksilver-type effect of Legacy of Greymake (source).
levelingStages.supports: Replace the Powered Zealot / Chaos Zealot's Feeding Frenzy II with Dialla's Desire, and the Skeletal Storm Mage's Lightning Attunement with Esh's Radiance. Put Atziri's Communion on Blasphemy or Convalescence (source).
levelingStages.transitionCondition: The finished form. From here, rerolling jewels and corruptions is the focus.

monk-lightning-minion-chayula.mainSkill: A minion army setup whose main force is Spectres bound with Bind Spectre. Late in the campaign it is bomb-type Vaal Guards; from mapping, Powered Zealot / Chaos Zealot Spectres firing Spark carry the damage, and Waking Dream's purple flames are transferred to the minions with Selfless Remnants to stack added chaos damage

mainSkillTiming.available: The main minion setup cannot be used until late Act 3. Acts 1–3 progress on crossbow leveling with Explosive Grenade and Flash Grenade, and after reaching Utzaal (around Lv41–43) you bind a bomb-type Vaal Guard with Bind Spectre and then transition
mainSkillTiming.guide: Helm Breaker's Maxroll guide (text checked directly)
mainSkillTiming.recommendedSwitch: Prepare around Lv41–43 and about 35,000 gold, bind the Vaal Guard (the type that throws bombs, 50 Spirit) first, then respec your passives. Vaal Guards also come in melee and ranged types under the same name, so choose the individual that throws bombs

monk-lightning-minion-chayula.name: Lightning Minion Acolyte of Chayula

beginner.note: The main minion setup starts after the transition late in Act 3 (around Lv41–43), and Acts 1–3 are crossbow / grenade leveling, so earlyMainSkill is not counted as a confirmed condition. From the Mid setup onward, the source's strengths include "Few buttons", and the minion army holds the front line while you support from behind, so the operation and dodge conditions are counted as confirmed conditions. SSF viability is not stated in the source.

moderateOperation.basis: The source's strengths state "Few buttons in the Mid setup". From the Mid setup onward, you mainly maintain Pain Offering, Despair and Refutation, while the minion army does the processing.

noDodgeRequirement.basis: Defense is built from stacking ES and Evasion, damage reduction from Loyalty and Wolf Pack, and Refutation's block; the source has no statement assuming dodge rolls. The minions hold the front line and you support from behind.

boss.note: In boss fights you support with Pain Offering, Despair and Refutation, and the FAQ even has an optimization for pinnacle bosses: remove Blasphemy and self-cast Despair. However, there is no statement making single-target damage the calling card, so this stays at 4.
boss.sourceName: Maxroll: Lightning Minion Acolyte of Chayula Build Guide (Helm Breaker)

damage.note: The first of the source's strengths. On top of the Spark-firing Spectre army, the added chaos damage from Waking Dream and Choice of Power rides along and is transferred to the minions with Selfless Remnants.
damage.sourceName: Maxroll: Lightning Minion Acolyte of Chayula Build Guide (Helm Breaker)

defense.basis: Both a strength and a weakness
defense.note: From the Mid setup onward it is tanky through stacking ES / Evasion, damage reduction from Loyalty and Wolf Pack, and Refutation's block (source strength). On the other hand, the weaknesses include "Can be squishy until Mid setup" and "Not recommended for HC", so it is fragile until finished.
defense.sourceName: Maxroll: Lightning Minion Acolyte of Chayula Build Guide (Helm Breaker)

mapping.note: An army centered on Powered Zealot / Chaos Zealot Spectres firing Spark processes maps while you support. However, the source has no statement making clear speed the calling card, so this stays at 4.
mapping.sourceName: Maxroll: Lightning Minion Acolyte of Chayula Build Guide (Helm Breaker)

reviewedFacts.difficulty: Medium to High (crossbow leveling → respec late in Act 3, and identifying the right Spectre variant is required)
reviewedFacts.gearDependence: Centered on +levels to all minion skills (sceptre, helmet, amulet) and securing Spirit. No unique is mandatory for the campaign to function, but the source says you "really need" Alpha's Howl at the start of mapping
reviewedFacts.operation: Low (few buttons from the Mid setup onward. You mainly maintain Pain Offering, Despair and Refutation)
reviewedFacts.ssfNote: Whether the build works in SSF is not stated in the source. The source says no unique is mandatory for the campaign to function, but from mapping onward much of it assumes specified uniques

ranger-twister-deadeye.audience: Players who want to map with freezing and shattering, unleashing tornadoes across the whole screen.

A separate setup, with a different ascendancy, from the existing Twister Gemling (Mercenary) and Twister Spirit Walker (Huntress). Support gems renamed in 0.3.0 were replaced with the current official names.

ranger-twister-deadeye.difficulty: Assumes weapon set usage, keeping Whirling Slash at Lv1, Parry timing, and mark and Salvo management.
gearPriorities: Weapons: Weapon Set 1 is a spear prioritizing attack speed (Winged Spear / Soaring Spear, with an attack speed suffix; Skysliver is also a candidate). Weapon Set 2 is a spear with physical damage, critical strike chance and + to projectile skill levels. The off-hand is basically an Omen Sceptre, with Sacred Flame as the maximum-damage option.

Gear: The top priorities are The Taming and Olroth's Conviction. Early stopgaps are Wake of Destruction and Berek's Grip / Berek's Pass / Berek's Respite, and Serpent's Egg. The finished form is Mageblood and Headhunter.

Armour: Armour-focused in Acts 1–3, shifting to Evasion and Deflection from Act 3 onward, with ES / Evasion hybrid also an option late. On armour pieces, Life and resistances are the top priority, and the chest's Evasion Rating is the guideline for Deflection nodes (1200+ → 1500+). Jewellery takes added damage to attacks and mana recovery on kill.

levelingStages.caution: To level with Twister from Lv1 in a fresh league, you must first create a Huntress mule character and pass a Lv1 Whirling Slash, a spear and a buckler through the stash. Without a mule, level with Lightning Arrow + Lightning Rod and switch around Lv10, once you have 3 Lv3 gems and a decent spear. Keeping Whirling Slash at Lv1 is a strong instruction in the source; leveling it only increases mana cost. WASD movement is the source's recommendation; with mouse movement you must keep the cursor near your character, which is awkward to operate.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Weapon Set 1 is a spear prioritizing attack speed (Winged Spear or Soaring Spear, with an attack speed suffix; Skysliver if you have it). Leave the off-hand empty to receive Dance with Death's benefit. Weapon Set 2 is a damage-focused spear. Armour pieces are Armour-focused in Acts 1–3 to suppress damage taken while parrying.
levelingStages.label: Lv1–Act 1 (start Twister leveling)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Stack Whirling Slash's wind vortex up to 3 layers and consume it with Twister to strengthen it. Early on, use the buckler to Parry → Fangs of Frost to create cold ground.
nowActions: Create a Huntress mule and pass Whirling Slash, a spear and a buckler through the stash (without a mule, level with Lightning Arrow to around Lv10)
Keep Whirling Slash at Lv1 and progress with the procedure vortex ×3 → Twister
Parry with the buckler → create cold ground with Fangs of Frost to strengthen Twister
levelingStages.passivePriority: Follow the source's "Campaign" tree. Take enough attributes to meet gear and gem requirements, and put the rest into Strength to grow Life. Weapon set point allocation starts in Act 2.
levelingStages.replaceGear: When a spear with an attack speed suffix appears, update Weapon Set 1 with it. Once you take the second Uncut Spirit Gem (Lv6), replace the buckler with an Omen Sceptre.
levelingStages.supports: Whirling Slash is kept at Lv1: Rapid Attacks I → Rage I. Twister: Retreat → Prolonged Duration I. Ice-Tipped Arrows: Elemental Armament I. War Banner: Prolonged Duration I. Frost Bomb is also used. Setup from the source planner (Campaign).
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Reach Act 2 and cut Frost Nexus with the first Lv2 Uncut Support Gem.

levelingStages.caution: Once you cut Frost Nexus, it creates the cold ground, so Fangs of Frost can be removed. Use Ice-Tipped Arrows on cooldown, converting damage to cold to freeze. Cull the Weak is used for Frenzy Charge generation while moving, and against rare or magic packs you fire a Frenzy-empowered Barrage. On bosses, Freezing Mark creates ice ground together with Frost Nexus.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Once you take the second Uncut Spirit Gem (Lv6), switch to an Omen Sceptre. Armour pieces stay Armour-focused, and from Act 3 you will also want Evasion. Jewellery and gloves prioritize added damage to attacks (flat damage).
levelingStages.label: Act 2 (switch to Frost Nexus)
levelingStages.mainSkill: The basic Twister + Whirling Slash rotation. Cull the Weak generates Frenzy Charges while moving, and Freezing Mark freezes tough enemies.
nowActions: Cut Frost Nexus with the first Lv2 support gem and remove Fangs of Frost
Switch to an Omen Sceptre with the second Spirit Gem (Lv6)
Take the Gathering Winds → Avidity ascendancy in the first trial
levelingStages.passivePriority: Start weapon set point allocation in Act 2. Weapon Set 1 is Whirling Slash and Barrage; Weapon Set 2 is everything else. Ice-Tipped Arrows must be placed on Weapon Set 2 (otherwise it does not function). The first ascendancy is Gathering Winds → Avidity to grow Frenzy Charge generation.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Equip the Omen Sceptre in Weapon Set 2's off-hand. When a high-attack-speed spear appears, update Weapon Set 1 with it.
levelingStages.supports: Twister: Retreat → Frost Nexus → Elemental Armament II. Ice-Tipped Arrows: Elemental Armament I → Magnified Area I. Barrage: Rapid Casting → Perpetual Charge. Cull the Weak: Thrill of the Kill II → Charge Profusion. Freezing Mark: Prolonged Duration I. Herald of Ice: Elemental Armament II → Magnified Area II. Setup from the source planner (Maps).
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Reach Act 3 and cut Herald of Ice.

levelingStages.caution: Cutting Herald of Ice makes clear much easier, so do not neglect carving out the support slots. If landing criticals on the marked target with Whirling Slash is difficult, check Pinpoint Critical, Inexorable Critical II and a Rune of Consistency on the helmet.
levelingStages.gearPriority: From Act 3, Evasion becomes desirable. On armour pieces, prioritize Life and resistances while combining Armour and Evasion. Put a high-physical-damage spear on Weapon Set 2.
levelingStages.label: Act 3–Campaign End (Herald of Ice)
levelingStages.mainSkill: The basic rotation (Ice-Tipped Arrows → Whirling Slash ×3 → Barrage → Twister) gains Herald of Ice's explosions.
nowActions: Cut Herald of Ice to raise clear
Once a chest with 1200+ Evasion appears, start taking Deflection nodes
Take Thrilling Chase with the third ascendancy
levelingStages.passivePriority: The third ascendancy is Thrilling Chase. Once you obtain an Evasion chest (1200+ Evasion Rating), start taking Deflection nodes such as The Wild Cat / Trained Deflection / Enhanced Reflexes. Projectile speed, skill effect duration and area of effect become Twister's damage multipliers.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Once a chest with an Evasion Rating of 1200+ appears, switch defenses together with the Deflection nodes. Jewellery prioritizes added damage to attacks.
levelingStages.supports: Twister: continue Retreat → Frost Nexus → Elemental Armament II. Extend Herald of Ice to Elemental Armament II → Magnified Area II → Elemental Focus. Link Charge Profusion to Combat Frenzy. See the source planner for the exact slots.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Campaign finished and maps reached.

levelingStages.caution: Do not fire Twister too often. The source instructs you to wait for the combination layered with Salvo and Barrage before releasing it. Once Called Shots applies a mark, trigger it twice with Whirling Slash to generate up to 4 Frenzy Charges. On bosses, store 4–6 Frenzy Charges, then release the Salvo + Barrage + Twister combination.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Wake of Destruction creates elemental ground, so you no longer need Frost Nexus. The top purchase priority is The Taming, which lets you always strengthen Twister even without elemental ground. Serpent's Egg is good for strengthening Frenzy Charge generation. Jewellery covers mana with Sapphires granting 2% mana recovery on kill.
levelingStages.label: Early Maps
levelingStages.mainSkill: The Twister + Barrage Salvo combination. Called Shots automatically applies Sniper's Mark to generate Frenzy Charges.
nowActions: Obtain boots that create elemental ground and do without Frost Nexus
Buy The Taming with top priority
Take Called Shots with the fourth ascendancy and switch to Sniper's Mark
levelingStages.passivePriority: The fourth ascendancy is Called Shots. Replace Freezing Mark with Sniper's Mark, and grow Frenzy generation with Eternal Mark (only when your critical strike chance is sufficient to consume them stably). Deflection nodes are brought into full use with a chest of 1500+ Evasion.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Obtain Wake of Destruction early, then buy The Taming with top priority. Berek's Grip / Berek's Pass / Berek's Respite are stopgaps until The Taming.
levelingStages.supports: Twister: Retreat → Frost Nexus → Elemental Armament II → Acceleration → Deliberation. Barrage: Perpetual Charge → Rapid Casting II → Heightened Charges. Release Salvo only after storing 4+ seals. Called Shots' Sniper's Mark: Charged Mark → Eternal Mark → Ingenuity → Charge Profusion. See the source planner for the exact slots.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Obtain The Taming, with a prospect of obtaining Olroth's Conviction.

levelingStages.caution: When using Sacred Flame and Rakiata's Flow together, keep the boss away from you when using Twister (they cancel each other out). Trinity has a breakpoint at Lv23 of "+1% more elemental damage", so reach it with Uhtred's Augury or Uhtred's Omen. Garukhan's Resolve is the strongest lineage support for damage.
levelingStages.gearPriority: The top priority is Olroth's Conviction, which lets you use Barrage 3 times on cooldown. The weapon is a high-physical-damage spear. Use 10%+ critical strike chance as the guideline for The Ordained. The sceptre's Sacred Flame is the maximum damage, but mind its synergy with Rakiata's Flow. For Trinity's balance, choose from Guiding Palm of the Eye / Guiding Palm of the Heart / Guiding Palm of the Mind. Uhtred's Sidereus and Runeforged Sekhema Sandals are also candidates.
levelingStages.label: Endgame (Crit)
levelingStages.mainSkill: The Twister + Barrage critical setup. Generate Power Charges with Spear Stab + Ailith's Chimes and extend them with Charge Regulation.
nowActions: Obtain with top priority the talisman that lets Barrage be used 3 times on cooldown, and remove Salvo from Twister
Balance Trinity's elements and reach the Lv23 breakpoint
Generate Power Charges with Spear Stab + Ailith's Chimes
levelingStages.passivePriority: Balance critical nodes with Evasion / Deflection nodes. Deflection nodes are brought into full use with a chest of 1500+ Evasion. Balance Trinity with Heart of the Well's "gain damage as extra Fire". Put "increased Energy Shield %" on rare Sapphires.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Once you obtain Olroth's Conviction, remove Salvo from Twister. Combined with Uhtred's Constellation, Barrage becomes easier to use. Secure around 200 Ward so Barrage can be run with Olroth's Conviction.
levelingStages.supports: Barrage: Perpetual Charge → Rapid Casting II → Heightened Charges → Cooldown Recovery II → Efficiency II. Twister: Retreat → Acceleration → Rakiata's Flow → Deliberation → Salvo. Once Olroth's Conviction is in, remove Salvo from Twister. Whirling Slash: Rapid Attacks III → Rage III → Pinpoint Critical → Inexorable Critical II → Blazing Critical. Spear Stab: Culmination II → Ailith's Chimes → Charge Profusion → Rapid Attacks III → Rage III. See the source planner for the exact slots.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: You reach the stage where currency can go toward expensive finished-form gear such as Mageblood and Headhunter.

levelingStages.caution: If mana problems arise, handle them with Sapphires granting 2% mana recovery on kill and a mana flask, and late on with Lavianga's Spirits. Pure Evasion or an ES / Evasion hybrid is a matter of taste; the hybrid is somewhat tankier but reduces tree freedom. The source warns that "during boss fights you are vulnerable while waiting for cooldowns".
levelingStages.gearPriority: For Mageblood, one with doubled Silver, Jade and Bismuth legacies is best. Headhunter is extremely powerful in rare-heavy content, but securing resistances and chaos resistance becomes harder. Kolr's Hunt's Marksman Gloves are a luxury item. Uhtred's Sidereus, Runeforged Sekhema Sandals, Legacy of Wanderlust and Absent Amulet are also finished-form candidates.
levelingStages.label: Endgame (Crit Aspirational)
levelingStages.mainSkill: The finished Twister + Barrage form. The final setup adds Berserk and Ghost Dance.
nowActions: Assemble the finished form's unique belt
Fill in the Garukhan's Resolve and Her Declaration / Seraph's Heart lineage supports
Incorporate Berserk and Ghost Dance into the final setup
levelingStages.passivePriority: Take efficient flask nodes with Lavianga's Spirits. On an Evasion chest, Beastial Skin is powerful (pairs well with Slipstrike Vest and Sleek Jacket). For Controlled Metamorphosis, choose one with a small penalty to all elemental resistances (important when using Headhunter). Socket only good Time-Lost Jewels. If a Megalomaniac is a good item, take additional jewel sockets toward the Shadow / Witch side.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Her Declaration and Seraph's Heart are expensive lineage supports; before them, use Herbalism II and Clarity II. Jewels prioritize skill effect duration, ailment magnitude, critical strike chance and critical damage.
levelingStages.supports: Twister: Retreat → Acceleration → Rakiata's Flow → Garukhan's Resolve → Deliberation. Barrage: Perpetual Charge → Heightened Charges → Olroth's Conviction → Uhtred's Constellation → Efficiency II. Whirling Slash: Rapid Attacks III → Heightened Accuracy II → Blazing Critical → Pinpoint Critical → Rigwald's Ferocity. Herald of Thunder: Elemental Armament II → Concentrated Area → Blindside → Esh's Radiance → Esh's Prowess. See the source planner for the exact slots.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: The finished form. From here, progress with 3-mod jewels, max-rolling each gear piece, and strict selection of Time-Lost Jewels.

mainSkillTiming.available: Twister is a Tier 1 gem usable from Lv1 (poe2db). However, leveling with Twister from Lv1 in a fresh league requires a Huntress mule; without a mule, level with Lightning Arrow + Lightning Rod until around Lv10.
mainSkillTiming.guide: Legi's Maxroll guide (guide text and embedded planner checked directly)
mainSkillTiming.recommendedSwitch: Rather than a switch, it is staged strengthening: to Frost Nexus in Act 2, to Called Shots → Sniper's Mark at the fourth ascendancy, and removing Salvo from Twister once Olroth's Conviction is obtained.

ranger-twister-deadeye.name: Twister Deadeye

beginner.note: The main skill Twister is a Tier 1 gem usable from Lv1, so only the early condition is counted as a confirmed condition. However, starting from Lv1 in a fresh league requires a Huntress mule. The source calls weapon set usage "extremely important", and there is also Parry timing and mark and Salvo management, so the operation condition is not counted. Evasion and Deflection are the defensive foundation and you are squishy early on, so the dodge condition is not counted either. SSF viability is not stated in the source (the author is known as an SSF player, but this guide contains no SSF statement).

earlyMainSkill.basis: Twister is a Tier 1 gem requiring level 1 (poe2db). The source also states explicitly that you can "start at Lv1 and play through to Endgame".

boss.basis: Both a strength and a weakness
boss.note: It is listed as a strength that it handles both bossing and mapping, while a weakness is being vulnerable during boss fights while waiting for cooldowns.
boss.sourceName: Maxroll: Twister Deadeye Build Guide

damage.note: Twister's clear, spreading across the whole screen, is the signature. The source evaluates The Taming as always strengthening Twister with 100% added elemental damage, Trinity as a large damage multiplier, and Garukhan's Resolve as the strongest lineage support.
damage.sourceName: Maxroll: Twister Deadeye Build Guide

defense.basis: Both a strength and a weakness
defense.note: There are layers of Evasion, Deflection and ES, while the source's weaknesses state explicitly that you are squishy early and vulnerable during boss fights while waiting for cooldowns.
defense.sourceName: Maxroll: Twister Deadeye Build Guide

mapping.note: Screen-wide clear and freezes are emphasized in the strengths. Herald of Ice's explosions also help clear.
mapping.sourceName: Maxroll: Twister Deadeye Build Guide

reviewedFacts.difficulty: Medium to high (weapon set management, Parry, and mark and Salvo management are constantly required. WASD movement is recommended).
reviewedFacts.gearDependence: Centered on the two weapon set spears and the sceptre. No unique is mandatory, and The Taming and Olroth's Conviction are the room to grow.
reviewedFacts.operation: Frequent (the basic rotation of Ice-Tipped Arrows → Whirling Slash ×3 → Barrage → Twister, plus weapon set switching, Parry, mark consumption and waiting on Salvo).
reviewedFacts.ssfNote: Whether the build works in SSF is not stated in the source (Maxroll). The author Legi is known as an SSF player, but this guide is aimed at league start and also introduces trade-assuming purchases such as The Taming and Mageblood. "Functions without uniques" is not an SSF statement.

strengths: Unleashes elemental Twisters across the whole screen, with a wide clear area (source strength: Big Coverage).
Freezes and shatters feel satisfying, and you can map while freezing the whole screen (source strength: Satisfying Freezes and Shatters).
Versatile enough to handle both bosses and maps (source strength: Versatile for both bossing and Mapping).
It functions without uniques and is suited to league start (per the source's introduction: does not require any Uniques to function).
weaknesses: Squishy early on (source weakness: Squishy Early).
Vulnerable during boss fights while waiting for cooldowns (source weakness: Vulnerable during boss fights while waiting for cooldowns).
Weapon set usage is extremely important, and the build does not function if the assignments are wrong (per the source's gear explanation).
Leveling with Twister from Lv1 in a fresh league requires the preparation of creating a Huntress mule character first (per the source's skill priority).
WASD movement is recommended, and with mouse movement Whirling Slash is hard to operate (source FAQ).

monk-minion-chayula.audience: Players who like "commander" play: letting a horde of minions fight while they focus on curses and buff upkeep

changeHistory.summary: Created a new draft (unpublished). Checked Helm Breaker's Maxroll guide text and embedded planner directly and cross-checked names and mechanics against the Japanese poe2db. No mirror or summary sites were used. The planner's old support gem names were replaced with the current names from GGG's official 0.3.0 rename list (e.g. Scattershot → Multishot, Primal Armament → Elemental Armament, Figurehead → Selfless Remnants). leagueStarter is true based on the A Tier placement in the Maxroll League Starter Tier List (the site's Tier list was checked on 2026-11-24). The requested name "Minion Disciple of Chayula" was corrected to the guide's actual name, "Minion Army Acolyte of Chayula".

monk-minion-chayula.difficulty: Medium to High (Acts 1–3 are grenade leveling → a respec of about 35,000 gold around Lv41–43, and identifying and binding the right Vaal Guard is required)
gearPriorities: +levels to all minion skills: secure it on the sceptre, helmet and amulet. The top-priority stat, growing both minion damage and durability (source).

Spirit: increase the number of minions you can summon with additional Spirit from gear. Alpha's Howl is the top priority for its large Spirit increase + doubled Presence radius. A Prism Guardian is also used to add Spirit (source).
Added damage to allies in your Presence: a high roll of this sceptre mod grows damage greatly, because Choice of Power and Waking Dream multiply it (source).
A melee splash belt: a requirement for the Mid setup. A rare belt with "minion attacks have melee splash" frees one support slot on the Spectre (source).
Defense: stack ES and Evasion, and reduce damage taken with Loyalty and Wolf Pack. In the Mid setup, ES + Evasion + about 100 Ward is the foundation (source).

Jewels: on Sapphire jewels, prioritize maximum ES, minions' all elemental resistances, minion attack / cast speed, and minion damage. From Mid onward, faster ES recharge start; in Min-Max, minion critical as well (source).

levelingStages.caution: The source calls the early part of Monk's Act 1 a rough section. Do not overextend until Explosive Grenade unlocks. Pick up and sell rares, and start saving gold for the respec.
levelingStages.gearPriority: A crossbow with high physical / lightning damage (a Bombard Crossbow in Act 3). Prioritize maximum Life and resistances. Armour or Armour / Evasion bases are preferable, but the source says Evasion-only is rough early on. If you see a helmet, amulet or sceptre with +1 minion skills, secure it (for the switch late in Act 3).
levelingStages.label: Lv1–37 (crossbow / grenade leveling)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Progress the first 2–3 levels with a Quarterstaff, and once you have a Makeshift Crossbow (can be bought from Renly), proceed with Explosive Grenade and Flash Grenade. Apply Exposure with Frost Bomb and raise boss damage with War Banner
nowActions: Obtain a crossbow
Proceed with Explosive Grenade and Flash Grenade
Prioritize maximum Life and resistances on gear
levelingStages.passivePriority: Raise grenade damage with Concussive Attack, Dizzying Sweep, Killer Instinct, Blinding Strike and Kite Runner. The first ascendancy order is Waking Dream → Choice of Power (source).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Update flasks to the newest ones every 10–15 levels (source).
levelingStages.supports: Explosive Grenade: Multishot II and Elemental Armament I. Flash Grenade: Multishot II and Lightning Attunement. Frost Bomb: Rapid Casting I. Into the Breach unlocks after taking the first ascendancy (Remnant Potency II + Harmonic Remnants II).
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Reach Utzaal late in Act 3 and become able to bind a Vaal Guard Spectre (around Lv38).

levelingStages.caution: There are three monsters named Vaal Guard (melee / 50 Spirit, ranged / 60 Spirit, bomb type / 50 Spirit). Bind the type that throws bombs. Bomb-type Spectres can cause performance problems (source note). If your PC cannot handle it or you find it unpleasant, you can substitute a Skeletal Reaver. Right after the switch, damage is lower than grenade leveling (stated in the source).
levelingStages.gearPriority: A sceptre, helmet and amulet with +levels to all minion skills. A Rattling Sceptre is the best base, but mod content matters more than the base (source). A high roll of added damage to allies in your Presence (fire / cold / lightning / physical) grows damage greatly, because Choice of Power and Waking Dream multiply it.
levelingStages.label: Lv38–41 (switch to minions: Vaal Guard Spectre)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Bind a bomb-throwing Vaal Guard with Bind Spectre, and bring out Raging Spirits with Flame Wall. Strengthen the minions with Wolf Pack + Pain Offering + Despair
nowActions: Bind a bomb-throwing Vaal Guard
Bring out Raging Spirits with Flame Wall
Respec your passives for about 35,000 gold
levelingStages.passivePriority: Respec for about 35,000 gold around Lv41–43. Relentless Fallen for minion mobility and damage; Lord of Horrors and The Soul Meridian to reduce Spirit reservation; Remnant Attraction and Empowering Remnants to strengthen Waking Dream and Choice of Power.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Replace helmet, amulet and sceptre with +1–2 minion skill versions. If you have leftover Spirit, add one Skeletal Storm Mage.
levelingStages.supports: Vaal Guard Spectre: Multishot II + Feeding Frenzy I + Muster. Raging Spirits: Last Gasp + Minion Splash I + Feeding Frenzy. Pain Offering: Meat Shield II + Danse Macabre. Into the Breach: Remnant Potency II + Harmonic Remnants II + Selfless Remnants.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: The Vaal Guard Spectre is bound, the passive respec (about 35,000 gold) is done, and you can enter Act 4 on the minion setup.

levelingStages.caution: Refutation and Wardbound Minions are skill gems from Expedition encounters. If you find them, keep them. Wardbound Minions is not used until the Mid setup.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Maintain +levels to all minion skills on the sceptre, helmet and amulet. With a Shrine Sceptre, you can use Spirit-reservation supports such as Upwelling II effectively for free (source). Prioritize boots with movement speed, Life and resistances.
levelingStages.label: Lv42–59 (Skeletal Reaver: Act 4–Interludes)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Use the first Greater Jeweller's Orb on a Skeletal Reaver and replace the Vaal Guard. Apply Shock with a Skeletal Storm Mage and heal with a Skeletal Cleric. Put Onslaught on minions with Refutation, and block with it in dangerous moments
nowActions: Use the Greater Jeweller's Orb on a Skeletal Reaver
Use the defensive skills found in Expedition
Supplement healing with a Skeletal Cleric
levelingStages.passivePriority: Take Right Hand of Darkness, because Withered scales greatly with Waking Dream and Choice of Power. Raise minion survivability with Necrotised Flesh, Crystalline Flesh and Vile Mending. Widen Spirit and Presence area with Profane Commander.
levelingStages.replaceGear: At Lv36, Soul Mantle becomes a defensive option. If you have Enfolding Dawn, runeforging it is best (source).
levelingStages.supports: Skeletal Reaver: Muster + Feeding Frenzy II + Last Gasp + Rage III. Raging Spirits: Muster + Minion Splash II + Feeding Frenzy II + Last Gasp. Pain Offering: Meat Shield II + Danse Macabre + Elemental Army. Refutation: Prolonged Duration II + Cooldown Recovery II.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Finish the Interludes and enter maps. The Skeletal Reaver setup is in place and you can use Refutation.

levelingStages.caution: First cap your resistances and meet attribute requirements. Until elemental resistances are capped, adjust with Flux runes. Without about 100 Ward you cannot maintain Wardbound Minions, so transition to the Mid setup only after securing Ward.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Alpha's Howl is the top priority (large Spirit increase + doubled Presence radius). Runeforge Enfolding Dawn, and increase minion counts with Bones of Ullr. Gloves prioritize ES above all. Instill Essence Infusion on the amulet.
levelingStages.label: Lv60–79 (Early Mapping)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Keep the Skeletal Reaver as the main force and keep bringing out Raging Spirits with Flame Wall. Strengthen all minions with Pain Offering, and weaken bosses and tough rares with Despair. Use Refutation on cooldown to put Onslaught on minions
nowActions: Obtain the helmet that doubles Presence radius
Cap resistances and meet attribute requirements
Runeforge a high-ES chest piece
levelingStages.passivePriority: Raise ES and Evasion with Enhanced Barrier, Mindful Awareness and Spectral Ward. Greatly extend ES with Heavy Buffer, and combine it with Mind Over Matter to use Mana for defense. Inner Faith and The Hollowkeeper reduce curse effect on you by 75%. The third ascendancy is Chayula's Gift.
levelingStages.replaceGear: If Alpha's Howl is expensive, substitute a helmet with +2 minion skills (source). The sceptre is a Shrine Sceptre or a Rattling Sceptre. Boots (Bones of Ullr) gain Ward through runeforging.
levelingStages.supports: Skeletal Reaver: Muster + Feeding Frenzy II + Last Gasp + Rage III + Minion Splash II. Pain Offering: Meat Shield II + Danse Macabre + Magnified Area II + Prolonged Duration II. Despair: Heightened Curse + Cursed Ground + Efficiency II + Prolonged Duration II. Refutation: Cooldown Recovery II + Prolonged Duration II + Rapid Casting II + Mobility.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Obtain a rare belt with "minion attacks have melee splash", and Spirit reaches 450 or more.

levelingStages.caution: Wardbound Minions is at most Lv16; lower is better because it consumes less Ward. Without about 100 Ward you cannot maintain Onslaught. Without the melee splash belt, the Spectre loses one support slot.
levelingStages.gearPriority: A rare belt with "minion attacks have melee splash" is required. Maximize ES and Evasion on the chest and gloves, and put Deflection Rating on at least one piece, preferably both. The chest is a Rambler Jacket or a Sleek Jacket. Add Spirit with a Prism Guardian. At 450+ Spirit, insert Amanamu's Gaze into the boots to raise movement speed.
levelingStages.label: Lv80–89 (Mid: Plague Harvester)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Switch to a Plague Harvester Spectre. It moves fast and leaps over obstacles, so it does not get stuck like the Skeletal Reaver. Remove Flame Wall and Raging Spirits, and add Wardbound Minions (max Lv16) and Convalescence. Turn Despair into an aura with Blasphemy
nowActions: Obtain a rare belt with melee splash
Switch to a Plague Harvester Spectre
Secure Ward up to about 100
levelingStages.passivePriority: Use Heavy Buffer and Mind Over Matter to use Mana for defense. Change the amulet instill to Warlord Leader. Sapphire jewels prioritize maximum ES, minions' all elemental resistances, minion attack / cast speed, minion damage, and faster ES recharge start. Optional: specialize Weapon Set II in Remnant nodes and snapshot by switching Set II → Set I on zone entry for about 20–30% more damage (if you will not do it, proceed on the base tree).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Update Alpha's Howl to a corrupted version with "+1 minion skills". Bones of Ullr may prioritize reservation efficiency over movement speed (if Spirit is 450+). Secure about 100 Ward on the gloves through runeforging.
levelingStages.supports: Plague Harvester Spectre: Muster + Feeding Frenzy II + Rage III + Rapid Attacks II + Minion Mastery. Pain Offering: Danse Macabre + Magnified Area II + Prolonged Duration II + Brutus' Brain + Efficiency II. Blasphemy + Despair: Ritualistic Curse + Magnified Area II + Chaos Mastery. Wardbound Minions: Efficiency II + Blind II + Rapid Casting II + Mobility. Convalescence: Second Wind III + Cooldown Recovery II + Prolonged Duration II + Rapid Casting III.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: ES and Evasion have grown enough, and you are used to running Convalescence and Refutation. You can put Khatal's Rejuvenation into Into the Breach.

levelingStages.caution: If you use the Blood of the Warrior flask while Rage is at maximum, Warlord Berserker does not trigger. Use it after Rage has dropped. From 0 Rage, using it in three separate doses maxes the minions' Rage (source). The source states the fourth ascendancy is useless.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Maximize ES and Evasion on the chest and gloves, and add Deflect. The chest is a Rambler Jacket or a Sleek Jacket. Insert Legacy of Greymake into a 2-socket Alpha's Howl (corrupted with +1 minion skills). A high-ES focus (+2 minion skills). If you replace the belt with a Mageblood, return Minion Splash II to the Spectre.
levelingStages.label: Lv90+ (Late–Min-Max finished form)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Recover ES with Convalescence, block enemy attacks with Refutation, and strengthen all minions with Pain Offering. In Min-Max, take Bulwark with From Nothing, enable Warlord Berserker with a Megalomaniac carrying Blood of Rage, and grant minions Rage with the Blood of the Warrior flask
nowActions: Change the amulet instill to the late-game one
Set up a system that can grant minions Rage
Update the Spectre's supports to their final form
levelingStages.passivePriority: Take Bulwark with From Nothing, and take Warlord Leader, Warlord Berserker and Ally Attack Damage. The Megalomaniac carries Blood of Rage. Sapphire jewels prioritize maximum ES, minions' all elemental resistances, minion attack / cast speed, minion damage, minion critical strike chance and critical damage bonus, and faster ES recharge start.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Change the amulet instill to Zarokh's Gift. Insert Cadigan's Epiphany into the gloves. If you have Sacrificial Regalia, it is a finished-form chest candidate. In addition to Lavianga's Spirits, prepare a Blood of the Warrior flask.
levelingStages.supports: Plague Harvester Spectre: Feeding Frenzy II + Muster + Dialla's Desire + Uul-Netol's Embrace + Minion Splash II (per the text's instructions; the planner has Rapid Attacks II, and the discrepancy is noted). Pain Offering: Danse Macabre + Magnified Area II + Prolonged Duration II + Brutus' Brain + Sacrificial Offering. Convalescence: Uhtred's Constellation. Skeletal Storm Mage: Esh's Radiance.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: After finishing, progress by rerolling the Spectre and updating jewels. For pinnacle bosses, removing Blasphemy and self-casting Despair raises damage (source FAQ).

monk-minion-chayula.mainSkill: A minion army centered on the Vaal Guards, Skeletal Reavers and Plague Harvesters bound with Bind Spectre. Into the Breach's Remnants are narrowed to added chaos damage by Choice of Power and transferred to the minions with Selfless Remnants to grow damage. Early on you level with a crossbow + Explosive Grenade and switch to minions late in Act 3

mainSkillTiming.available: The main minion army starts late in Act 3 (around Lv41–43), once you bind a Vaal Guard Spectre. Until then you progress on the crossbow + Explosive Grenade leveling setup
mainSkillTiming.guide: Helm Breaker's Maxroll guide (text checked directly)
mainSkillTiming.recommendedSwitch: Prepare Lv41–43, reaching Utzaal, about 35,000 gold, and a helmet / sceptre with +1–2 minion skills; bind the bomb-throwing Vaal Guard (of the three same-named variants, the bomb type at 50 Spirit) first, then respec. Note that right after the switch, damage is lower than grenade leveling

monk-minion-chayula.name: Minion Army Acolyte of Chayula

beginner.note: The main minion army starts after the switch late in Act 3 (around Lv41–43) and is not a main skill usable from Lv1, so the early condition is not counted as a confirmed condition. The source states the Mid setup has "few buttons", so only the operation condition is counted as a confirmed condition. Defense is founded on ES + Evasion + Refutation's block, and it is fragile until Mid, so the dodge condition is not counted. SSF viability is not stated in the source.

moderateOperation.basis: The source's strengths state "Few buttons in the Mid setup", and the rotation from Mid onward is mainly maintaining Pain Offering and Wardbound Minions. On bosses you only add Despair and Refutation.

boss.basis: Both a strength and a weakness
boss.note: The source has no statement praising boss damage. The FAQ recommends the adjustment "remove Blasphemy and self-cast Despair instead" for pinnacle bosses, and the finished form as-is needs work for pinnacle bosses, so this is rated 3.
boss.sourceName: Maxroll: Minion Army Acolyte of Chayula Build Guide (Helm Breaker)

damage.note: The first of the source's strengths. Added damage to allies in your Presence is multiplied by Choice of Power and Waking Dream, and grows a further 20–30% with the Remnant snapshot (optional).
damage.sourceName: Maxroll: Minion Army Acolyte of Chayula Build Guide (Helm Breaker)

defense.basis: Both a strength and a weakness
defense.note: In the Mid setup it is tanky through ES + Evasion, damage reduction from Loyalty / Wolf Pack, and Refutation's block (source strength: "Tanky (In the Mid setup)"). On the other hand, being fragile until Mid is a source weakness ("Can be squishy until Mid setup").
defense.sourceName: Maxroll: Minion Army Acolyte of Chayula Build Guide (Helm Breaker)

mapping.note: A horde of minions does the processing, and the Mid setup has few buttons. The Plague Harvester moves fast and leaps over obstacles, so it rarely gets stuck. However, Vaal Guard Spectres can cause performance problems, and leveling until Mid relies on grenades, so this is not rated 5.
mapping.sourceName: Maxroll: Minion Army Acolyte of Chayula Build Guide (Helm Breaker)

reviewedFacts.difficulty: Medium to High (grenade leveling → respec around Lv41–43, and identifying and binding the right Vaal Guard is required)
reviewedFacts.gearDependence: Centered on +levels to all minion skills (sceptre, helmet, amulet), securing Spirit, and added damage to allies in your Presence. No unique is mandatory, but Alpha's Howl is a major milestone at the start of mapping
reviewedFacts.operation: Low (the Mid setup has few buttons. Maintaining Pain Offering and Wardbound Minions, plus Despair and Refutation on bosses, is needed)
reviewedFacts.ssfNote: Whether the build works in SSF is not stated in the source. The source says no unique is mandatory during the campaign, but note that obtaining Expedition skill gems (Refutation, Wardbound Minions) is assumed
