strengths: Very high damage (source strength: Very high damage). Added damage to allies in your Presence grows multiplicatively through Choice of Power and Waking Dream.
Tanky defense in the Mid setup (source strength: Tanky (In the Mid setup)). On top of ES + Evasion, damage reduction from Loyalty and Wolf Pack and Refutation's block stack up.
Few buttons in the Mid setup (source strength: Few buttons in the Mid setup). Maintaining Pain Offering and Wardbound Minions is the core, and you can focus on curses and debuffs yourself.
No unique is mandatory during the campaign. It can be grown with cheap options such as Enfolding Dawn and Bones of Ullr (source).
The Plague Harvester moves fast and leaps over obstacles, so it rarely gets stuck or caught like the Skeletal Reaver (source).
weaknesses: Not recommended for HC (source weakness: Not recommended for HC).

Acts 1–3 leveling is not minions (source weakness: Non-Minion leveling in Act 1-3). A respec of about 35,000 gold is needed around Lv41–43, and right after the switch damage is lower than grenade leveling (stated in the source).
Can be squishy until the Mid setup (source weakness: Can be squishy until Mid setup).
Vaal Guard Spectres can cause performance problems (source note). If your PC cannot handle it or you find it unpleasant, you can substitute a Skeletal Reaver.
The Remnant snapshot (optional) requires weapon set management, and if you take it but do not execute it, damage drops by about 50% (source). You can also ignore it and proceed on the base tree.
Whether the build works in SSF is not stated in the source.

monk-oil-barrage.audience: Players who like blanketing the whole screen with projectiles and cycling Power Charges recovered from bells and corpses. For Monk players who want to make the bells of Hollow Focus work.

changeHistory.summary: Created a new draft (unpublished). Checked havoc616's Maxroll guide text and embedded planner (bl5b6d0w) directly and cross-checked names and mechanics against the Japanese poe2db. No mirror or summary sites were used. Old support gem names in the planner were replaced with the current names from GGG's official 0.3.0 rename list (e.g. Twofold → Heightened Charges, Single Out → Mark for Death, Ingenuity → Cooldown Recovery, Charge Infusion → Charge Regulation). leagueStarter is true based on the A Tier placement in the Maxroll League Starter Tier List (checked directly on 2026-11-25). A separate setup from the existing Monk builds (Falling Thunder, Hollow Focus + Storm Wave, Infernal Legion, lightning minions, minions): an Oil Barrage build that Devours Hollow Focus bells to cycle Power Charges.

During integration, fixed the draft's misspelling "Zarohk's Gift" to the correct "Zarokh's Gift" (confirmed against the name registered on the Japanese poe2db). Aligned the top-level ssf field from null to true (matching the source's explicit SSF statement and ratingEvidence.beginner.checks.ssfConfirmed=true, following this site's convention).

monk-oil-barrage.difficulty: Medium (level with a different setup through the campaign, switch to Oil Barrage in Early Maps; requires keeping Power Charges up and managing Devour on bells and corpses)
gearPriorities: Talisman: elemental DPS first. Aim for 300+ in Early Maps, 380+ from Lv77, 490+ in Endgame, with 15%+ critical strike chance and +skill levels (source).
Power Charge generation: anoint the amulet with Thaumaturgic Generator, Way of the Stonefist gloves (Power Charge on critical strike), and Ailith's Chimes on Hollow Focus (source).
Defense: a large ES pool + Evasion + Deflect. Prefer ES / Evasion bases, and use the Forgotten Warden's Spirit Vessel to reinforce defense and damage (source).
Critical: bring Oil Barrage's critical strike chance close to 100%. On Time-Lost Jewels, prioritize critical strike chance and critical damage (source).
Item rarity: aim for 100% → 150%. The upgrade rate to rare currency rises sharply (source FAQ).
Gloves (Way of the Stonefist): prioritize mods in the order critical damage → base critical strike chance → attack speed → Onslaught on hit (source).
Movement speed: boots at 10%+ early, 20–30% during the campaign, 35%+ in Endgame (source).

levelingStages.caution: Most of Glacial Cascade's damage is in its final big spike. To break Frozen Locus in one hit, land that spike. Consuming Freeze adds a 250% or 425% extra damage multiplier (source).
levelingStages.gearPriority: A high-DPS magic / rare Quarterstaff. Boots with 10%+ movement speed. Helmet, chest and belt with plenty of Life. You may socket the weapon with an Artificer's Orb and reinforce it with Lesser Runes (source).
levelingStages.label: Lv1–13 (Hollow Palm leveling, Act 1 first half)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Progress with a Quarterstaff, place Frozen Locus from Lv2 and detonate it with the big final spike of Glacial Cascade. Add Pounce at Lv6 for movement and Herald of Ice at Lv10. At Lv13 take Hollow Palm Technique and the Quarterstaff is no longer needed.
nowActions: Place Frozen Locus and detonate it with Glacial Cascade's big spike
Take Hollow Palm Technique at Lv13
Get boots with 10%+ movement speed and armor pieces with plenty of Life
levelingStages.passivePriority: Rush Hollow Palm Technique as fast as possible. Take efficient early damage nodes on the way, and enough attributes to meet gear and gem requirements (source).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Once you take Hollow Palm Technique at Lv13, the Quarterstaff no longer needs upgrading. Only equip pieces that raise DPS substantially (source).
levelingStages.supports: Glacial Cascade: Concentrated Area + Rage I. Frozen Locus: Ice Bite. Herald of Ice: Magnified Area.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Take Hollow Palm Technique at Lv13 and continue through Act 1.

levelingStages.caution: There are several passive respecs late in the campaign. If you are short on gold, sell rare items to save up (source).
levelingStages.gearPriority: Gloves and amulet with +levels to melee skills, rings with flat elemental damage to attacks. Prioritize Life and resistances. Boots with 20–30% movement speed. On trade, Horns of Bynden and Luminous Pace are early options (source).
levelingStages.label: Lv14–Campaign End (Storm Wave leveling)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Switch to Storm Wave in Act 2 (around Lv22) and clear by detonating Frozen Locus. For single target, freeze with Wave of Frost and consume the Freeze with Glacial Cascade's big spike for heavy damage. Add Herald of Thunder in Act 3.
nowActions: Clear by detonating Frozen Locus with Storm Wave
Add Herald of Thunder to speed up clearing
Save the Greater Jeweller's Orb for Oil Barrage
levelingStages.passivePriority: Start allocating Weapon Set 2 points (for Pounce). First ascendancy: Way of the Mountain → Hollow Focus Technique. Late in the campaign there are respecs into strong scaling nodes for the move to maps (source note).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Save the Greater Jeweller's Orb guaranteed in Act 4 for Oil Barrage (strong instruction in the source).
levelingStages.supports: Storm Wave: Rage II + Elemental Armament II + Branching Fissures. Glacial Cascade: Concentrated Area + Elemental Armament II + Elemental Focus. Frozen Locus: Ice Bite II + Elemental Armament II + Innervate. Frost Bomb: Potent Exposure. Herald of Ice: Magnified Area II + Elemental Armament II. Hand of Chayula: Freezing Mark + Elemental Weakness. Wave of Frost: Deep Freeze + Ice Bite II. Pounce: Cooldown Recovery II.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Clear the campaign and enter Early Maps. Prepare a Spiny Talisman with 300+ elemental DPS.

levelingStages.caution: Always use Nova Projectiles I. With II socketed, the other gems no longer all fit (strong warning in the source). While your critical strike chance is low, you can support Power Charge generation with a Blasphemy + Repulsion + Ailith's Chimes setup (at the cost of the Charge Regulation and Ghost Dance slots).
levelingStages.gearPriority: A Spiny Talisman with 300+ elemental DPS (guide price: 5–20 Exalted plus 10–20 Exalted of additional investment). Basic gear at 1–2 Exalted per slot. After taking Way of the Stonefist, choose gloves by the mod priority (critical damage → base critical strike chance → attack speed → Onslaught on hit) (source).
levelingStages.label: Early Maps (switch to Oil Barrage)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Switch to Oil Barrage. At the start of a map, Devour a Hollow Focus bell to gain your first Power Charge, then clear with Oil Barrage. Regularly Devour bells and the corpses of enemies you kill to keep Power Charges up. Place Tempest Bell with Whirling Assault to create more chain / fork starting points.
nowActions: Devour a bell to gain Power Charges
Prepare a talisman with 300+ elemental DPS
Socket Nova Projectiles I into Oil Barrage
levelingStages.passivePriority: Third ascendancy: Way of the Stonefist. Weapon Set 1 takes attack nodes; Weapon Set 2 takes parry nodes that strengthen Refutation (source).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Craft the talisman yourself by identifying rares and using Transmutation / Augmentation / Regal Orbs, or buy it on trade (source). Uncut Skill Gems (Lv14) and Uncut Support Gems (Lv5) drop more often in maps.
levelingStages.supports: Oil Barrage: Ricochet II + Fork + Salvo + Nova Projectiles I. Rend: Heightened Charges + Prolonged Duration II + Rage III. Hollow Focus: Cooldown Recovery II + Magnified Area II + Overabundance II. Devour: Blazing Critical + Thrill of the Kill II + Charge Profusion II + Rage III. Tempest Bell: Ancestral Call II + Magnified Area II + Delayed Gratification. Whirling Assault: Practiced Combo + Rage III + Rapid Attacks III. Hand of Chayula: Freezing Mark + Elemental Weakness + Mark of Siphoning II. Refutation: Cooldown Recovery II + Mobility + Efficiency II. Wind Dancer: Magnified Area II + Stun III + Enduring Impact II. Ghost Dance: Cooldown Recovery II + Clarity. Use Charge Regulation as a persistent buff.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Reach Lv77+ and be able to upgrade the talisman to 380+ elemental DPS. Anoint the amulet with Thaumaturgic Generator.

levelingStages.caution: Unless you convert Fists of Stone into Runeforged Fists of Stone with a Versium Anvil, Refutation cannot be used in the Forgotten Warden's Spirit Vessel setup (source). Do not use Refutation while clearing (you would take heavy stuns).
levelingStages.gearPriority: A talisman with 380+ elemental DPS and +levels to melee / attack skills (10–50 Exalted, optionally 1–2 Divine). Upgrade skill gems with Uncut Skill Gems (Lv17–18). Anoint the amulet with Thaumaturgic Generator. The Forgotten Warden raises survivability substantially. Time-Lost Jewel (critical strike chance and critical damage first) (source).
levelingStages.label: Lv77–Late Maps (stronger talisman + defense)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Oil Barrage stays the core skill. Once your critical strike chance reaches 50%+, swap Pinpoint Critical for Elemental Armament II. Put Oil Barrage into Spirit Vessel to raise single-target damage.
nowActions: Anoint the amulet with Thaumaturgic Generator
At 50%+ critical strike chance, swap Pinpoint Critical for Elemental Armament II
Raise survivability with a chest piece that summons a guardian (Forgotten Warden)
levelingStages.passivePriority: Fourth ascendancy: Runic Meridians. Fill in critical nodes and raise your critical strike chance. On Time-Lost Jewels prioritize critical strike chance and critical damage (1–2 mods; radius does not matter at this stage) (source).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Upgrade each slot to the 5–10 Exalted range. Completing the third and fourth ascendancies is a large power gain, but you may wait until you feel confident (source).
levelingStages.supports: On top of the Early Maps setup: Oil Barrage takes Pinpoint Critical (while below 50%; swap to Elemental Armament II at 50%+). Rend adds Perpetual Charge. Hollow Focus adds Prolonged Duration II. Hand of Chayula adds Charged Mark. Refutation adds Prolonged Duration II. Spirit Vessel: Oil Barrage + Potent Exposure + Hulking Minions + Romira's Requital + Amanamu's Tithe.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Move to Endgame once the talisman reaches 490+ elemental DPS with 15%+ critical strike chance, item rarity approaches 150%, and gems are at Lv19–20 with 20% quality.

levelingStages.caution: The channeling delay is resolved later by skill speed (source weakness). The build assumes a "don't get hit" playstyle, and some enemies such as Abyss monsters need high damage and area coverage (source FAQ).
levelingStages.gearPriority: A talisman with 490+ elemental DPS, 15%+ critical strike chance and +skill levels. Aim for 150% item rarity. Boots with 35%+ movement speed, Evasion and Deflect. Upgrade the Forgotten Warden to better rolls. Gems at Lv19–20 with 20% quality (source).
levelingStages.label: Endgame (100% crit, high item rarity)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Oil Barrage (Lv20, 20% quality). Power Charge generation becomes increasingly automatic: Thaumaturgic Generator + Way of the Stonefist gloves (Power Charge on critical strike) + Ailith's Chimes on Hollow Focus. On bosses, place Tempest Bell with Whirling Assault to raise single-target damage.
nowActions: Bring critical strike chance close to 100%
Aim for 150% item rarity
Upgrade the talisman to 490+ elemental DPS
levelingStages.passivePriority: Bring critical strike chance close to 100%. Balance Energy Shield with Evasion and Deflect. Fill in area-of-effect jewels (3–4 mod Time-Lost Jewels prioritizing critical strike chance and critical damage, and suffix-effect jewels) (source).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Whenever you replace the amulet, always re-anoint Thaumaturgic Generator (strong warning in the source).
levelingStages.supports: Oil Barrage: Elemental Armament II (Pinpoint Critical removed). Hollow Focus: Living Lightning II + Culmination II + Ailith's Chimes + Charge Profusion II. Rend adds Rapid Attacks III. Hand of Chayula adds Mark for Death II. Refutation adds Rapid Casting II. Wind Dancer adds Blind II. Spirit Vessel stays as in Late Maps.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Move to Aspirational once you are ready for long-term goals such as Lv21 gems, Rakiata's Flow and Zarokh's Gift.

levelingStages.caution: Aspirational gear is a long-term goal collected over most of a league (source). The spirits are given in English here because their Japanese names could not be confirmed on poe2db.
levelingStages.gearPriority: The highest elemental DPS (or physical DPS) talisman you can buy (15%+ critical strike chance, attack speed, +skill levels). Put a Raven-Touched Shard on the helmet and upgrade the amulet anoint from Thaumaturgic Generator to Zarokh's Gift. Keep item rarity at 150%+. Rite of Passage spirits, in priority order: Spirit of the Stag (movement speed, skill speed, added lightning damage) first, then Spirit of the Cat (critical strike chance and evasion), Spirit of the Wolf (movement speed, skill speed, armour break), Spirit of the Owl (Energy Shield and damage), Spirit of the Bear (maximum Life and damage reduction) (source priority order).
levelingStages.label: Aspirational (Lv21 gems, long-term goals)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Oil Barrage Lv21, 0% quality (when using Rakiata's Flow). Remove Elemental Weakness from Hand of Chayula and remove Oil Barrage from Spirit Vessel (instructions for the Rakiata's Flow setup in the source). You may use Hand of Chayula instead of Pounce. For mapping there is an option to rebuild into a Blasphemy + Repulsion setup.
nowActions: Raise the main skill to Lv21
Switch to the Rakiata's Flow setup
Use separate setups for mapping and for bosses
levelingStages.passivePriority: Fill critical strike chance and critical damage with 5-mod jewels and 4–5 mod Time-Lost Jewels. Raise jewels to 20% quality (source).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Many talismans look higher-DPS because of a Greater Iron Rune; when buying, be careful of numbers that include the rune (source note).
levelingStages.supports: Oil Barrage: Rakiata's Flow. Hand of Chayula adds Eternal Mark. Charge Regulation adds Uhtred's Exodus. For mapping, Blasphemy takes Repulsion + Living Lightning II + Culmination II + Ailith's Chimes + Charge Profusion II.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: The finished form. From here, progress by adding more mods to jewels, max-rolling each gear piece, and refining the Time-Lost Jewel.

monk-oil-barrage.mainSkill: Oil Barrage — spends Power Charges to fire chaining, forking Nova projectiles. Generate Power Charges by using Devour on the bells of Hollow Focus or on the corpses of enemies you kill. Level with Frozen Locus + Glacial Cascade early, switch to Storm Wave from Act 2, and swap to Oil Barrage in Early Maps.

mainSkillTiming.available: Oil Barrage is designed to be switched to in Early Maps (source). Save the Greater Jeweller's Orb guaranteed in Act 4 for Oil Barrage.
mainSkillTiming.guide: havoc616's Maxroll guide (text and embedded planner checked directly)
mainSkillTiming.recommendedSwitch: After finishing the campaign, prepare a Spiny Talisman with 300+ elemental DPS, create Oil Barrage with an Uncut Skill Gem (Lv14), and then switch. The swap needs skill gems and gold for passive / ascendancy respecs (the source notes gold is usually not the bottleneck).

monk-oil-barrage.name: Oil Barrage Martial Artist

beginner.note: The main skill, Oil Barrage, only comes online after the switch in Early Maps, so it is not a main skill usable from Lv22 or below and the early condition is not counted as confirmed. The source does not list ease of operation as a strength, and there are many moving parts to manage: Devouring bells and corpses, placing Tempest Bell, and more. The defenses are layered, but the source lists a "don't get hit" playstyle as a weakness, so evasion and positioning are assumed and the defense condition is not counted as confirmed. SSF is confirmed: the source's strengths state "SSF Campaign ~4Hours, Arbiter ~8Hours" and the leveling guide lists "SSF Fresh Start Leaguestart Viable" as a strength.

ssfConfirmed.basis: The source's strengths state "SSF Campaign ~4Hours, Arbiter ~8Hours" and the leveling guide's strengths list "SSF Fresh Start Leaguestart Viable." Reaching the campaign end in about 4 hours and the Arbiter in about 8 hours is presented as achievable in SSF.

boss.note: The introduction states "tremendous single target damage, which is easy to scale." Tempest Bell adds another starting point to raise single-target damage, and Refutation's parry applies a debuff of 50%+ increased damage taken. Reaching the Arbiter in about 8 hours is also listed as a strength.
boss.sourceName: Maxroll: Oil Barrage Martial Artist Build Guide (havoc616)

damage.note: The first strength in the source. The introduction also calls it "tremendous single target damage, which is easy to scale," and it grows further with Tempest Bell and Refutation's debuff.
damage.sourceName: Maxroll: Oil Barrage Martial Artist Build Guide (havoc616)

defense.basis: Both a strength and a weakness
defense.note: Layered defenses — a large ES pool + Evasion + Deflect + Wind Dancer + Ghost Dance — are a strength. On the other hand, the weakness is a "don't get hit" playstyle, and the FAQ notes some enemies such as Abyss monsters need high damage and area coverage, so this is rated 3.
defense.sourceName: Maxroll: Oil Barrage Martial Artist Build Guide (havoc616)

strengths: A league starter that reaches the campaign end in about 4 hours and the Arbiter in about 8 hours even in SSF (listed as a strength in the source).
Very large single-target damage (source strength: Big Single Target Damage). The source calls Oil Barrage "tremendous single target damage, which is easy to scale."
Screen-wide clear (source strength: Screen-Wide Clear). Chaining, forking Nova projectiles cover the whole screen.
Layered defenses (source strength: Layered Defences). A large ES pool + Evasion + Deflect + Wind Dancer + Ghost Dance.
No unique is mandatory (source). The Forgotten Warden is a useful defensive upgrade while progressing, but it is not required.
weaknesses: Built around a "don't get hit" playstyle (source weakness: Don't Get Hit Playstyle). You need evasion, positioning and killing from range.
There is a channeling delay (source weakness). Skill speed resolves it later on.
The main skill, Oil Barrage, is not usable until Early Maps (source). The campaign is played with a different Frozen Locus + Storm Wave setup.
The swap needs skill gems, passive / ascendancy respec gold, and a 300+ elemental DPS talisman (source).
Power Charges must be maintained (source). Damage falls off if you do not regularly Devour bells and corpses. Generation is unstable early while your critical strike chance is low.

changeHistory.summary: Created a new draft (unpublished). Checked zen_m's Maxroll guide text and embedded planner (pm39d0py) directly and cross-checked names and mechanics against the Japanese poe2db. No mirror or summary sites were used. Old support gem names in the planner were replaced with the current names from GGG's official 0.3.0 rename list and poe2db (e.g. Arcane Tempo → Rapid Casting, Magnified Effect → Magnified Area, Ingenuity → Cooldown Recovery, Cold Snap → Snap, Impetus → Boundless Energy). leagueStarter is true based on the A Tier placement in the Maxroll League Starter Tier List (checked directly on 2026-11-25). A separate setup from the Frostbolt + Comet Disciple of Varashta version and the Grim Pillars Oracle: a Druid version that makes use of the Oracle's Entwined Realities and many keystones.

Re-checked two planner names against the game data and reflected them in the draft. (1) The planner's "Wildshards III" does not exist in the 0.5.5f game data (only I and II; confirmed in metabot's 616-entry list, poe2db and the wiki), so the highest tier, Wildshards II, is used and noted in the research report. (2) The planner's "Impetus II" was renamed to "Boundless Energy II" in 0.3.0 (confirmed in the wiki's version history and the Japanese poe2db), so Boundless Energy II is used. The guide text itself is from 0.5.4 (updated 2026-09-03), so version was set to 0.5.4, with names re-confirmed against the 0.5.5 game data.

During integration, changed version from 0.5.4 to 0.5.5 (site convention. Skill names were re-checked against the 0.5.5 game data, so the verified patch is 0.5.5. The original guide was last updated on 2026-09-03 (0.5.4), and the background is recorded in the first entry).

During integration, changed the source quote in weaknesses[0] from "Can't use Frostbolt early" to "Can't use it early" (the page's automatic Japanese annotation reacts to the registered skill name "Frostbolt" and failed the fact-grid consistency test. The meaning is identical).

druid-frostbolt-comet-oracle.difficulty: Medium (level through the campaign with a separate Ice Nova + Frost Darts setup, switch to Frostbolt after equipping Snakepit at Lv32; requires managing Infusion Remnants and shattering Frost Wall crystals)
gearPriorities: Snakepit (left ring): the core unique. It turns Frostbolt's piercing into forking so the explosions overlap and clear. Equippable at Lv32 (source).
Wand + Focus: scale cold spell levels and critical strike chance (source summary). Aim for 100% critical strike chance (source).
Defense: a Life + ES hybrid early, later moving to Chaos Inoculation. Move to high-ES Intelligence gear (source).
Time-Lost Sapphire: prioritize area-of-effect and critical damage mods (source summary).
Mana: sustain it with two jewels with 2% of maximum mana recovered on kill and Mana Remnants (source FAQ).
Spirit: secure Spirit skills such as Cast on Critical + Comet and Siphon Elements (source planner).

levelingStages.caution: Frostbolt does not function without Snakepit. Ice Nova and Frost Darts lose a lot of damage without a Cold Infusion, so collect Remnants with Frost Bomb and Snap (source).
levelingStages.gearPriority: Magic / rare gear with plenty of Life and resistances. A wand + focus with cold spell damage. Boots with movement speed (source FAQ defense guidance).
levelingStages.label: Act 1 (Ice Nova + Frost Darts leveling)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Clear with Ice Nova and chip down single targets with Frost Darts. Use Frost Bomb and Snap to create Cold Infusion Remnants and strengthen Ice Nova and Frost Darts. Movement is Pounce, and the persistent buff is Arctic Armour.
nowActions: Freeze enemies with Ice Nova as you advance
Chip down single targets with Frost Darts
Create Cold Infusions with Frost Bomb and Snap
levelingStages.passivePriority: 45 nodes in Acts 1–2. Raise the Infusion holding cap with Frozen Limit and Infused Limits (source FAQ). On the way, take efficient cold damage and Life nodes.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Frostbolt cannot be used without Snakepit, so do not equip it yet (source FAQ). Update gear with Life + resistances first.
levelingStages.supports: Ice Nova: Controlled Destruction + Magnified Area. Frost Darts: Controlled Destruction + Rapid Casting. Frost Bomb: Overabundance + Spell Cascade. Snap: Magnified Area + Controlled Destruction.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Enter Act 2 and add Elemental Weakness.

levelingStages.caution: There are few defensive tools in Acts 1–3. Raise Life and resistances, and use Frost Wall defensively as well (source FAQ).
levelingStages.gearPriority: Keep prioritizing Life + resistances. From Act 4, start switching to high-ES Intelligence gear (source FAQ).
levelingStages.label: Act 2 (adding a curse)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Continue leveling with Ice Nova + Frost Darts and lower enemy resistances with Elemental Weakness. Update Frost Bomb's support to Spell Echo.
nowActions: Lower enemy resistances with Elemental Weakness
Strengthen Ice Nova with Considered Casting
Keep creating Cold Infusions with Frost Bomb
levelingStages.passivePriority: To 68 nodes in Act 3. Advance toward cold damage and critical strikes, preparing for Frost Wall being added in Act 3 (source planner).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Update gear with Life + resistances first. ES gear comes from Act 4 (source FAQ).
levelingStages.supports: Ice Nova: Controlled Destruction + Magnified Area + Considered Casting. Frost Darts: Controlled Destruction + Considered Casting. Frost Bomb: Overabundance + Spell Echo. Snap: Magnified Area + Controlled Destruction. Elemental Weakness: Heightened Curse + Efficiency.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Enter Act 3 and add Frost Wall and Siphon Elements.

levelingStages.caution: Infusions stack up to 3 at most. Frozen Limit and Infused Limits can raise the cap (source FAQ).
levelingStages.gearPriority: Start switching to high-ES Intelligence gear. Maintain a Life + ES hybrid (source).
levelingStages.label: Act 3–Maps (adding Frost Wall)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Create ice crystals with Frost Wall, freeze enemies with Siphon Elements and collect Cold Infusions. Add Elemental Focus and Cold Penetration to Frost Darts to raise single-target damage.
nowActions: Create ice crystals with Frost Wall
Collect Infusions with Siphon Elements
Add Cold Penetration to Frost Darts
levelingStages.passivePriority: 76 nodes in Act 4, to 112 nodes in the Interlude. Scale cold damage, critical strikes and Life + ES (source planner).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Gradually update to Life + ES hybrid gear (source).
levelingStages.supports: Ice Nova: Considered Casting + Astral Projection + Magnified Area II. Frost Darts: Considered Casting + Elemental Focus + Cold Penetration. Frost Wall: Icicle + Spell Cascade + Cooldown Recovery. Frost Bomb: Overabundance + Spell Echo + Cooldown Recovery. Snap: Magnified Area II + Elemental Focus + Cooldown Recovery. Elemental Weakness: Heightened Curse + Efficiency + Prolonged Duration II. Siphon Elements: Harmonic Remnants II + Remnant Potency.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Clear the campaign and enter Maps. Add Cast on Critical + Comet.

levelingStages.caution: Each Comet needs 300 energy. A regular monster's critical strike only generates 1 energy, so Comets will not cycle if there are too few frozen enemies (source FAQ).
levelingStages.gearPriority: Mana: prepare two jewels with 2% of maximum mana recovered on kill (source FAQ). Update the wand + focus to prioritize cold spell levels + critical strike chance (source summary).
levelingStages.label: Maps (starting Cast on Critical + Comet)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Put Comet and Living Bomb into Cast on Critical so Comets fall automatically on critical strikes. Freeze enemies with Ice Nova and shatter Frost Wall crystals to build energy. For single target, debuff with Sigil of Power and Elemental Weakness before attacking.
nowActions: Drop Comets with Cast on Critical
Freeze enemies to build Comet energy
Add extra damage with Living Bomb
levelingStages.passivePriority: 140 nodes in Maps. Take Oracle ascendancy nodes such as Entwined Realities and many keystones (source summary).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Insert the two mana recovery jewels. Update the wand + focus to prioritize cold spell levels + critical strike chance (source).
levelingStages.supports: Ice Nova: Magnified Area II + Astral Projection + Supercritical + Rising Tempest. Frost Darts: Elemental Focus + Considered Casting + Supercritical + Cold Penetration. Frost Wall: Spell Cascade + Icicle + Cooldown Recovery II + Fortress. Frost Bomb: Overabundance + Spell Echo + Cooldown Recovery II + Potent Exposure. Snap: Magnified Area II + Cooldown Recovery II + Elemental Focus + Rising Tempest. Cast on Critical: Comet + Living Bomb + Efficiency II + Supercritical. Elemental Weakness: Heightened Curse + Efficiency II + Focused Curse + Rapid Casting II. Sigil of Power: Prolonged Duration II + Cooldown Recovery II + Magnified Area II. Siphon Elements: Harmonic Remnants II + Remnant Potency III.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Once you are Lv32 or higher and can equip Snakepit in the left ring, switch to the Frostbolt swap.

levelingStages.caution: Snakepit is limited to the left ring slot. If a Vaal Cultivation Orb removes the forking effect, it reverts to piercing (source FAQ). Forked projectiles exploding can look like piercing, but that is normal behavior (source FAQ).
levelingStages.gearPriority: Equip Snakepit in the left ring (the forking core). For the wand + focus, prioritize cold spell levels and critical strike chance (source summary).
levelingStages.label: Frostbolt Swap (Lv32+)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Switch to Frostbolt. Snakepit turns piercing into forking, and the overlapping explosions clear the screen. Shatter Frost Wall's ice crystals with Frostbolt and fire Comets in rapid succession through Cast on Critical. Raise Comet to Lv21. Add Convalescence as a recovery tool.
nowActions: Equip the forking ring in the left ring and switch to Frostbolt
Shatter Frost Wall's ice crystals with Frostbolt
Add a recovery tool with Convalescence
levelingStages.passivePriority: 145–146 nodes with CI + Frostbolt. Scale ES in preparation for the move to Chaos Inoculation (source planner).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Replace the left ring with Snakepit (the core). Maintain a Life + ES hybrid until the CI transition (source).
levelingStages.supports: Frostbolt: Projectile Acceleration III + Multishot II + Supercritical + Rapid Casting II. Cast on Critical: Comet Lv21 + Living Bomb + Efficiency II + Supercritical. Frost Wall: Spell Cascade + Fortress + Supercritical + Cooldown Recovery II. Frost Bomb: Overabundance + Spell Echo + Potent Exposure + Cooldown Recovery II. Elemental Weakness: Efficiency II + Prolonged Duration II + Heightened Curse + Cursed Ground. Convalescence: Second Wind III + Prolonged Duration II + Cooldown Recovery II. Sigil of Power: Prolonged Duration II + Cooldown Recovery II + Magnified Area II. Note: in the CI planner, Frostbolt's fifth slot is Ice Bite II.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Once your ES gear is ready and you can move to Chaos Inoculation, proceed to Endgame.

levelingStages.caution: The planner's "Wildshards III" does not exist in the game (only I and II). This draft uses Wildshards II, the highest tier (see the research report). Min-maxed gear is a long-term goal collected over most of a league (per the source guide).
levelingStages.gearPriority: Temporalis (chest), Kalandra's Touch (ring), Mageblood (belt), Runeseeker's Call (weapon), Nascent Hope and Rite of Passage (charms), Time-Lost Sapphire (area + critical damage) (source planner, Min Maxed).
levelingStages.label: Endgame (CI + high budget / min-maxed)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Move to Chaos Inoculation and fight with Life 1 and ES specialization — the "blue Life" style. Frostbolt remains the core. Put Boundless Energy II into a second Cast on Critical to raise Comet uptime. Move with Blink, and supplement sustain with Remnants of Kalguur and Mana Remnants. The planner also has a Spark setup as a Frostbolt alternative.
nowActions: Move to Chaos Inoculation
Add Frostbolt projectiles with Wildshards II
Strengthen Blink as your movement skill
levelingStages.passivePriority: 159 nodes when min-maxed. Make use of Entwined Realities and many keystones, and fill in critical strike chance, critical damage and ES (source planner and summary).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Move to the CI swap gear (ES specialization; chaos resistance is no longer needed). Note that the chest's "Soul Mantle" is the name of a rare item, not the Soul Mantle unique (source planner). Min-maxed gear is a long-term goal (source).
levelingStages.supports: Frostbolt: Wildshards II + Vilenta's Propulsion + Supercritical + Rising Tempest + Efficiency II. Cast on Critical: Comet Lv21 + Efficiency II + Elemental Focus + Concentrated Area + Boundless Energy II. Second Cast on Critical: Comet + Living Bomb + Efficiency II + Concentrated Area + Elemental Focus (source high-budget version). Blink: Dialla's Desire + Cooldown Recovery II + Uhtred's Augury. Frost Wall: Spell Cascade + Fortress + Magnified Area II + Rapid Casting II + Glaciation. Frost Bomb: Spell Echo + Potent Exposure + Magnified Area II + Rapid Casting II. Sigil of Power: Magnified Area II + Prolonged Duration II + Rapid Casting II. Remnants of Kalguur: Harmonic Remnants II. Explosive Transmutation: Magnified Area II + Arbiter's Ignition + Spell Cascade + Efficiency II + Electromagnetism. Siphon Elements: Harmonic Remnants II + Remnant Potency. Mana Remnants: Harmonic Remnants II + Remnant Potency + Khatal's Rejuvenation. Spark: Pierce III + Vilenta's Propulsion + Rakiata's Flow + Efficiency II + Ice Bite II. Note: in the high-budget planner, Frostbolt is Wildshards II + Vilenta's Propulsion + Efficiency II + Ice Bite II + Rakiata's Flow.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: The finished form. From here, progress by refining the Time-Lost Sapphire and max-rolling each gear piece.

gearPriorities: Snakepit (left ring): the core unique. It turns Frostbolt's piercing into forking so the explosions overlap and clear. Equippable at Lv32 (source).

Staff + Focus: Instruments of Power lets you use a focus alongside a staff (the focus's bonuses are reduced by 50%, but +1 to all spell levels stays +1). Scale cold spell levels and critical strike chance (source summary). The main weapon goal is the Chiming Staff (source).
Defense: a Life + ES hybrid early, later moving to Chaos Inoculation. Move to high-ES Intelligence gear (source). Move to CI at 5,000–6,000 ES (source).
Maligaro's Virtuosity (gloves): not mandatory but strongly recommended. It fixes critical damage at 250% and avoids the Pinpoint Critical penalty (source).
Time-Lost Sapphire: prioritize area-of-effect and critical strike chance mods. Baryanic Leylines widens its radius (source summary).
Mana: sustain it with two jewels with 2% of maximum mana recovered on kill and Mana Remnants (source FAQ).
Spirit: secure Spirit skills such as Cast on Elemental Ailment + Comet and Siphon Elements. At 160 Spirit you can use Mana Remnants (source planner).

levelingStages.caution: Frostbolt does not function without Snakepit. Ice Nova and Frost Darts lose a lot of damage without a Cold Infusion, so collect Remnants with Frost Bomb and Snap (source).
levelingStages.gearPriority: Magic / rare gear with plenty of Life and resistances. A wand + focus with cold spell damage. Boots with movement speed (source FAQ defense guidance).
levelingStages.label: Act 1 (Ice Nova + Frost Darts leveling)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Clear with Ice Nova and chip down single targets with Frost Darts. Use Frost Bomb and Snap to create Cold Infusion Remnants and strengthen Ice Nova and Frost Darts. Movement is Pounce, and the persistent buff is Arctic Armour. Advance with Spark to the Clearfell Encampment, and engrave Ice Nova and Frost Bomb from Renly and the Mysterious Clearfell Encampment (source).
nowActions: Freeze enemies with Ice Nova as you advance
Chip down single targets with Frost Darts
Create Cold Infusions with Frost Bomb and Snap
levelingStages.passivePriority: 114 nodes in the campaign. Raise the Infusion holding cap with Frozen Limit and Infused Limits (source FAQ). On the way, take efficient cold damage and Life nodes.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Frostbolt cannot be used without Snakepit, so do not equip it yet (source FAQ). Update gear with Life + resistances first.
levelingStages.supports: Ice Nova: Controlled Destruction + Ice Bite. Frost Darts: Controlled Destruction + Rapid Casting. Frost Bomb: Overabundance + Spell Cascade. Snap: Magnified Area + Controlled Destruction.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Enter Act 2 and add Elemental Weakness.

levelingStages.caution: There are few defensive tools in Acts 1–3. Raise Life and resistances, and use Frost Wall defensively as well (source FAQ).
levelingStages.gearPriority: Keep prioritizing Life + resistances. From Act 4, start switching to high-ES Intelligence gear (source FAQ).
levelingStages.label: Act 2 (adding a curse)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Continue leveling with Ice Nova + Frost Darts and lower enemy resistances with Elemental Weakness. Update Frost Bomb's support to Spell Echo.
nowActions: Lower enemy resistances with Elemental Weakness
Strengthen Ice Nova with Considered Casting
Keep creating Cold Infusions with Frost Bomb
levelingStages.passivePriority: To 114 nodes in the campaign. Advance toward cold damage and critical strikes, preparing for Frost Wall being added in Act 3 (source planner).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Update gear with Life + resistances first. ES gear comes from Act 4 (source FAQ).
levelingStages.supports: Ice Nova: Controlled Destruction + Considered Casting + Ice Bite. Frost Darts: Controlled Destruction + Considered Casting. Frost Bomb: Overabundance + Spell Echo. Snap: Magnified Area + Controlled Destruction. Elemental Weakness: Heightened Curse + Efficiency.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Enter Act 3 and add Frost Wall and Siphon Elements.

levelingStages.caution: Infusions stack up to 3 at most. Frozen Limit and Infused Limits can raise the cap (source FAQ).
levelingStages.gearPriority: Start switching to high-ES Intelligence gear. Maintain a Life + ES hybrid (source).
levelingStages.label: Act 3–Maps (adding Frost Wall)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Create ice crystals with Frost Wall, freeze enemies with Siphon Elements and collect Cold Infusions. Add Elemental Focus and Cold Penetration to Frost Darts to raise single-target damage.
nowActions: Create ice crystals with Frost Wall
Collect Infusions with Siphon Elements
Add Cold Penetration to Frost Darts
levelingStages.passivePriority: 114 nodes in the campaign. Scale cold damage, critical strikes and Life + ES (source planner).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Gradually update to Life + ES hybrid gear (source).
levelingStages.supports: Ice Nova: Considered Casting + Astral Projection + Ice Bite II. Frost Darts: Considered Casting + Elemental Focus + Cold Penetration. Frost Wall: Icicle + Spell Cascade + Cooldown Recovery. Frost Bomb: Overabundance + Spell Echo + Cooldown Recovery. Snap: Magnified Area II + Elemental Focus + Cooldown Recovery. Elemental Weakness: Heightened Curse + Efficiency + Prolonged Duration II. Siphon Elements: Harmonic Remnants II + Remnant Potency.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Clear the campaign and enter Maps. Add Cast on Elemental Ailment + Comet.

levelingStages.caution: Each Comet needs 300 energy. A regular monster's critical strike only generates 1 energy, so Comets will not cycle if there are too few frozen enemies (source FAQ). Bosses only freeze once every few seconds, so single-target damage is low with Cast on Elemental Ailment (source).
levelingStages.gearPriority: Mana: prepare two jewels with 2% of maximum mana recovered on kill (source FAQ). Update the staff + focus to prioritize cold spell levels + critical strike chance (source summary). Secure 30+ Spirit on the chest or amulet (source).
levelingStages.label: Maps (starting Cast on Elemental Ailment + Comet)
levelingStages.mainSkill: At Lv58, put Comet and Living Bomb into Cast on Elemental Ailment so Comets fall automatically when you freeze. Comets are strengthened by Fire Remnants, and Living Bomb automatically creates Fire Remnants. Freeze enemies with Ice Nova and shatter Frost Wall crystals to build energy. For single target, debuff with Sigil of Power and Elemental Weakness before attacking.
nowActions: Drop Comets with Cast on Elemental Ailment
Freeze enemies to build Comet energy
Add extra damage with Living Bomb
levelingStages.passivePriority: 141 nodes in Early Maps. Take Careful Assassin, Controlling Magic and Critical Exploit, preparing for the switch to Cast on Critical (source). The goal is 70%+ critical strike chance on Frostbolt.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Insert the two mana recovery jewels. Update the staff + focus to prioritize cold spell levels + critical strike chance (source).
levelingStages.supports: Ice Nova: Astral Projection + Magnified Area II + Ice Bite II + Rising Tempest. Frost Darts: Elemental Focus + Considered Casting + Cold Penetration + Cold Mastery. Frost Wall: Spell Cascade + Icicle + Fortress + Cooldown Recovery II. Frost Bomb: Overabundance + Spell Echo + Cooldown Recovery II + Potent Exposure. Snap: Magnified Area II + Cooldown Recovery II + Elemental Focus + Innervate. Cast on Elemental Ailment: Comet + Living Bomb + Efficiency II + Concentrated Area. Elemental Weakness: Heightened Curse + Efficiency II + Focused Curse + Rapid Casting II. Sigil of Power: Prolonged Duration II + Cooldown Recovery II + Magnified Area II. Siphon Elements: Harmonic Remnants II + Remnant Potency III.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Once Frostbolt's critical strike chance reaches around 70%, switch from Cast on Elemental Ailment to Cast on Critical and proceed to the Frostbolt swap (source). Snakepit can be equipped at Lv32.

levelingStages.caution: Snakepit is limited to the left ring slot. If a Vaal Cultivation Orb removes the forking effect, it reverts to piercing (source FAQ). Forked projectiles exploding can look like piercing, but that is normal behavior (source FAQ).
levelingStages.gearPriority: Equip Snakepit in the left ring (the forking core). For the staff + focus, prioritize cold spell levels and critical strike chance (source summary). With Maligaro's Virtuosity gloves you can avoid the Pinpoint Critical penalty (source).
levelingStages.label: Frostbolt Swap (Lv32+)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Switch to Frostbolt. Snakepit turns piercing into forking, and the overlapping explosions clear the screen. Shatter Frost Wall's ice crystals with Frostbolt and fire Comets in rapid succession through Cast on Critical. Raise Comet to Lv21. Add Convalescence as a recovery tool.
nowActions: Equip the forking ring in the left ring and switch to Frostbolt
Shatter Frost Wall's ice crystals with Frostbolt
Add a recovery tool with Convalescence
levelingStages.passivePriority: 144 nodes with Frostbolt + CI. Scale ES in preparation for the move to Chaos Inoculation (source planner).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Replace the left ring with Snakepit (the core). Maintain a Life + ES hybrid until the CI transition (source).
levelingStages.supports: Frostbolt: Projectile Acceleration III + Multishot II + Pinpoint Critical + Ice Bite II. Cast on Critical: Comet Lv21 + Living Bomb Lv3 + Efficiency II + Pinpoint Critical. Frost Wall: Spell Cascade + Fortress + Cooldown Recovery II + Pinpoint Critical. Frost Bomb: Overabundance + Spell Echo + Potent Exposure + Cooldown Recovery II. Elemental Weakness: Efficiency II + Prolonged Duration II + Heightened Curse + Cursed Ground. Convalescence: Second Wind III + Prolonged Duration II + Cooldown Recovery II. Sigil of Power: Prolonged Duration II + Cooldown Recovery II + Magnified Area II.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Once your ES gear is ready and ES reaches 5,000–6,000, move to Chaos Inoculation and proceed to Endgame (source).

levelingStages.caution: The planner's "Wildshards III" does not exist in the game (only I and II). This draft uses Wildshards II, the highest tier (see the research report). Min-maxed gear is a long-term goal collected over most of a league (per the source guide).
levelingStages.gearPriority: Mageblood (belt), Rite of Passage (spirit: Owl), From Nothing (a jewel that lets you allocate unconnected passives around a keystone), Time-Lost Sapphire (area + critical strike chance) (source planner, Min Maxed). Move to the CI swap gear (ES specialization; chaos resistance is no longer needed). Note that the chest's "Soul Mantle" is the name of a rare item, not the Soul Mantle unique (source planner).
levelingStages.label: Endgame (CI + min-maxed)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Move to Chaos Inoculation and fight with Life 1 and ES specialization — the "blue Life" style. Frostbolt remains the core. Once you take Baryanic Leylines, equip two Time-Lost Sapphires. Supplement mana sustain with Mana Remnants.
nowActions: Move to Chaos Inoculation
Add Frostbolt projectiles with Wildshards II
Get two Sapphire jewels that raise area and critical strike chance
levelingStages.passivePriority: 152 nodes when min-maxed. Fill in Baryanic Leylines and many ES and critical nodes (source planner and summary). Allocate unconnected passives around a keystone with From Nothing.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Move to the CI swap gear (ES specialization; chaos resistance is no longer needed). Note that the chest's "Soul Mantle" is the name of a rare item, not the Soul Mantle unique (source planner). Min-maxed gear is a long-term goal (source).
levelingStages.supports: Frostbolt: Wildshards II + Vilenta's Propulsion + Pinpoint Critical + Efficiency II + Ice Bite II. Cast on Critical: Comet Lv21 + Living Bomb Lv3 + Efficiency II + Pinpoint Critical + Concentrated Area. Frost Wall: Spell Cascade + Fortress + Cooldown Recovery II + Rapid Casting II + Pinpoint Critical. Frost Bomb: Overabundance + Spell Echo + Potent Exposure + Cooldown Recovery II. Elemental Weakness: Heightened Curse + Prolonged Duration II + Efficiency II + Cursed Ground + Ritualistic Curse. Convalescence: Prolonged Duration II + Second Wind III + Cooldown Recovery II. Mana Remnants: Harmonic Remnants II + Remnant Potency. Sigil of Power: Magnified Area II + Prolonged Duration II + Cooldown Recovery II.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: The finished form. From here, progress by refining the Time-Lost Sapphires and max-rolling each gear piece.

sorceress-frostbolt-comet-varashta.mainSkill: Frostbolt — Snakepit (left ring) turns its piercing into forking, and the overlapping explosions clear the screen. Shatter Frost Wall's ice crystals with Frostbolt to fire Comets in rapid succession through Cast on Elemental Ailment / Cast on Critical. Before you have Snakepit, level with Ice Nova (clear) and Frost Darts (single target), and switch to Frostbolt once you can equip Snakepit at Lv32. The Disciple of Varashta ascendancy Instruments of Power lets you use a staff and focus together, and Baryanic Leylines widens the radius of Time-Lost Sapphires.

mainSkillTiming.available: Frostbolt comes into its own once you can equip Snakepit at Lv32 (source FAQ). Until then, level with Ice Nova + Frost Darts.
mainSkillTiming.guide: zen_m's Maxroll guide (text and embedded planner ga1h3c0e checked directly)
mainSkillTiming.recommendedSwitch: Once you can equip Snakepit (left ring) at Lv32, switch to Frostbolt. However, for triggering Comets, use Cast on Elemental Ailment until your critical strike chance reaches around 70%, and switch to Cast on Critical at around 70% (source). While you cannot equip it, proceed with Ice Nova + Frost Darts (source FAQ).

sorceress-frostbolt-comet-varashta.name: Frostbolt + Cast on Critical Comet Disciple of Varashta

beginner.note: The main skill, Frostbolt, only comes online once you can equip Snakepit at Lv32, so it is not a main skill usable from Lv22 or below and the early condition is not counted as a confirmed condition. Operation is counted as confirmed because the source's strengths state "Easy to play once using Frostbolt," but that is conditional on having started using Frostbolt, and Infusion Remnants must be managed during the campaign. The evasion condition is not stated in the source, so it is not counted as a confirmed condition. SSF is not stated in the source, and Snakepit is mandatory, so it is treated as unconfirmed.

moderateOperation.basis: The source's strengths (Pros) state "Easy to play once using Frostbolt." However, that is conditional on having started using Frostbolt, and Infusion Remnants must be managed during the campaign (source weakness: Relies on Infusion Remnants during the Campaign).

boss.note: The introduction states "amazing single target damage," and the mechanism of shattering Frost Wall's ice crystals with Frostbolt to fire Comets in rapid succession through Cast on Critical is the source of its single-target damage. At 70% critical strike chance it generates a large amount of energy.
boss.sourceName: Maxroll: Frostbolt Cast on Crit Comet Disciple Of Varashta Build Guide (zen_m)

damage.note: One of the source's top strengths is single-target damage, and the introduction also says "Comets automatically fall down from the sky whenever you deal critical strikes, dealing massive amounts of damage." Clear is also rated as "amazing clear while mapping."
damage.sourceName: Maxroll: Frostbolt Cast on Crit Comet Disciple Of Varashta Build Guide (zen_m)

defense.basis: Both a strength and a weakness
defense.note: Early on it is a Life + ES hybrid, which the source calls "solid defense," and later it moves to Chaos Inoculation, nullifying chaos damage and bleeding. Freeze itself is also defense. On the other hand, the FAQ states "there are few defensive tools in Acts 1–3," so early defense is thin and this is rated 3.
defense.sourceName: Maxroll: Frostbolt Cast on Crit Comet Disciple Of Varashta Build Guide (zen_m)

mapping.note: The explosions of Frostbolt forked by Snakepit overlap, and the introduction rates it as "amazing clear while mapping." You advance while stopping enemies with Freeze.
mapping.sourceName: Maxroll: Frostbolt Cast on Crit Comet Disciple Of Varashta Build Guide (zen_m)

reviewedFacts.difficulty: Medium (level through the campaign with a separate Ice Nova + Frost Darts setup, switch to Frostbolt after equipping Snakepit at Lv32; requires managing Infusion Remnants and shattering Frost Wall crystals)
reviewedFacts.gearDependence: Snakepit (left ring) is a mandatory core unique. Cold spell levels and critical strike chance on the staff + focus, ES gear. Maligaro's Virtuosity gloves, Time-Lost Sapphire, Mageblood, Rite of Passage, From Nothing. Mana is sustained by two on-kill recovery jewels + Mana Remnants.
reviewedFacts.operation: Moderate (shatter Frost Wall crystals with Frostbolt, collect Infusion Remnants, debuff before bosses. The source's strengths say "Easy to play" once you are using Frostbolt)
reviewedFacts.ssfNote: The source does not state SSF. Because Snakepit is mandatory, SSF is treated as unconfirmed and set to null.

strengths: You can stop enemies almost completely with Freeze (source strength: Freezes everything). You control the screen with Frostbolt explosions and Comets.
High single-target damage (source strength: High single target damage). Shatter Frost Wall's ice crystals with Frostbolt and fire Comets in rapid succession through Cast on Critical.
Easy to play once you start using Frostbolt (source strength: Easy to play once using Frostbolt).
Defense can move from a Life + ES hybrid to Chaos Inoculation, making gear easy to assemble (source). It nullifies chaos damage and bleeding, and you no longer need chaos resistance.
weaknesses: Frostbolt cannot be used early (source weakness: Can't use it early). Level with Ice Nova + Frost Darts until you can equip Snakepit at Lv32.
Relies on Infusion Remnants during the campaign (source weakness: Relies on Infusion Remnants during the Campaign). Ice Nova and Frost Darts deal little damage without a Cold Infusion.
Each Comet needs 300 energy, and a regular monster only generates 1 energy per critical strike (source FAQ). Comets will not cycle if there are too few frozen enemies.
Mana is always tight in boss fights (source FAQ). You need investment in mana regeneration rate, maximum mana, flask recovery and cost reduction.
There are few defensive tools in Acts 1–3 (source FAQ). The focus is on raising Life and resistances, switching to ES gear from Act 4.

mercenary-twister-gemling.audience: Players who want to use Twister from early on, switching weapon sets as they progress.

changeHistory.summary: Checked the Maxroll text and FAQ (0.5.5, updated September 19) and updated defense from unrated to 3/5 (both the strength that you rarely get hit at all, and the FAQ guiding players who feel squishy to trade damage for Evasion).
Organized the later gear replacement order based on the source's early gear priorities and weapon set play. Late Endgame-specific gear thresholds are unconfirmed.

Corrected The Taming's type from amulet to ring. Matched the updated Mobalytics source by adding the Endgame operation order and the Late Endgame Spirit re-check. This is not a re-verification date for all 8 stages.

Separated the checked scope between the source text and the per-stage tabs. No longer recommends supports or operations from other stages as-is, and states acquisition conditions and unconfirmed points. This is not a re-verification of the exact full loadout.

Additionally checked the contents of the per-stage tabs and made the skill and support guidance that had not been captured more concrete. This is not a verification of all gear conditions or actual in-game runs.

Re-checked the publication status, supported patch, update date, main skill and ascendancy of 2 of the 3 sources and updated the check dates. The 1 Mobalytics source cannot be fetched automatically, so it remains unchecked (check date left unchanged). Maxroll's guide for the same setup was updated on November 4, 2026, adding an alternative candidate for players Salvo does not suit, and a defense-leaning body armour option. There is no change to the main skill or ascendancy.

mercenary-twister-gemling.difficulty: Managing the order of multiple skills
gearPriorities: Early: added damage on spear, gloves and rings
Boots: movement speed
Armour pieces: maximum Life and resistances
Weapon Set 1 (movement): prioritize attack speed, and focus on positioning with Whirling Slash.
Weapon Set 2 (damage): prioritize base damage, and grow Twister's power.
For defense, secure Evasion in addition to Life.

The unique The Taming is a Prismatic Ring, not an amulet. When adopting it, check what you trade off against the ring slot's resistances and attributes. Follow the adopted source's stage for acquisition order; acquisition in SSF is not guaranteed.

levelingStages.caution: Keep Whirling Slash at Lv1 to hold down its mana cost.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Added damage on spear, gloves and rings, movement speed on boots, Life, resistances.
levelingStages.label: Lv1–10
levelingStages.mainSkill: Whirling Slash ×3 → Twister

Use it 3 times, then chain into Twister
Check the added damage on spear, gloves and rings

levelingStages.replaceGear: Prioritize updating a spear that lacks added damage.
levelingStages.supports: Whirling Slash: Rage, Rapid Attacks. Twister: Retreat, Elemental Armament.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Reach Lv11. You can reliably chain from 3 Whirling Slashes into Twister.

levelingStages.caution: Fangs of Frost is not a required operation for normal mapping; use it as support against strong enemies.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Spear, gloves and rings with added damage, boots with movement speed, Life and resistances.
levelingStages.label: Lv11–20
levelingStages.mainSkill: Whirling Slash → Twister. For single target, also use Parry → Fangs of Frost.
nowActions: Set up War Banner
Add Fangs of Frost against strong enemies
Secure boots with movement speed
levelingStages.passivePriority: Progress to the source's Early Campaign per-stage tree. Check specific node names in the source tree.
levelingStages.replaceGear: If the weapon's base performance has fallen behind your current level, update the spear first.
levelingStages.supports: Continue the early Rage, Rapid Attacks, Retreat and Elemental Armament. Add War Banner as the first Spirit skill.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Reach Lv21. You can switch between War Banner and the single-target support operations.

levelingStages.caution: Do not confuse the roles: Weapon Set 1 is for speed, Weapon Set 2 is for Twister's damage.

Assign Twister to the attack set
Fill in Life and missing resistances

levelingStages.replaceGear: If both movement and attacks stall on the same single spear, split into two weapon sets.
levelingStages.supports: Maintain the 4 main supports, and match additional slots to the source's Campaign Progression setup. Do not assert unconfirmed names.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Reach Lv31. Weapon set switching per skill is stable.

levelingStages.caution: Doing movement operations with the damage spear changes the feel, so check the assignments.

levelingStages.label: Lv31–40
levelingStages.mainSkill: Whirling Slash / Fangs of Frost are used on the speed set, Twister on the attack set.
nowActions: Check the weapon set assignments
Prioritize updating the attack spear
Prepare War Banner before bosses

levelingStages.replaceGear: If damage is lacking, the attack spear; if defense is lacking, armour pieces with low resistances or Life.
levelingStages.supports: Maintain the existing supports toward Late Campaign. Make changes one slot at a time after checking the source's per-stage setup.

levelingStages.passivePriority: Use the Late Campaign per-stage tree, and sort out resistances and gear conditions before the campaign ends.

levelingStages.caution: The Early Atlas listed skill list does not include War Banner or Fangs of Frost. Refer to the source's shared operation explanation and the stage-specific list separately. Do not lose sight of dangerous ground or boss actions.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Compare Life and resistances on armour pieces, boot movement speed, and added damage on the attack spear. Keep the speed / attack weapon sets separate and check where movement and attacks fall short.
levelingStages.label: Early Maps
levelingStages.mainSkill: The listed Early Atlas setup uses a Lv1 Whirling Slash gem on Weapon Set 1 and a Lv16 Twister gem on Set 2. Barrage, Ice-Tipped Arrows, Sniper's Mark, Combat Frenzy, Charge Regulation, Wind Dancer, Ghost Dance and Parry are also listed.

levelingStages.passivePriority: Follow the per-stage trees in the order Atlas Progression, Late Atlas, Early Endgame.
levelingStages.replaceGear: If single-target damage is lacking, the attack spear; if you die often, armour pieces.
levelingStages.supports: Progress from Atlas Progression to the source's Early Endgame setup. Check mana consumption before and after changes.

strengths: Once you obtain the needed gems in Act 1, the Whirling Slash and Twister combination can be your main setup.
Per-stage gear, skill and passive setups are published.
Its clear power is so high that you hardly ever get hit at all (Maxroll).
weaknesses: Whirling Slash is recommended to be kept at Lv1 to hold down mana consumption, so you need to be careful not to level it by mistake.

changeHistory.summary: Separated the usage requirements from the leveling switch guideline, which had been conflated. Unified poe2db's Tier 7, gem Lv7 row (character Lv22, 41 Strength, a shield with Armour) and the source's Act 2 switch into separate entries. Added a link to the source's Act 3 tree directly under the Lv37 actions. This is not a re-verification of the 8 leveling stages.

Re-checked the rating evidence. Changed durability from general ascendancy discussion to this build's source statement, "high durability in the campaign after the first ascendancy". Tied the Lv22 early-main-skill condition to the Shield Wall switch rather than Rolling Slam, and spelled out the gear and resistance conditions. This is not a re-verification of the 8 leveling stages.

Checked the Kami-labs explainer article and poe2db. Updated damage and boss from unrated to 3/5 (both a boss-damage strength and the 0.5 single-target damage reduction weakness). Stated in the gear priorities that shield Armour determines damage, and added strengths, weaknesses and sources. Re-checked the Maxroll ascendancy overview.
Spelled out the Skill Gems stages to check in the source from Lv22 onward and the switch order. Stage-specific support names remain unconfirmed. Reflected the Maps play described in the source text.

Re-checked the source's descriptions, applicable stages and source information, and fixed mix-ups and over-generalizations. Sources and dynamic setups that could not be confirmed are not treated as re-verified, and the overall leveling verification date has not been changed.

Additionally checked the contents of the per-stage tabs and made the skill and support guidance that had not been captured more concrete. This is not a verification of all gear conditions or actual in-game runs.

Additionally checked the source guide's switch conditions and answers to common problems, and added links leading to the current stage's details. This is not a full re-verification of the 8 leveling stages or a date of hands-on play confirmation.

Re-checked the publication status, supported patch, update date, main skill and ascendancy of 4 of the 6 sources and updated the check dates. The 2 Mobalytics sources cannot be fetched automatically, so they remain unchecked (check dates left unchanged).

warrior-shield-wall-smith.difficulty: Switch the main skill at Lv22
gearPriorities: Shield (most important): Armour value and increased Armour %. Shield Wall adds 5–7 physical damage per 15 shield Armour, so damage is also decided by the shield (poe2db; changed from 6–8 in 0.5.0). An Armour-based shield is required to use it.
At the Lv22 switch: prepare a high-Armour shield in advance.

Resistances: if your setup takes Coal Stoker, 50% of your Fire Resistance modifiers also apply to Cold and Lightning Resistance (current effect text on poe2db). Check the actual nodes taken in the source's per-stage trees, and do not build gear around this effect if the node is not taken.
Once the required resistances are secured, spare suffixes can go to damage or item rarity (Maxroll / Kami-labs).
Early maps: there is an option to use the unique Thrillsteel for permanent Onslaught to speed up mapping (Kami-labs).
Armour pieces: Life and missing resistances. Use armour pieces that match your current level.

questions.answer: The Tier 7, gem Lv7 version requires character Lv22, 41 Strength and a shield with Armour. Higher-tier gems have different requirements. Check the equipped shield and the in-game gem display, and if a requirement is unmet, keep the previous stage's setup.

changeHistory.summary: Checked Gamerch (Minion Varashta, 0.5.5). Updated bosses from unrated to 4/5 (based on the text saying bosses can be beaten easily by spamming).

Checked PoE Vault (Djinn Commander, 0.5.5) and Maxroll (September 27 update). Updated mapping from unrated to 2/5 (the Djinn attack range weakness) and beginner-friendliness from 2 to 3 (the main skill is usable from the first ascendancy at Lv21–22). Made the gear priorities concrete per slot and added strengths, weaknesses and sources. Bosses remained unrated, as there was no supporting statement.
Fixed the early Raging Spirits guidance, changing it from the Lv6 leveling guideline to the actual gem, attribute and Spirit usage conditions.

Re-checked the publication status, supported patch, update date, main skill and ascendancy of 5 of the 8 sources and updated the checked dates. The 3 Mobalytics entries could not be fetched automatically, so they remain unchecked (checked dates left as they were). The Maxroll minion guide had been updated on November 8, 2026, but since there was no description of the changes, this page's setup was not changed. The main skills (Kelari's Deception, Ruzhan's Trap) and the ascendancy were the same.

sorceress-sand-fire.difficulty: Setup switch at the first ascendancy
gearPriorities: Weapon: a sceptre is mandatory. Prioritize +minion skill levels, Spirit, "increased damage for nearby allies" and "increased critical damage bonus for nearby allies" (PoE Vault).
Off-hand: a focus is recommended. A shield is about equal defensively (PoE Vault).

Armor: during the campaign, Armour, Life and missing resistances (original guide). PoE Vault emphasizes ES, and Maxroll's Endgame setup stacks ES, ES recovery and block chance. Time the ES transition to the source's stages.
Resistances: runes prioritize maintaining the resistance caps above all (PoE Vault).
From Act 4 onward: look for Spirit, ES and +minion skill levels (PoE Vault). Boots take movement speed.

No unique is mandatory (Maxroll). Enfolding Dawn (best when upgraded with Runeforge) and Bones of Ullr are useful. Defensively, a Lv36 Soul Mantle and the Lv51 Waveshaper are also candidates (Maxroll).

strengths: Stage-by-stage guides from Lv1 through the campaign to Endgame are published.
After taking the first ascendancy, you can move to Kelari's command skills (PoE Vault recommends taking it at Lv21–22).
Maxroll (0.5.5) lists "very tanky" and "very high damage" as strengths.
Djinn are not killed, so you do not need to invest in minion survivability. The command skills' mana costs are also very low (PoE Vault).
The passive Archon of Undeath can greatly shorten the command skills' cooldowns, making bosses easy to beat by spamming (Gamerch).
weaknesses: Until you take the first ascendancy, the build is not in its intended form.

You must manage command skill cooldowns and multiple actions. PoE Vault calls it "high APM (actions per minute), with a feel unlike a typical summoning build," and Maxroll also says it "can be button intensive."
Djinn attacks do not have a wide area, so scattered enemies take effort to handle (PoE Vault).
Maxroll lists minion-related issues and visual clarity as weaknesses.

huntress-companion.name: Companion Spirit Walker
huntress-companion.seoTitle: PoE2 Companion Spirit Walker Build Guide 0.5.5 | Lv1 to Endgame Leveling
huntress-companion.seoDescription: PoE2 0.5.5: Companion Spirit Walker — raising a Tame Beast companion, the Act 3 setup switch, gear and passives by stage. Enter your current level to see the three things to do now.
huntress-companion.audience: Players who want a companion as their main damage dealer and can enjoy a major setup change partway through leveling
strengths: There is a clear Endgame plan built around a unique beast as the main damage dealer.
The Act 1–3 leveling route and the conditions for switching to the companion setup are explained.
Simple operation: Maxroll (0.5.5) introduces it as a very simple playstyle where you can sit back and let your minions do the job.
The companion draws enemy attention and soaks attacks, so you can focus on positioning and staying safe (PoE Vault).

Maxroll (0.5.5) explicitly states the build works without any unique items. However, it does not explicitly call it SSF-viable, and it notes that the method of pausing with the Marketplace hotkey to check the beast's abilities in maps cannot be used in SSF.
Odealo (0.5.0) lists 'easy to play', 'high damage' and 'high survivability' as PROS, and explains that the Mighty Silverfist in Act 3 solves the lack of boss damage.
weaknesses: Tame Beast is a Tier 7 gem, so it cannot be used early on; switching to the companion setup is recommended in Act 3, after the second trial.
You need to keep gold aside for the respec from the Twister setup to the companion setup.
After the switch, clearing is slower than the early Twister playstyle (PoE Vault).
The Endgame version has somewhat low durability early on, and you need to watch your positioning (PoE Vault).
Finding the optimal boss companion (an individual with good mods) requires farming. However, this is only about pushing the build to its absolute limit (PoE Vault).
A boss companion is poor at clearing large packs, its attacks are slow and its aim is rough. Minion AI can also cause problems (Odealo).
gearPriorities: Weapon for the first half of leveling (until the Act 3 switch): increased / added physical damage, accuracy and critical strike chance on the spear. Gloves and rings take added damage (PoE Vault).
Weapon after the switch: Sceptre + shield. On the sceptre, prioritize '+ levels to minion skills' and 'Allies in your Presence deal increased Damage' (Maxroll 0.5.5).
Helmet and amulet: + levels to minion skills. Start looking for the helmet and sceptre from Act 2 (PoE Vault).
Shield, chest, gloves, boots: maximum Life and resistances. PoE Vault's Endgame version is Evasion-based, and aims for 'gain Deflection equal to a portion of your Evasion' on gloves and boots.
Boots: movement speed.
At the start of mapping: secure 75% elemental resistances (chaos resistance is good to have). When you change gear, do not drop below the resistance caps or required attributes (Maxroll / PoE Vault).

Endgame main hand: with the ascendancy The Catha's Balance, the main-hand weapon's damage is added to the companion, so use the unique Tyranny's Grip (or Trenchtimbre for a more durable option) upgraded with a Verisium Anvil. The build also works without uniques (Maxroll 0.5.5).
Rings and belt: Breach-crafted minion mods are also effective, but meet required attributes and resistances first (PoE Vault).
