huntress-minion-spirit-walker.name: Minion Spirit Walker
huntress-minion-spirit-walker.seoTitle: PoE2 Minion Spirit Walker Build Guide 0.5.5 | Lv1 to Endgame Leveling
huntress-minion-spirit-walker.seoDescription: PoE2 0.5.5: Minion Spirit Walker's skills, supports, gear and passives from crossbow leveling to Endgame (ES setup). Enter your current level to see the three things to do now.
huntress-minion-spirit-walker.mainSkill: An army of unique beasts captured with Tame Beast, the Wild Protector bear spirit, Wolf Pack and Skeletal minions
huntress-minion-spirit-walker.audience: Players who like summoner play — letting an army fight while they support — and can enjoy an early setup switch
huntress-minion-spirit-walker.difficulty: Level with a crossbow early, respec into the minion setup at Lv22. Requires companion selection and Spirit management
strengths: The army handles combat, so you can focus on positioning and support (Switchblade Gaming's guide states 'The companions do the killing').
Companions serve as both tank and damage, smoothly handling both clear and single target (Zizaran's video summary, Exile Codex).
Leveling is cheap and stable. Early gear only needs added damage, Life and resistances (same source).
Huge scaling potential. There are reports of one-shotting most content and three-shotting bosses (same source).
Listed as A Tier in Maxroll's League Starter Tier List (updated November 3, 2026), and a setup Zizaran adopted as his own league starter.
weaknesses: The main army setup cannot be used from the start. You level with a crossbow (grenades) until Lv22, and need gold for the passive respec (U4GM summary / Zizaran's video summary).
Attribute requirements are strict, and you can easily end up chasing stats (a weakness in Zizaran's video summary).
Early defense is unstable, and there are points where you need a patchwork of armour, evasion and block (same source).
Obtaining specific companions (the Mighty Silverfist, beasts with a Haste aura) requires targeted farming (same source).
There is no way to recall minions (a Convocation equivalent), leaving positioning inconveniences (same source).
Whether it works in SSF is not stated in the sources.
gearPriorities: Sceptre: + minion skill levels and Spirit. The base for the army's numbers and damage (U4GM summary).
Helmet: + minion skill levels. Look for it with top priority alongside the sceptre (U4GM summary).
Minion damage and minion attack speed: stack them across all gear (U4GM summary).
Spirit: decides how many companions and support skills you can run at once. Calculate the reservation allocation first (U4GM summary).
Defense: early on, added damage, Life and resistances (Zizaran's video summary). Later, grow ES and prepare for the Chaos Inoculation transition (U4GM summary).
Jewels: leave special jewel upgrades for later, within what the budget allows (U4GM summary).

levelingStages.label: Lv1–21 (crossbow leveling)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Progress with a crossbow. Flash Grenade is the leveling mainstay, Explosive Grenade is single-target for bosses you have stopped in place, Frost Bomb supports bosses, and Crossbow Shot fills in as the basic attack
levelingStages.supports: Plan to attach area-expanding supports / runes to Flash Grenade (per Zizaran's video summary. Check the exact gem setup in the source guide's (Maxroll) planner).
levelingStages.passivePriority: Use the pre-transition attack tree. Follow the source guide's leveling tree (planner).
levelingStages.gearPriority: Flat added damage, Life, resistances. Gear can be minimal (Zizaran's video summary).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Compare crossbows by added damage first.
levelingStages.caution: The finished army setup cannot be assembled at this stage. Do not force minions; progress with the crossbow (U4GM summary). Do not spend all the gold for the respec.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Reach around Lv22 and be able to attempt the Trial of the Sekhemas (first ascendancy).
nowActions: Clear packs with Flash Grenade
Update to gear with added damage, Life and resistances
Keep gold saved for the respec

levelingStages.label: Lv22–End of Act 2 (transition begins)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Choose Spirit Walker at the first ascendancy and add the Wild Protector bear spirit to the army. Transition toward minions while still using crossbow attacks
levelingStages.supports: Plan to give companions Minion Splash, Rage, Rapid Attacks and Hulking Minions type supports (Zizaran's video summary).
levelingStages.passivePriority: Respec passives from attack-based to minion-based (Switchblade Gaming's guide puts the Lv22 respec as the turning point, at a cost of about 7,000 gold). The first ascendancy point is Wild Protector.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Start looking for + minion skill levels on helmet and sceptre. Next, minion damage and minion attack speed (U4GM summary).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Consider switching the weapon from a crossbow to a sceptre with minion skill levels.
levelingStages.caution: The bear spirit does not count toward the companion limit (poe2db). Spirit reservation allocation decides how many companions and support skills you can run (U4GM summary).
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Advance to Act 3 and be able to take The Natural Order at the second ascendancy.
nowActions: Take Wild Protector
Respec passives to minion-based
Look for a helmet and sceptre with + minion skill levels

levelingStages.label: Act 3–Campaign End (forming the army)
levelingStages.mainSkill: With The Natural Order, Tame Beast can capture unique beasts. Build the army around the Mighty Silverfist as the main candidate, with Wolf Pack and Skeletal minions. You support with Pain Offering, Mark for Death and Charged Mark
levelingStages.supports: Skeletal minions also serve as targets for Pain Offering (U4GM summary). Companion supports continue the plan from the transition stage.
levelingStages.passivePriority: The second ascendancy point is The Natural Order. The third is The Catha's Balance, where 60% of the main-hand weapon's damage is added to companions (Switchblade Gaming's order).
levelingStages.gearPriority: Balance + minion skill levels (helmet / sceptre), Spirit, Life and resistances.
levelingStages.replaceGear: If Spirit is short, prioritize updating the sceptre and Spirit sources.
levelingStages.caution: You can take at most 1 Tamed Beast (unique beast) at a time (The Natural Order, poe2db). Obtaining a targeted companion (the Mighty Silverfist or one with a Haste aura) requires farming (a weakness in Zizaran's video summary).
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Finish the campaign with the army's lineup in place and enter maps.
nowActions: Aim to capture the Mighty Silverfist
Settle the use of Pain Offering and marks
Check the Spirit breakdown

levelingStages.label: Early Maps
levelingStages.mainSkill: Clear with the army. You maintain marks and Pain Offering from a safe position and leave the killing to the army
levelingStages.supports: Keep the army's support setup, and swap according to the role that is lacking (area / single target).
levelingStages.passivePriority: Extend minion damage and companion nodes, and start building the defense base (evasion / ES).
levelingStages.gearPriority: Minion skill levels, minion damage, minion attack speed, Spirit (the Endgame priorities in the U4GM summary).
levelingStages.replaceGear: If you get killed, update armor and resistances; if damage is lacking, update slots with + minion skill levels.
levelingStages.caution: Early defense tends to be unstable. There are points where a patchwork of armor, evasion and block is needed (a weakness in Zizaran's video summary).
levelingStages.transitionCondition: The army is stable in high-Tier maps and you start gathering ES gear.
nowActions: Sort out resistances and Life
Review the companion lineup
Start looking for ES gear

levelingStages.label: Early Endgame
levelingStages.mainSkill: Continue strengthening the army. Work on companion selection (beasts with auras and the like) with the finished ascendancy in view
levelingStages.supports: Optimize supports for each companion's role. Check exact combinations in the source guide's planner.
levelingStages.passivePriority: The fourth ascendancy point candidate is Idolatry. However, it assumes Idol gear, and the resistance penalty must be covered by gear (Switchblade Gaming's guide).
levelingStages.gearPriority: Build an ES base. Prepare the transition to Chaos Inoculation.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Update starting from high-ES chest and helmet pieces.
levelingStages.caution: Transitioning to Chaos Inoculation before ES has grown enough leaves you fragile (U4GM summary).
levelingStages.transitionCondition: ES has grown enough to transition to Chaos Inoculation.
nowActions: Swap to ES gear step by step
Continue companion selection
Cover attribute shortfalls with gear

levelingStages.label: Endgame (ES / Chaos Inoculation)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Handle high-Tier maps and bosses with an army centered on the Mighty Silverfist
levelingStages.supports: The source guide's (Maxroll) Endgame planner setup is authoritative for companion and Skeletal supports. The summary sources could not confirm individual gems.
levelingStages.passivePriority: Take Chaos Inoculation. Finish defense around ES and evasion.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Maximize minion skill levels, and upgrade jewels according to budget (U4GM summary. Expensive ones can wait).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Life stats are no longer needed. Update one piece at a time based on ES and minion stats.
levelingStages.caution: Strict attribute requirements are the biggest hurdle (a weakness in Zizaran's video summary). There is no way to recall minions, and companion positioning inconveniences remain (same source). There are reports that with certain Tablet mods, when a unique monster gains rare mods, the companion's critical strike chance grows close to the cap (same source).
levelingStages.transitionCondition: After completion, extend the build through companion selection and jewels.
nowActions: Resolve attribute shortfalls
Upgrade jewels within budget
Continue selecting companion mods

beginner.note: The main army setup only comes together after the Lv22 transition, and early play requires crossbow leveling and a respec, so earlyMainSkill is not counted as a confirmed condition. SSF viability is not stated in the sources.

moderateOperation.basis: The army does the killing while you focus on positioning, debuffs and Pain Offering. Switchblade Gaming's guide states: 'You manage positioning, apply debuffs, and cast Pain Offering. The companions do the killing.'

noDodgeRequirement.basis: Companions also serve as tanks, so you can fight from away from enemies. Zizaran's video summary (Exile Codex) lists as a strength: 'Companions tank and deal damage, smoothing both clear and single-target'

damage.note: The scaling once companions and supporting nodes are online is said to be large. It also sits in A Tier in the 0.5.5 Tier list.

changeHistory.summary: Created a new draft (unpublished). Checked Zizaran's Maxroll guide via a summary (U4GM), and cross-checked with the Exile Codex video summary, Switchblade Gaming's ascendancy guide, SlashSkill's ranking, and names and mechanics on the Japanese poe2db. The Maxroll text could not be checked directly due to HTTP 403, and that is stated in the sources. ranger-ice-shot-deadeye.audience: Beginners who want to fight at range with a bow, switching between clear and single-target attacks.

changeHistory.summary: Checked Maxroll (0.5.5) and Gamerch (updated September 18). Counted safe positioning via Maxroll's pro "Avoids most damage", and updated beginner-friendliness from unrated to 2/5.

Re-checked the source's descriptions, applicable stages and source information, and fixed mix-ups and over-generalizations. Sources and dynamic setups that could not be confirmed are not treated as re-verified, and the overall leveling verification date has not been changed.

Reflected the current source text's Lv24 mini-switch and the Herald of Ice preparation at Lv31. Revised the guidance so you do not switch immediately on the numeric level band alone, but check owned gems and Spirit. The exact per-stage tabs are unconfirmed.

Additionally checked the contents of the per-stage tabs and made the skill and support guidance that had not been captured more concrete. This is not a verification of all gear conditions or actual in-game runs.

Additionally checked the source guide's switch conditions and answers to common problems, and added links leading to the current stage's details. This is not a full re-verification of the 8 leveling stages or a date of hands-on play confirmation.

Re-checked the publication status, supported patch, update date, main skill and ascendancy of 3 of the 5 sources and updated the check dates. The 2 Mobalytics sources cannot be fetched automatically, so they remain unchecked (check dates left unchanged).

gearPriorities: Bow and quiver: added attack damage and actual attack performance
Armour pieces: Life, Evasion, elemental resistances
Boots: movement speed. Later, also check required attributes and the ES transition conditions.

Check the added damage on bow and quiver

levelingStages.transitionCondition: Reach Lv31. Ice Shot and the post-switch supports can be prepared.

strengths: The Lv1–30 leveling setup and the Lv31-onward Ice Shot setup are published per stage.
Clear-oriented Ice Shot and single-target Snipe can be given separate roles.
Endgame can start from a non-crit form and transition later to match your gear.
weaknesses: Ice Shot is not unlocked until Lv31, so early on you use Lightning Arrow and Lightning Rod.
Later defense and the crit transition depend on gear, and switching to the finished form too early tends to make it unstable.
Single-target fights require Snipe's charge and mana management.

witch-minion-infernalist.name: Sniper Minion Infernalist
witch-minion-infernalist.seoTitle: PoE2 Sniper Minion Infernalist Build Guide 0.5.5 | Lv1 to Endgame Leveling
witch-minion-infernalist.seoDescription: PoE2 0.5.5: Sniper Minion Infernalist's summon skills, early leveling, gear and passives from Lv1 to Endgame. Enter your current level to see the three things to do now.
witch-minion-infernalist.audience: Beginners who want to leave attacking to summoned allies and focus on enemy movement and dodging
witch-minion-infernalist.difficulty: Switch summon targets in Act 3 and around Lv67
strengths: Per-stage sources are published for each Act, the Interludes, and Lv67–90.
Minions handle attacking, so the player can easily focus on watching the boss's movements.
Gear goals — minion levels, Spirit and defense — are easy to understand.
PoE Vault's leveling version introduces it as a safe, ranged playstyle that attacks almost automatically.
About the Endgame Spectre version, PoE Vault introduces it as 'easy to play' with 'very high single-target damage' (a source for 0.5).
Maxroll (0.5.5) explicitly states the build works without any unique items.
Defense specialized in ES can withstand large hits and recover quickly. PoE Vault says it feels 'very durable'.
weaknesses: Movement speed is slower than high-speed clearing builds, and minion AI can get stuck in narrow places (PoE Vault also lists minion AI problems as a weakness).
You need to switch the Spectre setup in Act 3 and around Lv67.
Later durability depends on gear updates across multiple areas: ES, block and resistances.
Starting Spectre play requires a certain amount of Spirit (PoE Vault).
The Lineage support gems used in Endgame are expensive (PoE Vault).
gearPriorities: Sceptre: increased Spirit, increased minion damage, + levels to all minion skills. Check the Rattling Sceptre from early on (PoE Vault).
Off-hand: PoE Vault's Endgame Spectre version uses a Focus (ES, + levels to all minion skills). The Maxroll version uses a high-block shield (ES, Life, resistances).
Helmet and amulet: + levels to all minion skills, ES, Life. Reservation efficiency on the helmet and Spirit on the amulet are also effective (PoE Vault).
Chest: ES gear with Spirit. Gloves: ES, Life, resistances (PoE Vault). Maxroll also guides getting as much ES as possible on chest, boots, helmet, gloves and amulet.
Resistances and attributes: do not fix them to specific slots; meet 75% elemental resistances and required attributes with the total across all gear (Maxroll).
Rings: Life, resistances, minion damage or minion attack / cast speed (PoE Vault).

No unique is mandatory (Maxroll). The boots Bones of Ullr (reservation efficiency for undead minions) are PoE Vault's top-priority target, and Maxroll also introduces them as useful. If you obtain Exalted / Chaos Orbs during the campaign, there is also a plan to spend them on purchases such as Enfolding Dawn (Maxroll).

changeHistory.summary: Checked the body text of PoE Vault (Spectre version) and updated defense from unrated to 5/5 ('very durable', an ES defense that withstands large hits).

Checked PoE Vault's leveling and Spectre versions and Maxroll (0.5.5). Updated damage and boss to 5/5 ('Incredible single target damage') and beginner from 4 to 5 ('Easy to play'). Detailed gear priorities by slot, and added strengths / weaknesses and sources. Defense and mapping remained unrated as there was no supporting statement.
Added the condition that after Lv41 as well, the Sniper setup is kept until the Act 3 switch point, summon target and Spirit are met.
Specified that the Vaal Guard Spectre switch at Lv31–40 is not decided by level alone, and requires the relevant Act 3 location and preparation of Spirit and the summon target.

Rechecked the source statements, target stages and source information, and fixed mix-ups and over-generalizations. Sources and dynamic setups that could not be confirmed are not treated as re-verified, and the overall leveling check date has not been changed.

Additionally checked the source guide's switch conditions and answers to common problems, and added guidance leading to the current stage's details. This is not a check date for a full re-verification of all 8 leveling stages or actual gameplay.

Rechecked the publication status, supported patch, update date, main skill and ascendancy of 3 of the 5 sources, and updated the check dates. The two Mobalytics sources could not be fetched automatically, so they remain unchecked (check dates left as-is).

practicalGuide.heading: If you are stuck on minion Spirit shortages or the Spectre switch
practicalGuide.scope: Cross-checked against the FAQ and gear direction of Thy's 0.5.5 guide. The dynamic support setups for all stages and actual behavior have not been re-verified.

questions.question: I am Lv37 but cannot switch to Vaal Guard?
questions.answer: Level alone does not trigger the switch. The source guide targets the grenade-throwing 50 Spirit Vaal Guard after reaching Utzaal in Act 3. Keep the Skeletal Sniper setup until the target and the needed Spirit are in place.

questions.question: When minion Spirit is short, which gear should I check?
questions.answer: The source guide names the sceptre, amulet and chest as slots that can have Spirit. Compare the needed amount for the summon you want to use against your current gear, and also check minion levels for damage and your own defense.

questions.question: Powered Zealot — can I switch as soon as I hit Lv67?
questions.answer: The source author gives Lv65–70 as a switch guide, and recommends moving once you have a 5-link and the needed supports. With a 4-link, the author's judgment is to prioritize Vaal Guard. Do not treat level alone as a mandatory condition or a guarantee of the switch.

druid-plant-oracle.difficulty: The main skill continues from Lv1; triggered setups are added later
gearPriorities: Weapon (staff): among suffixes, +levels to physical spell skills is the top priority, followed by critical strike chance, critical damage bonus and cast speed. Prefixes: increased physical spell damage, "gain damage as extra damage," and increased spell damage (Gamerch).
Campaign: check shops for weapons with +physical spell / +spell skill levels. Maxroll uses a Life-based setup that reduces damage taken with Armour and "Armour also applies to elemental damage."
Armor: ES, movement speed on boots, Spirit on the chest, maximum mana. Gloves take critical damage. Secure resistances including chaos resistance (Gamerch).
Amulet: ES, +spell skill levels, critical damage, resistances (Gamerch).

Cheap uniques: the Nightscale gloves supplement critical strike chance and mana recovery and can be used from leveling onward. The Waveshaper chest can be used from leveling through Endgame (Gamerch).

Endgame: ES, chaos resistance, Spirit, mana sustain. Maxroll's Endgame setup casts spells using Life (with the Atalui's Bloodletting and Lifetap support gems) and runs Mind Over Matter together with Eldritch Battery.

strengths: Entangle can be kept as the main skill from Lv1 through Endgame.
The basic clearing actions are easy to keep few, and plant-based rooting can also be used.
A leveling guide and an Endgame guide are published by the same author.
Maxroll (0.5.5) lists "easy map clear," "auto-targeting" and "cheap to start at league start" as strengths.
High pack-clearing ability and few actions to perform (Gamerch).
weaknesses: Defense is gear-dependent, and ES and chaos resistance must be sorted out later on.
Watch out for running out of mana in long boss fights.
The triggered setup from the second ascendancy onward must only be switched to once the required gems and Spirit are ready.
Damage is hard to land on bosses that keep moving, and burst damage is on the low side (Gamerch). Maxroll also says top-tier bosses require gear investment.
The screen tends to become hard to read (Maxroll weakness: Visual Clutter).

druid-grim-pillars-oracle.audience: Players who want to leave the attacking to totems, clear safely, start cheap and scale up a long way

changeHistory.summary: Created a new draft (unpublished). Checked Palsteron's Maxroll guide via a mirror (kami-labs) and cross-checked it against Odealo's strengths and weaknesses and the names and numbers on the Japanese poe2db. The Maxroll text itself could not be checked directly due to HTTP 403, and that is stated in the sources.

druid-grim-pillars-oracle.difficulty: Level with plants early, respec to totems mid-game. Gem level management is detailed
gearPriorities: Sceptre: maximum Spirit (150–210) is the most important stat and the center of the build. A sceptre with a Purity-type implicit (fire, lightning or cold) can socket Spirit-related supports at no cost, so you can effectively stack things like +40% spell power or mana recovery for free. It can be made 6-linked even below Lv20.

Wand: +levels to cold spell skills is the top priority (at +5, damage roughly doubles). Next, spell power and elemental damage, cast speed, totem placement speed. Critical strike chance only matters after taking the third ascendancy.
Amulet: a Solar Amulet (up to 65 maximum Spirit) + spell levels. The anoint is Efficient Casting (+20% mana cost efficiency). The final form moves to a Stellar Amulet.

Chest: the Life version takes Life, mana, resistances and Spirit (up to 61 from a prefix). The ES version needs 650+ ES while keeping Spirit, and is the single hardest piece in this build. The helmet is about as important, due to the tree node (increased shield gained from the helmet).
Belt: the Darkness Enthroned variant that "treats socketed items' bonuses as body armour." Socketing a Rune of Blooming gives about 49 Spirit at Lv100.

Charms and more: early on, a Silver Charm against slows, a Stone Charm against stuns, and the cheap Nascent Hope. In the finished form, replace the first two with The Fall of the Axe and Rite of Passage. Movement speed on boots is mandatory. For chaos resistance, converting from other resistances with Void Flux is an early shortcut (conversion lowers the tier, and implicits do not move).

The stat priority is unchanged from the campaign to Endgame: cold spell levels → spell power and elemental damage → cast speed → totem placement speed. Critical strike chance is added after the third ascendancy.

levelingStages.transitionCondition: Obtain the Grim Pillars gem (drops from Lv22 onward; most players get it at Lv30–40 via the league mechanic). Or be able to judge that you will continue with plants to Lv52.

levelingStages.caution: A leveled Entangle has a high mana cost and cannot be used just for detonation. Create a fresh Lv1 one. Its quality is worth investing in (chance to generate additional fissures).
levelingStages.gearPriority: A maximum-Spirit sceptre (150–210 is the guideline, and the center of the build). Stack Spirit together with the campaign quest rewards (the first 100).
levelingStages.label: Lv30–Campaign End (respec preparation)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Continue the plant setup (Bonestorm as the main skill). Once the respec conditions are met, you may move to totems even mid-campaign.
nowActions: Check the 3 respec conditions
Create a fresh Lv1 Entangle
Calculate the Spirit breakdown (quests, sceptre, armor)
levelingStages.passivePriority: Check the respec destination tree. Ancestral Bond and the placement speed nodes (70% total) are prerequisites. Take the second ascendancy, The Lesser Harm, as a path to the third (no need to rush it).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Compare sceptres by Spirit amount first, then look at the weapon's spell levels.
levelingStages.supports: Maintain the plant setup. Prepare Spell Totem and a fresh Lv1 Entangle dedicated to detonation for the transition.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: All three are in place: (1) the Grim Pillars gem obtained, (2) a sceptre with Spirit, (3) Ancestral Bond taken.

levelingStages.caution: Spell Totem must be adjusted to exactly Lv14 including gear +levels (Lv14 is the breakpoint where the totem cap becomes 2; confirmed in poe2db's level table). Beyond that, only totem resistance grows, and the ascendancy makes it meaningless. Both weapons must be fixed to both sets, or switching will change your Spirit and the totems will disappear. Grim Pillars is a Kalguuran gem, and its gem level is raised or lowered with the currency Thaumaturgic Flux.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Securing Spirit is the top priority (75 per totem, 63 with Efficient Inscriptions). Aim for 300% totem placement speed.
levelingStages.label: Respec to Totems
levelingStages.mainSkill: Spell Totem + Grim Pillars. Detonation of the pillars is handled by Lv1 Entangle + Biting Frost I (a skill that consumes Freeze detonates the pillars immediately).
nowActions: Confirm Spell Totem's effective Lv14
Fix both weapons to both sets
Turn on Dynamic Culling
levelingStages.passivePriority: Take Ancestral Bond (doubles the totem cap, no cost or charge consumption; instead, each totem reserves 75 Spirit). Weapon set passives come into full use after the campaign: Set 1 (red) = all totem nodes, Set 2 (green) = cast speed, area of effect, critical strikes, Arcane Surge.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Prioritize updating the pieces where Spirit falls short (sceptre, amulet, chest prefix).
levelingStages.supports: The totem-side Entangle: Biting Frost I + Living Lightning + Branching Fissures I.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Totems stay up permanently, and you can clear the pillars with Entangle detonations.

levelingStages.caution: Do not use Mana Tempest before placing totems. Its effect lingers for 4 seconds after the cloud disappears, and the totems benefit from it passively.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Spirit (the final goal for 6 totems is about 400), +cold spell levels, resistances, Life / ES.
levelingStages.label: Early Maps
levelingStages.mainSkill: Make Spell Totem + Grim Pillars the clearing main skill. Use Mana Tempest after placing the totems.
nowActions: Check the Spirit breakdown
Sort out resistances and Life / ES
Stop Frost Bomb and Elemental Weakness at Lv18
levelingStages.passivePriority: The ascendancy order is The Unseen Path → The Lesser Harm → Forced Outcome → Unnamed Heartwood. After taking the third ascendancy, shift critical strike chance to 30–40% (beyond that, efficiency drops).
levelingStages.replaceGear: If you die, check armor and resistances; if you do not have enough totems, check your Spirit sources.
levelingStages.supports: Grim Pillars: Urgent Totems III + Efficiency II + Magnified Area II. Mana Tempest: Advancing Storm + Efficiency II + Lightning Mastery.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Totem uptime and detonation are stable in low-tier maps, and you can judge Spirit and mana shortfalls.

levelingStages.caution: The Life version can handle the campaign and endgame bosses, but one-shot deaths appear later on. For mana problems, first check gem levels (Overabundance), and deal with them through Efficiency-type supports. Stacking maximum mana itself also fattens your base recovery.
levelingStages.gearPriority: +levels to cold spell skills is the top priority (a wand's +5 roughly doubles damage). Next, spell power and elemental damage, cast speed, totem placement speed. The amulet is Solar (up to 65 Spirit) + spell levels, with the Efficient Casting anoint. The belt is the Darkness Enthroned type that treats socketed items as body armour, with a Rune of Blooming socketed to secure Spirit. Charms such as Nascent Hope are cheap.
levelingStages.label: Early Endgame (Life-based)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Run Spell Totem + Grim Pillars with curse and exposure support.
nowActions: Introduce Vorana's Siege (damage against isolated enemies = bosses)
Stack maximum mana to fatten the mana base
Look for a chest and helmet for the ES transition
levelingStages.passivePriority: The Life-based Endgame tree. Complete the weapon set specialization (24 points).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Rather than a fixed price, compare against listings under the same conditions for gear that addresses your current shortfall (Spirit, ES, mana).
levelingStages.supports: Elemental Weakness: Efficiency II + Cursed Ground + Heightened Curse. Frost Bomb: Spell Echo + Overabundance I + Efficiency II. In the Spirit slots, Purity of Fire with Mysticism II + Clarity II + Vitality II. Mana Drain is also used alongside.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Clearing and bosses are stable on the Life version, and you start gathering gear for the ES transition (a high-ES chest that coexists with Spirit, and the like).

levelingStages.caution: Only make the ES transition when you have damage to spare. Right after transitioning, you are weaker by exactly the damage nodes you moved into shield nodes.
levelingStages.gearPriority: ES: the chest keeping Spirit while reaching 650+ ES is the single hardest piece. The helmet is also important due to a tree node. Gloves and boots at the 200–250 ES class, and movement speed on boots is mandatory. Jewels take increased maximum shield % and recharge start speed. The finished charms are The Fall of the Axe and Rite of Passage.
levelingStages.label: Endgame (ES / Chaos Inoculation)
levelingStages.mainSkill: Spell Totem + Grim Pillars. Take Chaos Inoculation to set Life to 1 and nullify chaos damage and bleeding.
nowActions: Judge whether to transition by your damage headroom
When introducing Rakiata's Flow, remove curses and exposure
Update one piece at a time without using fixed market prices
levelingStages.passivePriority: Take Chaos Inoculation. Move some damage nodes into shield nodes (in exchange for about a 30% damage loss).
levelingStages.replaceGear: Life and chaos resistance become unneeded stats. Update one piece at a time based on coexisting ES and Spirit.
levelingStages.supports: In Endgame+++, Elemental Conflux adds Compressed Duration II + Fire Mastery. If you use the final piece, Rakiata's Flow, remove Frost Bomb and Elemental Weakness (lowering enemy resistances would cancel out the benefit).
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Once complete, improve the bottlenecks — Spirit, ES, critical strikes — one item at a time.

strengths: Because the totems handle the attacking, after placing them you can concentrate on evasion and positioning (Odealo strength: Safe totem playstyle).
High map clear power (Odealo strength: Great clear).
Large single-target damage as well (Odealo strength: BIG single target damage).
High damage uptime (Odealo strength: High damage uptime).
Totems do not consume mana, Life or Runewards, so Grim Pillars can effectively be cycled at no cost (the guide's mechanics explanation).
Suited to league start and cheap to begin, scaling to the several-hundred-Divine class with investment. Palsteron rates it "the best league start I have ever played (including the campaign)."
weaknesses: The screen tends to become hard to read (Odealo weakness: Limited visual clarity). The pillars can also block your own movement (same source: Pillars can block your movement).
Spirit is effectively the cap, and the roughly 400 Spirit needed for 6 totems is not reachable until late.
The Grim Pillars gem does not drop until Lv22, and Lv30–40 is normal for obtaining it. Early listings are expensive.
Gem level management is detailed (Spell Totem at exactly Lv14 including gear, Entangle at Lv1, Frost Bomb and Elemental Weakness stopped at Lv18).
The Life version has one-shot deaths later on, and moving to ES / Chaos Inoculation trades off about a 30% damage loss.
Whether it works in SSF is not stated in the sources. Gem acquisition depends on the league mechanic and is delayed.

mainSkillTiming.recommendedSwitch: Once all three are in place — the gem obtained, a sceptre with Spirit, and Ancestral Bond — respec to totems. The guide estimates that continuing with plants to Lv52 makes the gem cost about 1/10 as much.

witch-ed-contagion-lich.name: ED / Contagion Lich
witch-ed-contagion-lich.seoTitle: PoE2 ED / Contagion Lich Build Guide 0.5.5 | Lv1 to Endgame Leveling
witch-ed-contagion-lich.seoDescription: PoE2 0.5.5: ED / Contagion Lich's early leveling, how to use the DoT skills, gear and passives from Lv1 to Endgame. Enter your current level to see the three things to do now.
witch-ed-contagion-lich.audience: Beginners who want to spread damage over time from range and advance to Endgame stage by stage
strengths: There are per-stage setups from Lv1 to Endgame centered on Contagion and Essence Drain.
Written guides explain that it easily combines clearing regular enemy packs with safe positioning.
Setups are presented separately for the campaign, T1–T15, full-life and low-life versions.
Maxroll (0.5.5) lists as pros 'SSF campaign in about 5 hours, Arbiter in about 10 hours', 'very strong area clear' and 'a large ES pool'.
The clear is exhilarating, and you can fight with a safe, ranged playstyle (PoE Vault).
weaknesses: Using multiple skills makes mana consumption heavy.
In single-target fights, operations with different roles increase: Bonestorm, Dark Effigy, Despair and more.
The low-life version has many requirements, so do not partially mix it in from the early game.
It assumes a playstyle that does not get hit (Maxroll's con: 'Don't Get Hit Playstyle').
Damage depends heavily on whether you can obtain or craft a decent weapon, and damage over time takes time to take effect (PoE Vault).
Single-target fights are mediocre, and scaling and burst damage are modest. Damage depends on the performance of the wand and focus (Gamerch).
gearPriorities: Campaign: + chaos / spell / projectile skill levels on wand, focus and amulet. Gear with Life, ES and resistances, and boots with 20–30% movement speed (Maxroll).
Weapon importance is high: PoE Vault lists as a weakness that damage depends heavily on whether you can obtain or craft a decent weapon. For the wand: + Chaos Spell Skills, Spell Damage, Cast Speed.
After the campaign: update weak slots at shops and gambling vendors, and first secure the resistance caps (Maxroll).
From maps onward: update ES gear, and aim for 100% item rarity early. For jewels, increased maximum ES %, and at least one '% of maximum Mana recovered on Kill' for mana sustain (Maxroll).

Spirit: the Maxroll-derived condition that using Convalescence and Ravenous Swarm together requires 'a total of +50 Spirit on amulet and chest' could not be re-confirmed, as the source guide could not be obtained.

Endgame: + levels to all skills, ES, item rarity, high movement speed boots, Lv20–21 gems with 20% quality. The low-life version equips the unique Atziri's Disdain early after taking Eternal Life (Maxroll).
No unique is mandatory (Maxroll).

huntress-twister-spirit-walker.seoTitle: PoE2 Twister Spirit Walker Build Guide 0.5.5 | Lv1 to Endgame Leveling
huntress-twister-spirit-walker.seoDescription: PoE2 0.5.5: Twister Spirit Walker's early skills, weapon sets, combos, gear and passives from Lv1 to Endgame. Enter your current level to see the three things to do now.
huntress-twister-spirit-walker.audience: Players who want to start with no mandatory uniques and gradually build up area clearing with Twister
huntress-twister-spirit-walker.difficulty: Medium (two weapon sets and combo operation)
strengths: Published sources say you can start leveling with no mandatory uniques.
You can create a whirlwind with Whirling Slash and launch it with Twister, chaining into area attacks.

The direction for the early game, campaign and Endgame references overseas guides. The numeric level bands are this site's organizational guide, and the sources do not guarantee transitions at each level.
weaknesses: It requires assigning two weapon sets and multiple skills, and is not a complete one-button setup.
You need to practice the order of Whirling Slash, Ice-Tipped Arrows and Twister.
Endgame unique candidates are optional, and base gear and resistances must be sorted out first.
gearPriorities: Spear: physical damage, added damage, attack speed
Armor: Life or Energy Shield, Evasion, resistances, Deflect
Support: needed Spirit and movement speed on boots

levelingStages.label: Lv1–10
levelingStages.mainSkill: Once you have a spear and the needed gems, create a whirlwind with Whirling Slash and chain into Twister. Pounce is for movement, Shred is a werewolf-form support candidate; neither is treated as the published route's main skill.
levelingStages.supports: Early on, prioritize supports that extend physical damage and attack speed; check names you do not have in the source's stage table.
levelingStages.passivePriority: The source's Early Game stage. Check the route toward projectiles, attack speed and cold.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Physical damage on the spear, movement speed on boots, Life and resistances on armor.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Prioritize replacing a spear whose physical damage is low for your current level, and boots with no movement speed.
levelingStages.caution: Whirling Slash is used to generate whirlwinds, not for damage, so the source guides keeping it at Lv1.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: A progress guide around Lv11. Check your spear upgrade and the basic Whirling Slash → Twister combo.
nowActions: Prepare a spear and the Whirling Slash / Twister gems
Keep Whirling Slash at Lv1 and chain into Twister
Secure boots with movement speed and resistances

levelingStages.label: Lv11–20
levelingStages.mainSkill: Create a whirlwind with Whirling Slash and launch it into enemy packs with Twister.
levelingStages.supports: Prioritize Twister's damage and area. Use War Banner as support once obtained.
levelingStages.passivePriority: Continue the source's Early Game stage, checking in the order projectiles, attack speed, cold.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Physical damage on the spear, Life, resistances, Evasion. Keep movement speed on boots.
levelingStages.replaceGear: If damage stalls, replace the spear; if defense feels shaky, replace the slots lacking resistances and Life.
levelingStages.caution: Do not over-level Whirling Slash; prioritize updating the Twister side.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Reach Lv21. You can reproduce the basic combo of making a whirlwind and launching it with Twister.
nowActions: Create a whirlwind with Whirling Slash
Launch the whirlwind at enemies with Twister
Prioritize gem updates on the Twister side

levelingStages.label: Lv21–30
levelingStages.mainSkill: Whirling Slash → Ice-Tipped Arrows → Twister. If you adopt Barrage, use it before firing the Twister you want to strengthen.
levelingStages.supports: Prioritize Twister and Ice-Tipped Arrows, and add Barrage for single-target fights in stages.
levelingStages.passivePriority: The source's Mid Campaign stage. After taking Spirit Walker, check the current route including Primal Bounty.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Prepare both weapon sets, and check physical damage on the spear, added cold, Life and resistances.
levelingStages.replaceGear: First arrange skill assignments and gear requirements so the main skills work correctly on both weapon sets.
levelingStages.caution: Ascendancy timing varies with progress, so do not apply names ahead of time before you obtain them.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Reach Lv31. Weapon set switching and the three-skill combo are stable.
nowActions: Add Ice-Tipped Arrows to the combo
Set up both weapon sets
Prepare Barrage for single-target fights

levelingStages.label: Lv31–40
levelingStages.mainSkill: Use Whirling Slash three or more times, prepare with Ice-Tipped Arrows and Barrage, then fire Twister.
levelingStages.supports: Prioritize updating Twister, Barrage and Ice-Tipped Arrows, and keep the whirlwind-generating Whirling Slash at Lv1.
levelingStages.passivePriority: The source's Mid Campaign stage. Extend projectiles, cold and attack speed, and check Evasion and Deflect for defense.
levelingStages.gearPriority: A high physical damage spear, movement speed, Life, resistances, Evasion.
levelingStages.replaceGear: The weapon is top priority, then fix resistance and movement speed shortfalls.
levelingStages.caution: If the number of whirlwinds and the skill order break down, damage falls, so check the operation in single-target fights.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Reach Lv41. You can reproduce the combo in both clearing and single-target fights.
nowActions: Create multiple whirlwinds before attacking
Prioritize updating Twister and Barrage
Check Evasion, Deflect and resistances

levelingStages.label: Lv41–Campaign End
levelingStages.mainSkill: Whirling Slash → Ice-Tipped Arrows → Barrage → Twister. For movement and support, check the source's weapon set assignments.
levelingStages.supports: Match the source's Mid / Late Campaign setup and prioritize completing the links of the three main skills.
levelingStages.passivePriority: The source's Mid / Late Campaign stage. Check the current route that adopts Dance with Death and the weapon set assignments.

levelingStages.replaceGear: Before the campaign ends, update slots lacking elemental resistances and the old spear.
levelingStages.caution: Do not break the per-weapon-set skill assignments, and prioritize base defense over optional uniques.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Campaign finished. Resistances are in order and the basic combo handles both regular enemies and bosses.

Sort out resistances before the campaign ends
Update the spear and armor before optional uniques

levelingStages.mainSkill: Use Whirling Slash three or more times, use Ice-Tipped Arrows and Barrage, then chain into Twister.
levelingStages.supports: Prioritize the main skills' links and keep support skills up with no Spirit shortfall.

levelingStages.supports: Complete the main links and secure the needed Spirit to maintain support effects.
levelingStages.passivePriority: The source's Endgame stage. Extend critical, cold and attack speed, and check the balance with Evasion and Energy Shield.
levelingStages.gearPriority: High physical and added damage on the spear, Spirit, Life or Energy Shield, Evasion, resistances.

Fixed the incorrect operation order that used Barrage after Twister. Corrected a source explanation about Lv11–20 that was not in the source, and changed the main skill's early availability condition to PoE2DB. Also corrected the early guidance that treated Pounce and Shred as main skills to their roles in the source: movement and transformation support.
Rechecked the publication status, supported patch, update date, main skill and ascendancy of all 5 sources, and updated the check dates.

changeHistory.summary: Newly published. Confirmed the Lv1 to Endgame steps in the stage-by-stage resources from PoE Vault (0.5 leveling, 0.5.5 Endgame) and pathofexile.gg.

Re-checked the sources' statements, the stages they apply to and the source information, and fixed mix-ups and overgeneralizations. Sources and dynamic setups that could not be confirmed are not treated as re-verified, and the overall leveling checked date has not been changed.

Re-checked the publication status, supported patch, update date, main skill and ascendancy of all 3 sources and updated the checked dates. sorceress-spark-stormweaver.difficulty: The main skill continues from Lv1; the automatically triggered Comet is added in Endgame
gearPriorities: Staff: lightning / all spell skill levels, added elemental damage, increased spell damage, cast speed
Armor: Life, resistances, Energy Shield, mana recovery rate (tiara, robe, gloves, sandals)
Endgame: 121+ Spirit and critical strike chance. The source states the Maligaro's Virtuosity gloves are the key to its damage.

levelingStages.caution: This level band applies the source's "Act 1" content. The correspondence between level and progress is a guideline.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Lightning and all spell skill levels on the staff, then cast speed and spell damage. Armor is gear with Energy Shield.
levelingStages.label: Lv1–10
levelingStages.mainSkill: Make Spark, obtained from the gem chest at the starting point, your main skill. Your second skill is Frost Bomb, followed by Flame Wall.
nowActions: Put Spark on your main attack button
Create Frost Bomb and use it together with Spark
Look for a staff with spell skill levels
levelingStages.passivePriority: Take the route toward elemental damage, and put attribute nodes mainly into Intelligence. Only supplement the Strength and Dexterity needed for gear and gems.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Replace staves with spell skill levels as the top priority. Merchant stock changes with level, so check every time you return to town.
levelingStages.supports: Strengthen Spark as the top priority. Once you create Orb of Storms, add Overabundance I and Unleash so you can place two at once.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Reach Lv11. You have obtained Spark, Frost Bomb and Flame Wall, and can defeat packs of enemies with Spark.

levelingStages.caution: Orb of Storms fires chaining lightning at enemies when you cast from within its area, so do not stray too far from where you placed it.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Skill levels and added damage on the staff, Life and resistances on armor, mana recovery rate.
levelingStages.label: Lv11–20
levelingStages.mainSkill: Spark + Frost Bomb. Create Orb of Storms with your first Lv3 Uncut Skill Gem, and cast Spark from within its area.
nowActions: Create Orb of Storms and place two of them
Add Rising Tempest to Spark
Activate Mana Remnants with 30 Spirit
levelingStages.passivePriority: While scaling elemental damage, aim for Secrets of the Orb, which lets you place three Orb of Storms.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Once you obtain 30 Spirit (defeating The King in the Mists in Act 1), activate Mana Remnants.
levelingStages.supports: From Act 2, Lv2 Uncut Support Gems appear. Add Rising Tempest to Spark, then to Orb of Storms.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Reach Lv21. You can place two Orb of Storms and fight in the order Frost Bomb → Orb of Storms → Spark.

levelingStages.caution: The source states that the Chiming Staff (damage) and Wolf Form (movement speed) cannot be used at the same time — only one of them.
levelingStages.gearPriority: The staff is the top priority. Armor in the order Life, resistances, Energy Shield, mana recovery rate.
levelingStages.label: Lv21–30
levelingStages.mainSkill: Spam Frost Bomb → Orb of Storms → Spark. On bosses, use Elemental Weakness (a Lv7 Uncut Skill Gem).
nowActions: Finish the trial and take Storm's Recollection
Open Spark's third socket
Use Elemental Weakness on bosses
levelingStages.passivePriority: After finishing Act 2's trial (Trial of the Sekhemas), take the Stormweaver's Storm's Recollection. A single Frost Bomb can create 6 Cold Infusions.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Optionally, hold a Chiming Staff (Lv25+) in Weapon Set 2 and use Sigil of Power. Set the other skills to Weapon Set 1 only.
levelingStages.supports: With the Lesser Jeweller's Orb dropped by enemies around Lv25, open the third socket of Spark, then of Orb of Storms.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Reach Lv31. You have taken the ascendancy and can use Elemental Weakness and Frost Bomb in boss fights.

levelingStages.caution: The source guides you to keep mana above 90% while using Zenith. Keep your remaining mana up with mana recovery rate on the staff, rings and amulet, and with a mana flask.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Skill levels, cast speed and spell damage on the staff. Armor takes resistances and Energy Shield.
levelingStages.label: Lv31–40
levelingStages.mainSkill: Centered on Spark. On bosses, the order is Sigil of Power → Elemental Weakness → Frost Bomb → Orb of Storms → Spark.
nowActions: Raise Spark's supports to Zenith II
Switch to Blasphemy at 60 Spirit
Finish the Trial of Chaos and gain 2 more ascendancy points
levelingStages.passivePriority: At Act 3's Temple of Chaos, finish Ultimatum (the Trial of Chaos) and obtain 2 ascendancy points.
levelingStages.replaceGear: With 60 Spirit (The King in the Mists + Act 3's Ignagduk), replace Mana Remnants with Blasphemy and move Elemental Weakness into that socket.
levelingStages.supports: From Act 3, Lv3 Uncut Support Gems appear. Raise Spark's supports to Zenith II.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Reach Lv41. Elemental Weakness is automated through Blasphemy, and you can reproduce the boss rotation.

levelingStages.caution: The Greater Jeweller's Orb rarely drops, so do not count on it. If one drops, use it on Spark, then on Orb of Storms.
levelingStages.gearPriority: A Voltaic Staff (item level 36+ gives +3–4 levels to lightning spell skills) has the most room to grow. Maintain resistances and Energy Shield as well.
levelingStages.label: Lv41–Campaign End
levelingStages.mainSkill: Spark as the main skill, supplementing boss damage with Frost Bomb, Orb of Storms and Flame Wall.
nowActions: Add Considered Casting to Spark
Aim to update to a Voltaic Staff
Add Siphon Elements at 100 Spirit
levelingStages.passivePriority: The second ascendancy is Constant Gale (permanent Arcane Surge). Advance the leveling tree until the campaign ends.
levelingStages.replaceGear: With 100 Spirit (the final reward from defeating Lythara in the Interlude), add Siphon Elements and Clarity I.
levelingStages.supports: From Act 4, Lv4 Uncut Support Gems appear. Add Considered Casting and Projectile Acceleration II to Spark.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Campaign complete. Resistances are sorted out, and you can defeat regular enemies and bosses centered on Spark.

levelingStages.caution: If you use Mana Tempest, leave its area as soon as you have gained the effect. Staying inside drains your mana rapidly.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Secure Energy Shield on the tiara, robe, gloves and sandals. Prefixes take Life and added Energy Shield, and resistances are supplemented with runes.
levelingStages.label: Early Maps
levelingStages.mainSkill: Spam Spark against regular enemies. Against strong enemies, use the order Sigil of Power → Frost Bomb → Orb of Storms → Spark.
nowActions: Sort out resistances and Energy Shield
Cover mana shortfalls with Efficiency II
Secure an amulet with Spirit
levelingStages.passivePriority: Move from the leveling tree to the Endgame tree. Check Cold Infusions, elemental damage and Energy Shield.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Update one piece at a time in the order: insufficient resistances, insufficient defense, insufficient staff damage. Keep an amulet with Spirit, as you will use it later.
levelingStages.supports: Maintain the Spark and Orb of Storms links, and add Efficiency II to mana-hungry skills to cover mana shortfalls.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: You can farm centered on Spark while maintaining resistances in low-tier maps.

levelingStages.caution: Pinpoint Critical lowers critical damage, so the source assumes it is used together with Maligaro's Virtuosity (which fixes the critical multiplier).
levelingStages.gearPriority: Spirit (staff and amulet, the robe prefix, a helmet corruption, side quests) and critical strike chance.
levelingStages.label: Early Endgame
levelingStages.mainSkill: With 121+ Spirit, add Cast on Critical + Comet. Spark's critical strikes automatically trigger Comet, and the controls stay the same as before.
nowActions: Raise Spirit to 121 or more
Add Cast on Critical and Comet
Raise the critical strike chance with Pinpoint Critical
levelingStages.passivePriority: Taking Elemental Equilibrium makes Orb of Storms produce Cold Infusions and Frost Bomb produce Fire Infusions, strengthening Comet.
levelingStages.replaceGear: The source states the Maligaro's Virtuosity gloves are the key to its damage. After equipping Call of the Brotherhood, prioritize added cold damage over added lightning damage.
levelingStages.supports: Add Pinpoint Critical to Spark, Cast on Critical and Orb of Storms to raise the critical strike chance.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: Comet triggers automatically, and you have enough Spirit including Convalescence for emergencies.

levelingStages.caution: This is a different author, gear set, passive tree and ascendancy from the preceding setup that uses Maligaro's Virtuosity. You cannot assume you can transition just by adding mana. Cross-check the required respec, gems and gear together. The source explicitly states it includes expensive gear and is not for a low-budget start. Unconfirmed in 1.0.
levelingStages.gearPriority: Maximum mana (5,000+ is the guideline), critical strike chance, Spirit. If you do not have an Absent Amulet (with Cast on Critical), supplement Spirit with a sceptre.
levelingStages.label: Endgame (finished form)
levelingStages.mainSkill: The option of rebuilding into a separate high-budget mana-stacking setup. Farming is Spark; bosses are Frost Bomb → Spark. Comet triggers automatically through Cast on Critical.
nowActions: Aim for 5,000+ maximum mana
Keep Spark's critical strike chance at 90%+
Re-check the supported-version display before moving to 1.0
levelingStages.passivePriority: The ascendancy is Constant Gale, Force of Will, Tempest Caller and Multiplying Squalls. Jewels prioritize critical strike chance, critical damage and spell damage.
levelingStages.replaceGear: Cloak of Defiance is not mandatory. If you use a regular Energy Shield chest instead, take Mind Over Matter in the passives.
levelingStages.supports: Keep Spark's critical strike chance at 90% or more. Strengthen supports in the priority order of the source's gem table, and also raise each skill's quality.
levelingStages.transitionCondition: The 0.5.5 stage you are using is complete, and you can compare before and after the change in-game.

strengths: The Sorceress can obtain Spark from the gem chest at the starting point and keep using the same main skill from Lv1 through Endgame.
Normal farming centers on spamming Spark, and in Endgame Comet automatically triggers on critical strikes (the source describes it as "almost one button").
The campaign leveling guide explicitly states that it also works in SSF (no trade).
weaknesses: Damage depends heavily on the staff's performance, according to the leveling guide's weakness column.
Boss fights require a multi-button rotation using Frost Bomb, Orb of Storms, Flame Wall and more in sequence.

In the overseas guide setup that adds CoC Comet, 121+ Spirit is the guideline. The separate mana-stacking finished form requires 90%+ critical strike chance, 5,000+ maximum mana and a rebuild of gear and tree, making it hard to assemble on a low budget.
